  /==++====++==\                                             /==++====++==\
 /==++====++====++====++====++====<<##0##>>====++====++====++====++====++==\
| >SND2. Blaine County and Los Santos                                       |
 \==++====++====++====++====++====<<##0##>>====++====++====++====++====++==/
  \==++====++==/                                             \==++====++==/

The north half of the state is dominated by Blaine County. This area is
sparsely populated and very rugged. There are several major mountains in this
county including Mount Josiah, Mount Gordo, and Mount Chiliad. In the center
of the county is a huge freshwater lake called the Alamo Sea. There are
several small towns in the county including Paleto Bay, Grapeseed, and Sandy
Shores. To the west is a major military base, Fort Zancudo.

Between Blaine County and Los Santos itself is Los Santos County. Most of
this area is very hilly and sparsely populated.

Los Santos itself is a major metropolis with many neighborhoods. The very
rich live in the Rockford Hills and Vinewood areas to the north. The world
famous beaches are located at the west side of the city. The downtown area
contains some of the tallest buildings in the state of San Andreas. The south
central region of the city contains lower class neighborhoods fraught with
gang activity.

To the southwest is the world famous Los Santos International Airport. The
south and east regions of the city are mainly industrial complexes with some
lower end neighborhoods mixed in.

But the story starts elsewhere.....

            /=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=\
 /=========================================================================\
| >GHF1. Prologue                                                           |
 \=========================================================================/
            \=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=/

Ludendorff, North Yankton, nine years ago.....

Unlike the previous GTA installments you get started right away instead of
just watching a cutscene. You are inside a depository and in the process of
robbing it. This mission is intended not only to set up things story wise but
also to show you the basics. This is also a good time to adjust certain
settings like target reticle and other visual attributes.

As you leave the depository you are confronted by multiple Police. These guys
are pretty easy to deal with as they are not very accurate. Go for headshots
to quickly dispatch them. After the sniper ambush you will confront a lot of
Cops but it is best to run away. After running away you will start some
cutscenes that bring you to the present day.

As Michael sits on a park bench near the beach he is asked by someone where a
certain house is. After Michael tells him where to go then you start the next
mission.....

0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0
| A. Franklin and Lamar |~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~\
0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0

0=========0
| Overview \
0=======================>

  In your first mission as Franklin you and your friend Lamar need to repo 
  some sports cars.....

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  After taking the vehicles you need to race Lamar back to the Simeon's 
  Dealership. As you race along you will be given instructions on your 
  Special Ability and controlling vehicles in the air. Try not to beat Lamar 
  as he is a good driver. The reason for this is so you don't wreck your car. 
  Just stay reasonably close and you should be fine.

  After the race then Lamar will drive off but the Police will come after you 
  with a 2-Star Wanted Rating. Lose them then duck into an alley until the 
  Rating disappears. After that then drive to the Dealership to and start a 
  cutscene. When this is completed then get into your vehicle, the White 
  Buffalo, and drive you and Lamar back to your home. When you arrive home 
  then the mission is successfully completed.

0===========0
| 100% Score \
0=======================>

  >>Not a Scratch
    *************
      You need to deliver the car with minimal damage. Not hard to do with 
      decent driving. Don't compete with Lamar so you can navigate the course 
      without crashing.

  >>Focused Driver
    **************
      You need to use Franklin's Special Ability for seven seconds. You need 
      to use it more than once during the race. Use it the moment you are 
      allowed to, let the gauge empty, then get enough Ability, maybe about a 
      third full, and use it again. This should be enough.

  >>Winner
    ******
      You need to win the race against Lamar. Since he is a good driver 
      you'll need to go through the race a few times to learn the course. In 
      addition, use your Special near the tail end as you go through the 
      garages - this is probably the best place to pass him up.

  >>We Come in Peace
    ****************
      You need to avoid hitting any aliens in the movie studio. Slow down a 
      little as you go through Backlot City so you can avoid the actors.

0=======0
| Reward \
0=======================>

  $250 plus the $78 you started the mission with. You will also earn the 
  {Welcome to Los Santos} Accomplishment. Parking your car by your house will 
  allow you to keep it there without having to put it in the garage.

  In addition, you are told about your Safehouse and the items within. After 
  leaving your home you will get a phone call from Simeon which sets up the 
  next mission but I will leave him be for now. Now that you're finally free 
  to do whatever you want it is time to go over things starting with.....

  0==================================0
 / The Main Story \+++++++++++++++++++\
0==========================================================================\
| >MSY1. Franklin Clinton                                                   +
0==========================================================================/

Although you got to play with Michael and Trevor earlier, Franklin is the
first major character you will spend a lot of time with. He works as a repo
man for a dealership owned by Simeon Yetarian and is trying to make ends
meet. He also lives with his Aunt Denise and that is also your Safehouse. He
is also friends with a guy named Lamar Davis but he ends up causing problems
for Franklin due to his general lack of intelligence.

As was pointed out during the mission Franklin's Special is to slow time down
while driving. But you will also make the vehicle go faster while in this
mode. This can be very useful in races and chases. Out of the three
characters his is the quickest and easiest to max out.

            /=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=\
 /=========================================================================\
| >GHF2. The Cell Phone                                                     |
 \=========================================================================/
            \=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=/

To bring up the Cell Phone, press D-Pad up and it will appear in the lower
right corner. At the top of the screen is the time and below it are the
multiple functions of your phone (starting in the upper left corner):

0===========================================================================0
| Email      | This has all of the email you receive throughout the game.   |
|------------+--------------------------------------------------------------|
| Texts      | This has all of the texts you receive throughout the game.   |
|------------+--------------------------------------------------------------|
| Check List | This lists your progress throughout the game and will tell   |
|            | you what is open.                                            |
|------------+--------------------------------------------------------------|
| Quick Save | This is the quick save feature that you will be using a lot  |
|            | of.                                                          |
|------------+--------------------------------------------------------------|
| Contacts   | This will list all of your contacts and will let you dial    |
|            | various phone numbers you may see around the area.           |
|------------+--------------------------------------------------------------|
| Settings   | This will let you view and change various settings of your   |
|            | phone.                                                       |
|------------+--------------------------------------------------------------|
| Snapmatic  | This will let you take pictures with your phone including    |
|            | the ever important Selfie.                                   |
|------------+--------------------------------------------------------------|
| Internet   | This will allow you to surf the internet with your phone.    |
|            | There's a lot you can go through here including Media and    |
|            | Entertainment, Food and Drink, Money and Services, Travel    |
|            | and Transport, and Fashion and Health.                       |
0===========================================================================0

            /=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=\
 /=========================================================================\
| >GHF3. Your Safehouse                                                     |
 \=========================================================================/
            \=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=/

Your Safehouse, in Strawberry, is a small but nice home that you share with
your Aunt Denise. Inside your Safehouse you have a bed (to save your game), a
closet (for your wardrobe), and a TV (to watch shows). There are also a
couple of Health kits inside.

Your personal vehicle, the Buffalo, will be parked outside near the garage.
The garage can be used to store additional cars and motorcycles. Like in the
previous installments you can fix vehicles with the garage but you will have
to get some distance away before it will work.

            /=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=\
 /=========================================================================\
| >GHF4. Weapons, Health, Body Armor, Stores, and Soda Machines             |
 \=========================================================================/
            \=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=/

In this chapter I go over information on the Weapons, Body Armor, Health,
Stores, and Soda Machines that can be found in the Blaine County and Los
Santos areas:

0+=+=+=+=+=+=0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0
| A. Weapons |~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~\
0+=+=+=+=+=+=0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0

Weapons are the tools of the trade for any professional criminal. There are 
thirty different weapons, in eight different categories, that can be found
and used to create mayhem and abuse. In previous GTA installments whenever
you found a weapon in a given class you replaced the weapon in that class if
what you found is different than what you currently have.

In GTA V you can collect and keep every weapon you find. Of course, you can
only use one weapon of a given class at one time. You can select what weapons
you would like to use by bringing up the Weapon Wheel, another new feature
presented in this game.

Hold down the Left Bumper (Xbox 360) or L1 Button (PS3) to bring it up. Use
the Right Analog Stick to move between the classes and the D-Pad Left/Right
to choose a weapon. Tap the Weapon Wheel button to holster or un-holster
whatever weapon you are currently carrying.

In previous installments whenever you picked up a weapon or item in the wild
it would take quite awhile for it to re-spawn again. In GTA V the re-spawn
time is much shorter. If you want you can stand in one place for awhile and
get a healthy amount of ammo for a given weapon without spending too much
time.

Like in GTA IV you can only carry a limited amount of ammo for your weapons
but you can drastically increase the maximum (up to 9,999 rounds for most
firearms) by maxing out your Shooting Skill. Maxing your Shooting Skill will
also make your weapons more accurate and, by extension, more powerful.

Unlike the illegal Gun Stores found in GTA IV you now have use of the ever
popular Ammu-Nation chain. There are a total of eleven Ammu-Nation stores
throughout the state including two with Shooting Ranges (which I will get to
later in the guide). They are all well marked on your in-game map. You cannot
use an Ammu-Nation when you have a Wanted Rating nor can you draw a weapon
while inside.

These stores carry pretty much every weapon in the game. However, only a
small number are available at the beginning - the others will unlock during
the course of the Main Story. There is even a wall for special weapons
available through downloads. Ammu-Nations even carry various clothing and
multiple types of Body Armor (more on that later).

You can even buy Parachutes but you won't be able to that until after the
mission "Minor Turbulence".

Another feature in this game is the ability to upgrade your weapons with new
items. You can un-equip an item if you feel it is not useful to you. In
addition, you can't add new items to a weapon until it becomes available at
Ammu-Nation. Listed below are the features available to most weapons:

0===========================================================================0
| Extended Clip  | Available on most firearms this will increase the amount |
|                | of ammo in your clip and will reduce the times you need  |
|                | to reload. Useful in a firefight, especially against the |
|                | Cops. Once bought you cannot un-equip it.                |
|----------------+----------------------------------------------------------|
| Grip           | Available on some rifles this will give some stability   |
|                | while in use.                                            |
|----------------+----------------------------------------------------------|
| Flashlight     | Available on most firearms this will allow you to        |
|                | illuminate dark areas. However, I prefer not to use it   |
|                | as this tends to spook potential targets.                |
|----------------+----------------------------------------------------------|
| Scope          | Available on most firearms this will give you some       |
|                | degree of zoom and improve accuracy.                     |
|----------------+----------------------------------------------------------|
| Advanced Scope | Available only on Sniper Rifles and will give excellent  |
|                | zooming ability for increased accuracy.                  |
|----------------+----------------------------------------------------------|
| Suppressor     | Available on most firearms this will add a silencer      |
|                | which makes the weapon pretty quiet and makes it easier  |
|                | to take down targets without being spotted.              |
|----------------+----------------------------------------------------------|
| Black Tint     | These options will only give the weapon a different look |
| Army Tint      | without making any improvements on performance.          |
| LSPD Tint      |                                                          |
0===========================================================================0

Of course, you can buy ammo for all your weapons at Ammu-Nation. One new
thing to note however. You can toggle between buying a single clip at a time
or purchasing the amount needed to max out your ammo in one purchase. Very
handy and saves time.

In addition, maxing out the ammo for a given weapon will also max out the
ammo for all the other weapons in that class. For example, if you max out the
ammo for your Pistol it will also max out the ammo for all the other Pistols.
The exception to this rule is the MG guns in the Machine Gun class.

In the following weapons list, below the weapon name, there is the following
information (if applicable):

  ++Appears after: This tells you what mission you have to complete before 
                   this weapon can be bought from Ammu-Nation.
  ++Cost: How much the weapon costs at Ammu-Nation (prior to discounts).
  ++Clip: How many rounds the weapon's clip holds (prior to purchasing an 
          Extended Clip) and how many it will hold after acquiring an 
          Extended Clip (if applicable).
  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ++Notes: Information on the weapon.

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

This list starts at the top of the Weapon Wheel and goes clockwise:

0==================0
| Slot 1 - Handguns \
0===============================================>

  These weapons can be used as a drive-by weapon (with the exception of the 
  Stun Gun).

    >>Pistol
      ******
        Cost: $350.
        Clip: 12 rounds / 16 rounds.
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        Notes: This is just a standard handgun that most gangbangers and 
               Police carry.

    >>Combat Pistol
      *************
        Appears after: Dead Man Walking.
        Cost: $600.
        Clip: 12 rounds / 16 rounds.
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        Notes: This handgun fires slower and has a smaller clip but packs 
               more punch making it easier to take down enemies.

    >>AP Pistol
      *********
        Appears after: Three's Company.
        Cost: $1,000.
        Clip: 18 rounds / 36 rounds.
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        Notes: This is basically a rapid fire machine gun pistol. It has the 
               same power as a regular Pistol but is more powerful because of 
               its rapid fire capability. This also holds more rounds but 
               goes through them far more quickly.

    >>Stun Gun
      ********
        Appears after: The Civil Border Patrol.
        Cost: $100.
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        Notes: This is a very short range weapon that stuns your victim for a 
               short time. It takes a long time to recharge so this isn't 
               really a good weapon to use in most situations. But it can 
               make for a few laughs.

0======================0
| Slot 2 - Machine Guns \
0===============================================>

    >>Micro SMG
      *********
        Cost: $850.
        Clip: 16 rounds / 30 rounds.
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        Notes: This is a small handheld machine gun that fires very rapidly. 
               Its rapid speed and small caliber creates a wide spread that 
               degrades its accuracy. Because of its small size this is the 
               only machine gun that can be used as a drive-by weapon.

    >>SMG
      ***
        Cost: $1,300.
        Clip: 16 rounds / 30 rounds.
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        Notes: This weapon is larger than the Micro SMG and fires a bit 
               slower. However, it is more accurate and powerful, due to its 
               narrower spread, thus making it more preferable than the Micro 
               SMG.

    >>MG
      **
        Appears after: The Paleto Score.
        Cost: $3,000.
        Clip: 54 rounds / 100 rounds.
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        Notes: This is a large belt fed weapon that has a large clip and has 
               a larger caliber than either the Micro SMG and SMG. It doesn't 
               fire as fast as the Micro SMG but fires faster than the SMG. 
               It also has a wide spread that makes it inaccurate at medium 
               distances and beyond.
 
               Because of its larger caliber rounds you cannot buy ammo for 
               this weapon by buying ammo for the Micro SMG or SMG.

    >>Combat MG
      *********
        Appears after: Blitz Play.
        Cost: $3,700.
        Clip: 100 rounds / 200 rounds.
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        Notes: This is similar in power to the MG but carries more rounds and 
               is more accurate because it has a narrower spread.

0========================0
| Slot 3 - Assault Rifles \
0===============================================>

    >>Assault Rifle
      *************
        Cost: $1,400.
        Clip: 30 rounds / 60 rounds.
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        Notes: This weapon is modeled after the popular AK-47 assault rifle. 
               It has a pretty good rate of fire but is less accurate at 
               medium distances.

    >>Carbine Rifle
      *************
        Appears after: The Jewel Store Job.
        Cost: $2,100.
        Clip: 30 rounds / 60 rounds.
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        Notes: This weapon has about the same caliber as the AK-47 and fires 
               slower but is more powerful because it is more accurate.

    >>Advanced Rifle
      **************
        Appears after: The Big Score.
        Cost: $3,500.
        Clip: 30 rounds / 60 rounds.
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        Notes: This interesting looking weapon has about the same power and 
               accuracy as the Carbine Rifle but fires faster.

0=======================0
| Slot 4 - Sniper Rifles \
0===============================================>

    >>Sniper Rifle
      ************
        Appears after: Nervous Ron.
        Cost: $5,000.
        Clip: 20 rounds.
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        Notes: This is a standard sniper rifle that has to be reloaded with 
               each shot. To properly use this weapon, hold down the target 
               button to bring up the sniper scope. Then use the Left Analog 
               Stick to zoom in and out. When you have the victim properly 
               targeted then press the Fire Button to shoot. In addition, 
               this weapon can shoot through more than one target.

    >>Heavy Sniper
      ************
        Appears after: Three's Company.
        Cost: $9,500.
        Clip: 12 rounds.
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        Notes: This is similar to the standard Sniper Rifle but has longer 
               range and is more powerful. In addition, you can't use a 
               Suppressor on it.

0=======================0
| Slot 5 - Melee Weapons \
0===============================================>

    >>Fist
      ****
        Your standard bare fist that can be made more powerful by increasing 
        your Strength Skill.

    >>Baseball Bat
      ************
        A standard bat that can be used as a powerful blunt force weapon.

    >>Crowbar
      *******
        A standard construction tool that can also be used as a weapon but 
        does not have as much range as the Bat.

    >>Golf Club
      *********
        This weapon can only be acquired after playing Golf and has the same 
        range and effectiveness as the Bat.

    >>Knife
      *****
        Cost: $100.
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        Notes: This weapon can only be purchased from Ammu-Nation and can be 
               used to quickly and quietly kill someone.

    >>Nightstick
      **********
        Appears after: I Fought the Law...
        Cost: $100.
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        Notes: This is a blunt force weapon similar to the Bat that the Cops 
               usually carry. However, the Police would rather shoot you down 
               than arrest you so going through Ammu-Nation may be the only 
               way to acquire this weapon.

0==================0
| Slot 6 - Shotguns \
0===============================================>

    >>Pump Shotgun
      ************
        Appears after: Repossession.
        Cost: $550.
        Clip: 16 rounds.
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        Notes: This is a standard shotgun that is carried by the Police. Has 
               good range and power but fires slow because you have to pump a 
               new round into the chamber after each shot.

    >>Sawed-Off Shotgun
      *****************
        Appears after: The Long Stretch.
        Cost: $300.
        Clip: 16 rounds.
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        Notes: This is a pump style shotgun that has had the barrels sawn 
               down for easier concealment. This creates a wide spread when 
               firing but greatly reduces its range. But, because of its 
               smaller size, this shotgun can be used for drive-bying (only 
               on motorcycles though).

    >>Assault Shotgun
      ***************
        Appears after: Blitz Play.
        Cost: $1,500.
        Clip: 8 rounds / 32 rounds.
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        Notes: This shotgun is more deadly than the Pump Shotgun because you 
               can hold down the Fire Button to rapid fire your entire clip 
               before reloading. This weapon has a much smaller clip than the 
               others but can be greatly increased with the Extended Clip, 
               something the other shotguns can't use.

0=======================0
| Slot 7 - Heavy Weapons \
0===============================================>

    >>Grenade Launcher
      ****************
        Appears after: Trevor Philips Industries.
        Cost: $8,100.
        Clip: 10 rounds.
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        Notes: This weapon fires special grenade rounds that will allow you 
               to land them with more accuracy than with the regular hand 
               thrown variety.

    >>RPG
      ***
        Appears after: Three's Company.
        Cost: $6,500.
        Clip: 20 rounds.
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        Notes: This very powerful rocket propelled grenade is best used to 
               destroy hard to reach targets, helicopters, and large groups 
               of vehicles. It should be noted that you can skip the grenade 
               along the ground and other objects so it is best to aim at 
               your target straight on to prevent this.

    >>Minigun
      *******
        Appears after: The Paleto Score.
        Cost: $15,000.
        Clip: 9,999 rounds.
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        Notes: This weapon may very well be the most powerful one in the 
               game. This powerful rapid fire weapon will destroy pretty much 
               anything in less than two seconds. Not much can stand up to 
               it.

               The only downsides is that it takes a couple of seconds to 
               start firing because it has to spin up first and that you move 
               slowly while using it thus making you vulnerable to the Cops.

0===========================0
| Slot 8 - Explosive Weapons \
0===============================================>

  The majority of these weapons can be used as a drive-by weapon.

    >>Molotov
      *******
        This standard flame based explosive weapon can only be found in the 
        wild. As usual, you need to be careful when using it or you may 
        accidentally set yourself aflame. You can only carry a maximum of 25 
        bottles.

    >>Grenades
      ********
        Cost: $150.
        Max Units: 25.
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        Notes: This weapon causes a nice sized explosion which is great for 
               clearing out a large group of people and cars. This weapon has 
               a four second delay when used. However, when you hold down the 
               fire button, then you can do what is known in combat lingo as 
               "cooking" the Grenade.

               The longer you hold the weapon, the less reaction time you 
               give to your intended victim when thrown. But, if you cook it 
               too long, then the Grenade will explode in your hand killing 
               you instantly. This, of course, makes for some interesting and 
               funny suicide situations. Release the Fire Button to throw the 
               weapon.

    >>Sticky Bomb
      ***********
        Appears after: Friends Reunited.
        Cost: $400.
        Max Units: 25.
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        Notes: This is an explosive weapon that you can attach to objects and 
               detonate remotely by pressing D-Pad Left. You can also 
               detonate it by shooting at it from a distance. You can also 
               create a larger explosion by placing several of them in one 
               place. You can also use it as a drive-by weapon and create 
               massive car explosions in traffic.

               Unfortunately, unlike the Sticky Bomb in TBoGT, you cannot use 
               it as a time bomb - it will not explode on its own, you must 
               detonate it manually.

    >>Tear Gas
      ********
        Appears after: The Jewel Store Job.
        Cost: $150.
        Max Units: 25.
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        Notes: This weapon creates a cloud of noxious gas that can 
               temporarily incapacitate others. However, if you stand too 
               long in the cloud, then you will die. But so will your 
               enemies.

    >>Jerry Can
      *********
        Appears after: Crystal Maze.
        Cost: $25.
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        Notes: This is a large gasoline can that has a hundred units of gas 
               inside. This is used for setting fires. What you do is pour 
               the gas on the ground and make a trail to something you want 
               to set aflame. Use either a firearm or the backfire of a 
               vehicle to set the gas on fire.

| B. DLC Weapons |~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~\
0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0

Since the release of the game there have been multiple updates to both the
single player and online portions. These updates often contain new cars,
homes, clothing, and weapons.

The new weapons are available when downloaded - even at the beginning of the
game. They can also be upgraded with expanded clips, suppressors, and grips.
Some of these weapons are useful and others can be considered nothing more
than novelties.

In this sub-section I go over the weapons currently available for download:

0==================0
| Slot 1 - Handguns \
0===============================================>

    >>Vintage Pistol
      **************
        DLC: The "I'm Not a Hipster" Update.
        Clip: 7 rounds / 14 rounds.
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        Notes: Has the same power and fire rate as the standard Pistol but 
               holds fewer rounds.

    >>SNS Pistol
      **********
        DLC: Beach Bum Update.
        Clip: 6 rounds / 12 rounds.
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        Notes: This is a very small pistol that doesn't do a lot of damage.

    >>Heavy Pistol
      ************
        DLC: The Business Update.
        Clip: 14 rounds / 36 rounds.
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        Notes: Has roughly the same power as the Combat Pistol but fires 
               slower. But it also holds more rounds.

    >>Gusenberg Sweeper
      *****************
        DLC: Valentine's Day Massacre Special Update.

               clip.

      ***************

| C. Health and Body Armor Icons |~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~\
0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0

But Weapon Icons aren't the only things you will find scattered around the
state. You will also find these other icons that you can use to help you
out:

0===========================================================================0
| Health     | This item comes in the form of a green First Aid Kit. It can |
|            | be found laying on the ground and attached to walls. Using   |
|            | one will bring your Health back up to its maximum.           |
|------------+--------------------------------------------------------------|
| Body Armor | This item comes in the form of a armored vest can usually be |
|            | found laying on the ground. Using one will bring your armor  |
|            | back up to its maximum.                                      |
|            |                                                              |
|            | It is important to note that you can also buy Armor from     |
|            | Ammu-Nations. There are several types with varying degrees   |
|            | of protection and cost.                                      |
|            |                                                              |
|            | However, the Body Armor you find in the wild is the same as  |
|            | the best and most expensive Armor type, the Super Heavy      |
|            | Armor. So it makes the others kind of useless, at least in   |
|            | single player anyway.                                        |
0===========================================================================0

0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0
| D. Stores and Soda Machines |~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~\
0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0

When your Health is low and there's no Health laying around and you don't
feel like paying for an Ambulance then you can regain your Health by finding
Stores and Soda Machines.

The Stores carry various candy which will replenish your Health a certain
amount depending on what brand you buy. Most Stores may also have Soda
Machines either inside or outside. It costs a dollar to buy a can and it will
completely refill your Health.

Soda Machines can also be found in the open. However, not all of them work. I
estimate that 97% of all of the Soda Machines I found work. Only the ones
that work are listed in the guide.

            /=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=\
 /=========================================================================\
| >GHF5. Weapons, Items, and Soda Machine Locations                         |
 \=========================================================================/
            \=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=/

Listed in this chapter, by area and neighborhood, are the Weapon, Health, and
Body Armor Icons plus Parachutes, Stores, and Soda Machines for the entire
map. Some of the locations come from the Brady Guide, some come from me, and
the rest come from fnxrak over at GTAForums (and YouTube).

The information is broken down as follows:

  --Location: Specific location of Store, weapon, or item.
  --Map: The co-ordinates on the printed map that comes included with the 
         GTA V game disc.
  --Directions: How to get there and find the weapon or item (if applicable).

                  junky building which should have a sign for Tractor Parts

                  the northwest corner of this building.

0========0
| Weapons \
0=====================================>

  >>Assault Rifle
    *************
      Location: On the ground some distance from a dirt road.
      Map: (C-3).
      Directions: On the Great Ocean Highway, at the west side of the map, 
                  there is a bridge that goes over Cassidy Creek. Starting 
                  from the north end of this bridge, head north on the 
                  highway. After some distance you should see several 
                  vehicles parked on the right side of the road.

                  This is also the beginning of a dirt road that proceeds 
                  into the hills. Go along this road and, when you get to the 
                  intersection of two major roads, continue straight. When 
                  you get to the next intersection just ahead, continue 
                  straight. Continue along this path and you should find a 
                  small bridge.

                  Just before this bridge, if you look right, you should see 
                  a small group of trees and rocks that form a straight line 
                  (there may also be a parked car nearby). Stop when you get 
                  near them.

                  Proceed south along this group until you get to two tall 
                  trees and a small rock. From this small rock, head due 
                  west. You should find the weapon on the ground about thirty 
                  feet from where you started.

| Chiliad Mountain State Wilderness |===| Chiliad Mountain State Wilderness |
0---------------------------------------------------------------------------0

0========0
| Weapons \
0=====================================>

  >>Assault Shotgun / RPG
    *********************
      Location: Inside the sheltered porch in front of the Church inside the 
                Altruist Cult Compound at the northwest corner of the 
                facility.
      Map: (C-3).
      Directions: On the Great Ocean Highway, at the west side of the map, 
                  there is a bridge that goes over Cassidy Creek. Starting 
                  from the north end of this bridge, head north on the 
                  highway. After some distance you should see several 
                  vehicles parked on the right side of the road.

                  This is also the beginning of a dirt road that proceeds 
                  into the hills. Go along this road and, when you get to the 
                  intersection of two major roads, turn left. At this point 
                  you will head upwards. As you near the next intersection 
                  you should see a water tank to your left.

                  When you get to the intersection then angle right. As you 
                  proceed along this path you should see the south wall of 
                  the Compound to your left. Continue until you reach a 
                  wooden bridge then stop. Proceed up towards the antenna 
                  mast and you should find a dirt path that leads down into 
                  the Compound.

                  It is important to note that if you have a firearm out or 
                  completely unarmed then they will shoot at you with 
                  Pistols. However, if you have a Knife out then they will 
                  attack you un-armed. This will make it easier to go after 
                  the weapons on the Compound as long as you don't stab them 
                  otherwise they will start to shoot you.

                  Later in the game you can bring certain people up to the 
                  Cultists when you are playing as Trevor. After dropping off 
                  enough people then they turn on him and this results in a 
                  shootout. After the shootout, which results in the deaths 
                  of the Cultists, then the Camp will be abandoned and you 
                  can freely go in and out.

  >>Baseball Bat
    ************
      Location: On the large rock at the west end of the Cult Compound.
      Map: (C-3).

                  distance you should get to a three-way intersection where 
                  this road ends. You should also see a large ranch house 
                  ahead of you. At the east corner of this intersection are

                  the east end of these stables (and next to some Health).

| Davis Quartz |=============================================| Davis Quartz |
0---------------------------------------------------------------------------0

0========0
| Weapons \
0=====================================>

  >>SMG
    ***
      Location: At the top of a ladder.
      Map: (D-6).
      Directions: Go to the intersection of Senora Way and Senora Freeway. 
                  From here, head south on Senora Way. After crossing the 
                  railroad tracks you should encounter the entrance to the 
                  Quarry which should be to your left.

                  After entering the facility then turn left at the first 
                  intersection you come up to. Follow the way and you will go 
                  under a small bridge. Turn right after going under and 
                  follow the rest of the road to a large conveyor belt 
                  machine.

                  Look for a large yellow generator and you should see a 
                  ladder leading up. Climb the ladder and you should pick up 
                  the weapon automatically when you reach the top.

  >>Crowbar
    *******
      Location: By a small building.
      Map: (D-6).
      Directions: From where you find the SMG go back to the intersection 
                  just beyond the front entrance. From here, turn left and 
                  proceed forward. There will be two forks in the road that 
                  you will encounter as you go - take the right one both 
                  times.

                  Go up the incline and you should find a small building at 
                  the top. On one end there should be some Porta-Potties. The 
                  weapon can be found on the ground by them.

| Weapons \

  >>Sniper Rifle
    ************
      Location: Near the top of one of the large smokestacks.
      Map: (D-2).
      Directions: The large power station can be found off of Senora Way 
                  directly east of Ron Alternatives Wind Farm. After entering

                  to the top and go around to the opposite side to find the 
                  weapon.

| Health \
0=====================================>

  >>Location: On a pillar at the upper level of the Kortz Center.
    Directions: Go to the intersection of Kortz Dr. and N. Rockford Drive 
                then go onto Kortz Dr. and take it to the end to reach the 
                center itself. Stop at the main entrance which is at the 
                small road loop.

                From here, head east and then go south along the east side of 
                the building. Continue south until you find a pair of large 
                umbrellas (which should be to your left) then stop. Look 
                southwest to find a set of stairs on the other side of the 
                open area in the center of the complex.

                Go up these stairs and, when you reach the top, you should 
                see a walkway ahead of you that goes above the open area 
                below. Go east on this walkway and stop when you reach the 
                end. Look left to find a column and the Health attached to 
                it.

  >>Location: By a door within the Kortz Center.

                walkway and find the stairs that lead down to ground level. 
                When you get back down then go northeast until you find a 
                large black bullet shaped sculpture then stop. To your right 
                should be a door and you can find the Health on the ground 
                next to it.

                Eclipse Blvd. From here, head northwest on Great Ocean 
                Highway. After a little over a half a mile you should find 
                the Country Club which should be on the left side of the 
                road.

                When you enter the parking lot then turn south and you should 
                find a loading area. There should also be a path by the 
                yellow striped area which should be to your left and on the 
                ground. Go along this path and it will take you to the Tennis 
                Courts. You should also find the Health, on the ground, ahead 
                of you when you get there.

                bridge. Just before you get to the bridge turn right and head 
                to Del Perro Beach. When you get to the beach then angle left 
                to find a lifeguard station. You should find the Health here.

                  culvert. At the south end of this culvert you should find a

  >>Pistol
    ******
      Location: On top of a small building.
      Directions: Go to the intersection of North Sheldon Ave. and Hillcrest 
                  Ridge Access Rd. From here, head east on Hillcrest Ridge 
                  Access Rd. After a short distance you should come to a 
                  small building with some graffiti on it. The weapon can be 
                  found on the roof of this building at the east end.

    *************
      Location: On a roadway island.
      Map: (C-1).
      Directions: Go to the intersection of East Galileo Drive and Baytree 
                  Canyon Road. From here, head west on East Galileo Drive. 
                  Eventually you'll come to a three-way intersection with an 
                  un-named road that leads up to Galileo Observatory. You 
                  should see a small roadway island here. The weapon can be 
                  found on it.

  >>Sniper Rifle
    ************
      Location: Near a telescope behind the Galileo Observatory.
      Map: (C-1).
      Directions: From where you find the Assault Rifle, go up the un-named 
                  road to the Observatory. When you get there then go to the 
                  east end of the main building and take a curved path that 
                  will lead you behind it. At the southeast corner behind the 
                  building is a lone telescope. The weapon can be found on 
                  the ground here.

  >>Sniper Rifle
    ************
      Location: By a tree north of the Galileo Observatory.
      Map: (C-1).
      Directions: While you are at the Observatory then go to the north end 
                  of the parking lot. Here you should see a dirt path for 
                  Arthur's Pass Trails. Go north along this path and you will 
                  see it split. Take the left path.

                  Look to your left to see a wooden fence. When you get to 
                  the end of it then turn left and go straight west. After a 
                  short distance you should see a large bushy tree which 
                  should be to your right. The weapon can be found at the 
                  base of this tree.

  >>Crowbar
    *******
      Location: Next to a concession stand at the Vinewood Bowl.
      Map: (D-2).
      Directions: Go to the four-way intersection where Senora Road, Elgin 
                  Ave. and Vinewood Park Drive meet. From here, head west on 
                  Vinewood Park Drive and go to the Vinewood Bowl. Go to the 
                  southeast corner of the parking lot where you should be 
                  right at the main stage.

                  Near this corner is a walk path that goes southwest up the 
                  stairs to the back part of the stands. Just ahead of you, 
                  as you start up, is a green building. This is a concession 
                  stand and the weapon can be found on the ground at its 
                  south side.

  >>Sawed-Off Shotgun
    *****************
      Location: Next to a tree.
      Map: (D-2).
      Directions: Go to the intersection of Whispymound Dr. and Baytree 
                  Canyon Ave. When you get there then look at your in-game 
                  map. Southwest of this intersection are two dirt paths. Go 
                  to where the two paths meet.

                  From this point, head north and between the paths. After a 
                  short distance you should come to a tree and a large rock. 
                  The weapon can be found on the ground next to this tree.

  >>Grenades
    ********
      Location: Near the Big O Juice Stand north of the Galileo Observatory.
      Map: (C-1).
      Directions: While you are at the Observatory then go to the north end 
                  of the parking lot. Here you should see a dirt path for 
                  Arthur's Pass Trails. Go north along this path and you will 
                  eventually get to a three-way intersection. Turn left and 
                  head west to find the Juice Stand. The weapon can be found 
                  on the ground about twenty feet southwest of the Stand.

            /=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=\
 /=========================================================================\
| >GHF6. The Order of Things (Part One)                                     |
 \=========================================================================/
            \=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=/

At this point in the game I am going to focus on maxing out most of
Franklin's Skills and Special Ability using the various tricks I listed
earlier. This will be very helpful in the early part of the Main Story. When
I do get to the story I will do any Stranger encounters as soon as they pop
up so they are out of the way quickly. I will do the same with the other two
characters when I unlock them.

Before getting to the Main Story I will do as much as possible for 100%
Completion as well as other tasks such as the following.....

            /=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=\
 /=========================================================================\
| >GHF7. Hidden Packages                                                    |
 \=========================================================================/
            \=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=/

The Hidden Packages are money filled briefcases, with different amounts, that
can be found inside wreckages on the ocean floor. Acquiring them does *NOT*
count for 100% Completion and neither is there an Accomplishment for finding
them. However, going after them can help you get a pretty good amount of
money at this early stage of the game which can be very helpful for weapons
and car repair.

Most of the wreckages are in very deep water and you will not be able to swim
down there without some kind of equipment. At some point within the game you
can buy some property that has scuba gear you can use. But IGN posted a video
where you can get some free scuba gear right from the start of the game.

Go to Elysian Island and to the west end. Here you should find a long
rectangular building for the Post Op Depository. Just west of the west corner
of this building should be a barge. Just north of this barge is a black
Dinghy (which usually appears during the daytime). Take the Dinghy out into
the water. Get out of the boat and you will fall into the water with scuba
gear on.

In addition to the Packages most of the wreckages will also have weapons and
other items scattered nearby. One good thing about this is that their glowing
will serve as a beacon to let you know that you are near a wreck location.
This is especially useful at night or in murky waters.

Some of the wreckages are in waters where Sharks are known to spawn. As long
as you swim away from them they will usually not attack. If one happens to
spawn while you are still in the Dinghy then wait for it to surface and kill
it with a drive-by weapon before diving.

When you arrive at a Package location you may notice that it will magically
appear in front of you as you get closer to it. The spawn delay is longer
with the PS3 version. So, when you arrive at where the Package is, give the
game a few seconds to make it appear. There are instances where the Package
may not appear at all and you will have to leave and come back later. I have
noted these instance with certain Packages.

Visiting all of these wrecks can net you $143,000. I recommend going twice
around the state to get about $286,000 which will make a very nice amount of
early spending money. Of course, once you get the hang of finding the wrecks
quickly, you can do as many "laps" around the state as you want. The more
money you have now, the more you can invest in the stock markets later in the
game.

If you plan to do laps around the state to collect Hidden Packages you may
want to do the following. When you dive down and reach a wreck then pause
your game and mark the location with a Point of Interest marker. This will
make the wreck easier to find when you come back that way again later.

There is also a well known exploit about the Packages that utilizes two
characters. Send one character out to get a Package and pick it up then
switch to another character then switch back. The Package will immediately
re-spawn. Continue switching back and forth this way to get lots of quick
money for one character. Unfortunately, this exploit was removed in the first
patch that was released for the game.

In addition, the patches that have come out since the game's release have
been known to affect the availability and re-spawning of the Packages. For
best results you should go after the Packages on an un-patched system
(removing whatever patches you have if necessary).

However, according to Sterling P. de Mille, you can pick up a Package, do a
Quick Save, then reload to make it respawn instantly (regardless of patches -
works with weapons too). This is not a bad idea if you don't mind the slow
reload times (especially with the PS3 version).

Listed below are the eleven Packages, their amounts, and their locations. The
Map co-ordinates refer to the main map that comes with the game. The
locations are based on the nearest land region and start at the northeast
side of the map going clockwise. I also note if the area tends to spawn
Sharks.

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

  >>Mount Gordo
    ***********
      Amount: $8,000.
      Map: (B-6).
      Sharks: Yes.
      -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      Notes: Look on your in-game map to find the dirt road that runs along 
             the north side of the mountain. Find the bend at the northeast 
             end of the road. Directly northeast of that is a small cove. 
             Park there and dive northeast.

             As you dive you'll notice that the depth colors indicate a steep 
             dive and that the darkest part is V-shaped. Go northeast right 
             at the point of this V and stay close to the floor.

             You should start seeing the weapon pickups through the murk. You 
             will also find large amounts of seaweed. But keep in this 
             direction and you should run into a crashed Duster. You can find 
             the Package on the floor under the wreck.

  >>Humane Labs and Research
    ************************
      Amount: $10,000.
      Map: (D-7).
      Sharks: No.
      -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      Notes: East of the area is a peninsula. From the tip of this peninsula, 
             head south along the shoreline. On your radar you should see a 
             small indentation on the shore just before it curves west.

             From this indentation, head east about five hundred feet then 
             dive. You should see some ruins on the ocean floor. Amongst them 
             is a large metal crate attached to a large ruined truck near the 
             edge of a drop-off. Inside the crate is the Package.

  >>N.O.O.S.E.
    **********
      Amount: $20,000.
      Map: (G-6).
      Sharks: No.
      -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      Notes: Just northeast of the area is a small group of islands. Go to 
             the south tip of the largest island and dive. Almost immediately 
             south of this point is a large cargo ship that broke apart. Find 
             the stern section.

             The top part of this section has been ripped open. If you look 
             down into this area you should see the Package amongst some red 
             railings near the top of the opening.

  >>Palomino Highlands (1)
    **********************
      Amount: $12,000.
      Map: (H-6).
      Sharks: Yes.
      -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      Notes: East of the shore is a large island. Go between the island and 
             the shore and dive. Here you will find a large paddle boat. The 
             Package can be found on the ocean floor inside the east paddle 
             wheel.
             ----------------------------------------------------------------
             **NOTE: The Package might not spawn upon arrival due to the 
                     vegetation and coral near its location. Leave the area 
                     and return a little later and it should spawn.

  >>Palomino Highlands (2)
    **********************
      Amount: $16,500.
      Map: (I-5).
      Sharks: No.
      -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      Notes: At the south side of the area, and east of Terminal, are three 
             small islands. Go to the east-most of these islands. From the 
             south tip, dive into the water. Here you should encounter a 
             large crashed cargo plane. Find the tail end. Go to the south 
             side of this piece of wreckage. Then go under the tail wing to 
             find the Package.

  >>Banning
    *******
      Amount: $7,500.
      Map: (H-4).
      Sharks: No.
      -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      Notes: Find the railroad bridge that connects Banning to Elysian 
             Island. From the north end of the bridge, go east until you find 
             a set of stairs that go into the water. Swim and dive directly 
             south of here to find a sunken barge. The Package can be found 
             on top of it. Since this is very shallow you can easily acquire 
             it without the need for scuba gear.

  >>Elysian Island
    **************
      Amount: $11,000.
      Map: (I-4).
      Sharks: No.
      -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      Notes: Look on your in-game map and zoom in on the central part of the 
             island complex. West of the south peninsula are a bunch of piers 
             going south into the water. Head to the area just west of this 
             group. When you get there then look for two small red bouys. 
             When you find them then go to the south-most one.

             Just to the southwest of this buoy is a large broken up tanker. 
             You need to find the stern section which is the part closest to 
             the buoy. The Package can be found on the floor inside this 
             section on the south side.
             ----------------------------------------------------------------
             **NOTE: The Package might not spawn upon arrival due to the 
                     vegetation and coral near its location. Leave the area 
                     and return a little later and it should spawn.

  >>Pacific Bluffs
    **************
      Amount: $25,000.
      Map: (G-2).
      Sharks: No.
      -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      Notes: Go along the shoreline and find the east end of the Pacific 
             Bluffs Country Club. From this point, head directly south about 
             a thousand feet. When you dive you should find a large sub-like 
             object on supports near the edge of a drop-off. On one end is a 
             large hatch. The Package can be found near the hatch.
             ----------------------------------------------------------------
             **NOTE: On rare occasions the game may spawn a large piece of 
                     rock-like coral where the Package is supposed to be. 
                     This will keep it from spawning. Leave the area and come 
                     back a little later. Hopefully the game will remove the 
                     coral and allow the Package to spawn.

  >>Fort Zancudo (1)
    ****************
      Amount: $9,000.
      Map: (D-2).
      Sharks: Yes.
      -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      Notes: Look on your in-game map and find the beach at the west edge of 
             the base. Find the westernmost point and go there. To the east 
             of this point is a very small inlet. Go to a point between the 
             west point and this inlet.

             Swim and dive directly south of this point. Dive into the deeper 
             water and you should find a sunken tugboat. You can find the 
             Package on the rear deck near the bridge housing.

  >>Fort Zancudo (2)
    ****************
      Amount: $12,500.
      Map: (D-2).
      Sharks: No.
      -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      Notes: Look on your in-game map and find the four-way intersection on 
             the Great Ocean Highway just north of Fort Zancudo. This wreck, 
             a crashed cargo plane, is 2,500 feet directly west of this 
             point and on the edge of a drop-off. Go to the rear of the 
             fuselage where it has been ripped open. The Package can be found 
             just inside.

  >>Paleto Bay
    **********
      Amount: $12,000.
      Map: (B-3).
      Sharks: No.
      -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      Notes: At the south end of the town is a long thin peninsula. Go to the 
             tip of this peninsula and head directly north about five hundred 
             feet then dive. Here you should find a large crashed cargo 
             plane. Find the tail end. The Package can be found on the floor 
             just in front of the front end of the tail section.

            /=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=\
 /=========================================================================\
| >GHF8. Accomplishments (Part One)                                         |
 \=========================================================================/
            \=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=/

In addition to acquiring Hidden Packages you can also go after two
Accomplishments:

  >>San Andreas Sightseer
    *********************
      Going from wreck to wreck will allow you to expose the outer edges of 
      the map. On your first "lap" you should expose the outer edge of the 
      ocean. On your second lap you should go long the land edges and expose 
      the waters there. If you do any more laps then you should expose the 
      remaining ocean waters.

      After exposing the ocean and getting back onto dry land then go to the 
      N.O.O.S.E. Headquarters to get a Buzzard and start flying over the 
      remaining areas to expose the rest of the map and get the 
      Accomplishment.

  >>Out of Your Depth
    *****************
      For this you need to get killed by a Shark. As you go collecting Hidden 
      Packages then keep an eye open for a Shark. When one appears then do a 
      Quick Save and dive.

      Just sit there and it will swim around you for awhile before attacking. 
      As you float and die then you should get the Accomplishment. After you 
      appear at the nearest Hospital then reload your save and continue on 
      your way.

            /=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=\
 /=========================================================================\
| >GHF9. Stunt Jumps                                                        |
 \=========================================================================/
            \=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=/

Listed in this chapter, by area and neighborhood, are the Stunt Jumps for GTA
V. There are a total of fifty Stunt Jumps in the game but you only have to do
twenty five of them for 100% Completion. Doing all fifty will earn you the
{Show Off} Accomplishment.

If you do a Jump and then do the same Jump again the game will tell you if
you already did it. This makes it easier to track down Jumps you may have
missed. In addition, completing a Jump the first time, regardless of
character, will add to your Driving Skill for that person. Making the same
Jump multiple times will not add Driving Skill.

Although you can do these Jumps with a car some of them are best done with a
motorcycle. However, you are more vulnerable on a motorcycle because a good
wipeout can do some serious damage to you (or even kill you). If you plan to
use a bike the best ones to use are the Bati 800 and Dinka Double-T. At this
time there doesn't seem to be a place where any of them are spawned so you
will have to drive around until you find one being ridden and take it.

Your standard vehicle, the Buffalo, is a good choice but you can easily mess
up the front alignment which will make the car useless. It is recommended to
mod the vehicle with the most current engine, brake, and suspension upgrades
if you went and did Hidden Package collecting earlier. If you wish to use a
bike then I also recommend modding it before doing any Jumps.

Modding the vehicles beforehand will make them faster, allow you to stop
sooner, and give them better durability even at this early stage of the game.

The information under the type of ramp is broken down as follows:

  ++Neighborhood: What neighborhood the Jump is found.
  ++Map: Map co-ordinates on the printed map that comes included with the 
         game disc.
  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ++Directions: How to get there and find the Jump.
  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ++Vehicle: Best vehicle for the Jump. All vehicles listed have been 
             modified (with one exception).
  ++Heading: Direction of the Jump.
  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ++Notes: Information on the Jump.

[BLC-J1] - A rock ramp near Raton Pass
           ***************************
             Neighborhood: Raton Canyon.
             Map: (C-3).
             ----------------------------------------------------------------
             Directions: Go to the Califia Bridge in Alamo Sea. From here, 
                         head south on Califia Road. After some distance you 
                         will come to a Y-shaped intersection with Raton 
                         Pass. Go onto Raton Pass and up the mountain side.

                         Eventually you'll stop climbing and level out. The 
                         moment you start going down, stop. Ahead of you, 
                         past the next curve, you should see a a solid rock 
                         ramp which is the Jump.
             ----------------------------------------------------------------
             Vehicle: Bati 800, Dinka Double-T.
             Heading: Southeast to Northwest.
             ----------------------------------------------------------------
             Notes: Go back near the top of the road to start your run. You 
                    need to jump the gap to be successful. You don't actually 
                    have to land on the road - you can land before it.

[BLC-J2] - A broken bridge
           ***************
             Neighborhood: Paleto Bay.
             Map: (B-4).
             ----------------------------------------------------------------
             Directions: The Jump is the broken bridge in the middle of 
                         Procopio Promenade.
             ----------------------------------------------------------------
             Vehicle: Bati 800, Dinka Double-T, or Buffalo.
             Heading: Southwest to Northeast.
             ----------------------------------------------------------------
             Notes: This can pretty much be done with any vehicle but a 
                    motorcycle is recommended. Go at a moderate speed and you 
                    can make this easy.

[BLC-J3] - A dirt ramp within a construction site
           **************************************
             Neighborhood: Paleto Bay.
             Map: (B-4).
             ----------------------------------------------------------------
             Directions: Go to the intersection of Procopio Drive and Great 
                         Ocean Highway. At the west corner of this 
                         intersection is a construction site. The entrance 
                         can be found about sixty feet fron the intersection. 

                         Next to the entrance is a bunch of pipes. The dirt 
                         ramp for the Jump is across the site southwest of 
                         them.
             ----------------------------------------------------------------
             Vehicle: Bati 800, Dinka Double-T.
             Heading: Northeast to Southwest.
             ----------------------------------------------------------------
             Notes: Start from the pipes and make the jump into the alley 
                    outside of the site. You don't need to go real fast and 
                    the short distance from the ramp to the pipes keeps you 
                    from going real fast anyway.

                    There is a short wall within the alley and you may find 
                    yourself landing just before it. Brake as you are in the 
                    air to keep you from hitting it. All in all another easy 
                    Jump.

[BLC-J4] - A rock ramp along North Calafia Way
           ***********************************
             Neighborhood: Alamo Sea.
             Map: (C-4).
             ----------------------------------------------------------------
             Directions: Go to the Calafia Bridge in northwest Alamo Sea. 
                         From here, head northeast along North Calafia Way. 
                         The ramp is about a half mile from the bridge. You 
                         will get to a curve that has large concrete barriers 
                         on both sides of the road. The ramp for the Jump is 
                         on the east end of the curve.
             ----------------------------------------------------------------
             Vehicle: Bati 800, Dinka Double-T.
             Heading: East to West.
             ----------------------------------------------------------------
             Notes: You have plenty of road to the east to make a good run. 
                    Try to aim between the trees that are at the other side 
                    of the gap you need to jump. You may risk colliding with 
                    one of them if you don't.

[BLC-J5] - A dirt ramp
           ***********
             Neighborhood: Grand Senora Desert.
             Map: (D-5).
             ----------------------------------------------------------------
             Directions: Go to the intersection of Smoke Tree Road and 
                         Panorama Drive. At the west side of this 
                         intersection is an unpaved road that runs parallel 
                         to Sandy Shores Airfield which is northwest of this 
                         intersection.

                         Head west on this road and you will come to a 
                         three-way intersection with another dirt road. It 
                         should also have a sign that says "Private Road No 
                         Access". The ramp for the Jump is at the north side 
                         of this intersection.
             ----------------------------------------------------------------
             Vehicle: Bati 800, Dinka Double-T.
             Heading: South to North.
             ----------------------------------------------------------------
             Notes: Go south up this road to the small building. This is 
                    where you should start your run. The goal is to clear the 
                    group of large white boulders then land on the Airstrip. 
                    A fairly easy Jump.

[BLC-J6] - At the ruined Sandy Shores Motel
           ********************************
             Neighborhood: Sandy Shores.
             Map: (D-5).
             ----------------------------------------------------------------
             Directions: Go to the intersection of Zancudo Drive and Panorama 
                         Drive. At the west side of this intersection is the 
                         ruined Motel. Also here at this intersection is the 
                         ramp for the Jump.
             ----------------------------------------------------------------
             Vehicle: Bati 800, Dinka Double-T.
             Heading: East to West.
             ----------------------------------------------------------------
             Notes: You need to jump over the Motel without touching the roof 
                    and land in or near the empty pool. Go to Sandy Shores 
                    Medical Center to begin your run and push up on the Right 
                    Analog Stick to gain extra speed for the Jump.

[BLC-J7] - At the El Gordo Lighthouse
           **************************
             Neighborhood: Mount Gordo.
             Map: (C-6).
             ----------------------------------------------------------------
             Directions: Go to the intersection of El Gordo Drive and 
                         Grapeseed Avenue. From here, head north along El 
                         Gordo Drive and follow the road to the Lighthouse. 
                         You should see a carpark at the end of this road 
                         along with some small construction barriers nearby. 
                         Just behind the barriers is the ramp for the Jump.
             ----------------------------------------------------------------
             Vehicle: Mid-range to high end car or Buffalo.
             Heading: West to East.
             ----------------------------------------------------------------
             Notes: You have to jump to the small island where the Lighthouse 
                    is. This is one of the trickier Jumps. You have to land 
                    to the right of the Lighthouse in order to successfully 
                    complete the Jump.

                    The small construction barriers is why you have to use a 
                    car. If you use a motorcycle then you will smash into one 
                    of them which will slow you more than enough to keep you 
                    from successfully completing the Jump. You can use the 
                    van to clear them but they will instantly regenerate if 
                    you move back far enough to try the Jump.

                    Since you will be landing on an island you will 
                    automatically lose any vehicle you use so use a car you 
                    do not wish to keep. You can use your Buffalo if you want 
                    but you will have to go back to your Safehouse to get 
                    another one.

                    You can still make the Jump even if the car ends up in 
                    the water as long as you hit the landing zone with all 
                    four wheels first.
