[LCY-J8] - A dirt ramp along Baytree Canyon Road
           *************************************
             Neighborhood: Grand Senora Desert.
             Map: (E-4).
             ----------------------------------------------------------------
             Directions: Go to the intersection of Baytree Canyon Road and 
                         Mt. Haan Road. From here, head north on Baytree 
                         Canyon Road. After a short distance you should see a 
                         wooden retaining wall which should be to your left. 
                         The ramp for the Jump is at the top of this wall.
             ----------------------------------------------------------------
             Vehicle: Bati 800, Dinka Double-T.
             Heading: Southwest to Northeast.
             ----------------------------------------------------------------
             Notes: Go up the hillside to make your run. The goal is to jump 
                    over the wall and land in the ditch on the other side. A 
                    pretty easy Jump.

[LCY-J9] - A rock ramp south of Bolingbroke Penitentiary
           *********************************************
             Neighborhood: Grand Senora Desert.
             Map: (E-5).
             ----------------------------------------------------------------
             Directions: There is a tall rock embankment that you have to use 
                         to jump into the facility. It can be found between 
                         two guard towers at the south side of the Prison.
             ----------------------------------------------------------------
             Vehicle: Buffalo.
             Heading: South to North.
             ----------------------------------------------------------------
             Notes: You have to clear both fences and land in the area just 
                    before the first cell block. You must land with all four 
                    wheels. If you hit the cell block building before all 
                    four wheels touch the ground then the Jump is failed.

                    After completing the Jump you will get an automatic 
                    2-Star Wanted Rating for entering the Prison. You have to 
                    go clockwise around the central area to get to the gate 
                    leading out. After leaving the Prison then head southwest 
                    off road to lose the Cops.
                    It is *NOT* recommended to use a motorcycle for this 
                    Jump. Even if you successfully make it the cheap ass Cops 
                    will kill you before you can get out of the facility 
                    because you are not protected like you would if you were 
                    in a car.

[LCY-J10] - A rock ramp alongside Senora Freeway
            ************************************
              Neighborhood: Grand Senora Desert.
              Map: (E-5).
              ---------------------------------------------------------------
              Directions: Go to the intersection of Route 68 and Senora 
                          Freeway. From here, head south on Senora Freeway. 
                          Just after you pass Bolingbroke Penitentiary the 
                          freeway will start to split into two roads.

                          Keep in the southbound lane and look at the railing 
                          to your left. At some point there will be a gap in 
                          the railing. Just beyond the gap is the ramp for 
                          the Jump.
             ----------------------------------------------------------------
             Vehicle: Bati 800, Dinka Double-T.
             Heading: Northwest to Southeast.
             ----------------------------------------------------------------
             Notes: Go through this gap and hit the ramp to start the Jump. 
                    You need to land under or just before the underpass ahead 
                    to successfully complete the Jump.

[LCY-J11] - A dirt ramp by a stopped windmill
            *********************************
              Neighborhood: Ron Alternatives Wind Farm.
              Map: (E-5).
              ---------------------------------------------------------------
              Directions: Go to the south entrance of the Wind Farm which is 
                          near the entrance to Palmer-Taylor Power Station. 
                          Go through the nearby facility and onto the road 
                          that goes up into the Farm. After a long drive you 
                          should get to a fork in the road.

                          Take the left path and, after a short distance, you 
                          should come to a three-way intersection. Turn left 
                          and you should see a substation to your right. 
                          Continue forward through the next three-way 
                          intersection and you should come to another road 
                          fork.

                          Take the right path and it should lead you to a 
                          stopped windmill. The ramp for the Jump is just to 
                          the west of this windmill.
              ---------------------------------------------------------------
              Vehicle: Bati 800, Dinka Double-T.
              Heading: Southeast to Northwest.
              ---------------------------------------------------------------
              Notes: Get a good distance for your run and push up on the Left 
                     Analog Stick to get some extra speed. You need to clear 
                     the railroad tracks and land either on or just before 
                     the Freeway to get credit for the Jump.

[LSO-J12] - A stair-like ramp within a parking garage
            *****************************************
              Neighborhood: Pacific Bluffs.
              Map: (A-3).
              ---------------------------------------------------------------
              Directions: Go to the intersection of Playa Vista and W. 
                          Eclipse Blvd. From here, head north on Playa Vista. 
                          When you get to the road curve you should see a 
                          parking garage for The Jetty apartment complex. 

                          Enter the garage and you will find several small 
                          road barriers. The ramp for the Jump is the 
                          stair-like structure just beyond them.
              ---------------------------------------------------------------
              Vehicle: Bati 800, Dinka Double-T.
              Heading: Southeast to Northwest.
              ---------------------------------------------------------------
              Notes: Go back near the intersection with W. Eclipse Blvd. to 
                     start your run. You need to land on the driveway below 
                     to successfully complete the Jump.

[LSO-J13] - A metal ramp at a construction site
            ***********************************
              Neighborhood: Richman.
              ---------------------------------------------------------------
              Directions: Go to the intersection of North Sheldon Ave. and 
                          Ace Jones Dr. From here, head south on North 
                          Sheldon Ave. When you get to the road curve you 
                          should see some small road barriers on the outside 
                          part.

                          This starts a small road that leads into a 
                          construction site. The ramp for the Jump is at the 
                          south end of this small road.
              ---------------------------------------------------------------
              Vehicle: Bati 800, Dinka Double-T.
              Heading: North to South.
              ---------------------------------------------------------------
              Notes: This is a tricky Jump to complete. You need to start 
                     your run near the intersection with Ace Jones Dr. then 
                     maneuver into the site while gaining speed.

                     You need hit the ramp straight on and land on Picture 
                     Perfect Drive near or on the major intersection to 
                     succeed. Not doing this right may result in hitting 
                     trees or concrete walls on the way down.

[LSO-J14] - A broken pedestrian bridge at a golf course
            *******************************************
              Neighborhood: GWC and Golfing Society.
              Map: (A-3).
              ---------------------------------------------------------------
              Directions: Go to the Los Santos Golf Club and to the lake at 
                          the southeast corner of the course where you can 
                          find a broken pedestrian bridge which is the Jump.
              ---------------------------------------------------------------
              Vehicle: Golf Cart.
              Heading: West to East.
              ---------------------------------------------------------------
              Notes: Even though you can make a jump going from east to west 
                     the Jump actually goes one way.

                     Although you can use a motorcycle the best vehicle for 
                     this is a Golf Cart which can be found at the north end 
                     of the Clubhouse. Get a topless one since you can't hit 
                     the archway at the other end of the Jump.

                     It should be noted that you will get a 2-Star Wanted 
                     Rating for being on the course at this stage of the game 
                     so you may also need to dodge Police. Try to lure them 
                     into the lake if you can so they don't interfere.

                     If you lose the Wanted Rating while on the course then 
                     they will no longer become a problem and you can do the 
                     Jump as many times as you need to without interference.

[LSO-J15] - At the top of a tunnel
            **********************
              Neighborhood: Del Perro.
              Map: (B-4).
              ---------------------------------------------------------------
              Directions: Go to the intersection of Equality Way and Bay City 
                          Avenue. From here, head southwest on Equality Way. 
                          After making the road curve and going under the 
                          bridge you should see some orange road markers on 
                          the left side of the road.

                          Go through the markers and onto the dirt. Keep 
                          going forward and you should reach the edge of the 
                          Del Perro Fwy. tunnel below. The edge of the tunnel 
                          is the ramp for the Jump.
              ---------------------------------------------------------------
              Vehicle: Bati 800, Dinka Double-T.
              Heading: Southeast to Northwest.
              ---------------------------------------------------------------
              Notes: Jump onto any of the roads below without hitting any 
                     cars to successfully complete the Jump. A pretty easy 
                     Jump.

[LSO-J16] - A ramp for a parking garage
            ***************************
              Neighborhood: Rockford Hills.
              Map: (C-3).
              ---------------------------------------------------------------
              Directions: Go to the intersection of Hawick Avenue and 
                          Rockford Dr. At the southwest corner of this 
                          intersection is a small parking garage for the 
                          nearby subway station. The ramp going onto the top 
                          of this building is the Jump.
              ---------------------------------------------------------------
              Vehicle: Bati 800, Dinka Double-T.
              Heading: East to West.
              ---------------------------------------------------------------
              Notes: Start your run east of here on Hawick Avenue and 
                     maneuver your way to the Jump. You need to get a high 
                     speed because you need to completely jump over the area 
                     and the signage to successfully complete the Jump.

                     It should be noted that you run the risk of smacking 
                     into something when you land at the station and 
                     seriously hurt yourself so try to hit the ramp at a 
                     slightly right angle to avoid the subway entrance.

            ********
              Neighborhood: Little Seoul.
              Map: (B-4).
              ---------------------------------------------------------------

              Notes: Go to the intersection with Ginger Street to begin your

[LSO-J18] - A metal ramp near some Korean shops
            ***********************************
              Neighborhood: Little Seoul.
              Map: (C-4).

                          that rings the Korean shopping center.

                          Head directly west from here and you should see a

                          ramp for the Jump.
              ---------------------------------------------------------------
              Vehicle: Buffalo.
              Heading: East to West.
              ---------------------------------------------------------------
              Notes: Go back to Adam's Apple Blvd. to begin your run. You

[LSO-J19] - Near a major highway intersection
            *********************************
              Neighborhood: Little Seoul.
              Map: (C-3).
              ---------------------------------------------------------------
              Directions: Go to the intersection of Calais Ave. and San 
                          Andreas Ave. From here, head east on San Andreas 
                          Ave. Just before you get to the bridge for La 
                          Puerta Freeway turn left onto the un-named road 
                          that runs alongside the bridge.

                          When the road turns left continue straight and you 
                          should see a ramp right at the edge of Del Perro 
                          Freeway which is the Jump.
              ---------------------------------------------------------------
              Vehicle: Buffalo.
              Heading: South to North.
              ---------------------------------------------------------------
              Notes: Start at the building at the south side of San Andreas 
                     Ave. and you need to clear Del Perro Freeway without 
                     hitting any cars to successfully complete the Jump.

                     This may be a little tricky due the high volume of 
                     vehicles on the road so the faster you can go, the 
                     higher you can get above the traffic and the less likely 
                     you will hit them.

[LSO-J24] - At the top of a parking garage
            ******************************
              Neighborhood: Pillbox Hill.
              Map: (C-4).
              ---------------------------------------------------------------
              Directions: Go to the intersection of Las Lagunas Blvd. and San 
                          Andreas Ave. At the southwest corner of this

              Vehicle: Bati 800, Dinka Double-T.

            /=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=\
 /=========================================================================\
| >GHF10. Shooting Range                                                    |
 \=========================================================================/
            \=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=/

The next activity that contributes to 100% Completion is the Shooting Range.
The Range can only be found at two Ammu-Nations: Pillbox Hill and Cypress
Flats. To enter the Range it will cost you fourteen dollars.

There are a total of eighteen different Challenges divided into six weapon
classes. You must get at least a Bronze Medal to pass a Challenge. Passing
all three Challenges in a weapon class will count as one activity in the
Hobbies and Pastimes category (for a total of six).

When you select a weapon class only the first Challenge is open. Challenge 2
opens up when you get at least a Bronze in the first one and the third will
open up when you get at least a Bronze in the second.

Earning a Bronze Medal in all Challenges will give you a 10% discount at all
Ammu-Nations. All Silver will get you 15% and all Gold will get you 25%.
Acquiring one Gold Medal in any Challenge will add towards the
{Multi-Disciplined} Accomplishment.

When you start the Range you will be given a brief tutorial. Some rounds are
based on a set number of Targets destroyed within a time limit. When the
Targets are destroyed or time runs out then the round will end. If you
destroy the targets before time runs out then whatever time you have left
will be converted into a bonus.

Other rounds are based on destroying as many Targets within a time limit and
scoring as many hits as you can. The Targets are zoned based on color and go
from ten points up to 100.

There is also a combo bar and a multiplier. If you string together
consecutive hits then your combo bar will fill and your multiplier will
increase. The maximum multiplier is 3x. If you miss then the multiplier is
reset. However, automatic weapons give one free miss before resetting.

You can use any weapon in a class even if it is not available in the wild or
at any Ammu-Nation. Any weapon mods you buy can be used at the Range. Having
the Extended Clips for your weapons can be very helpful, as this will reduce
the need for reloading which is time consuming, but it is not absolutely
necessary for the Range.

In most cases you will either need to buy the weapon, find the weapon in the
wild, pass a Challenge, or earn a Gold Medal in one before being allowed to
use some of the more powerful guns. Before doing the Shooting Range you
should go out and find the following weapons in the wild to make things
easier:

  --SMG
  --Assault Rifle
  --Pump Shotgun
  --Sawed-Off Shotgun
  --Assault Shotgun
  --MG

As noted earlier this is the best and safest way to quickly maximize your
Shooting Skill which is the reason why you should do this as soon as a
character becomes available. It is important to note that each character has
his own set of scores and Medals - whatever you do with Franklin doesn't
carry over to Michael or Trevor. Each character must earn their own Medals.

0===========================================================================0
|+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++[ Hand Guns ]+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++|
0===========================================================================0
| --Pistol: Open from start.                                                |
| --Combat Pistol: Buy the weapon or pass Hand Gun Challenge 2.             |
| --AP Pistol: Buy the weapon or earn a Gold Medal in any Hand Gun          |
|              Challenge.                                                   |
|---------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Hitting Targets without missing increases your score multiplier up to     |
| three times. Missing a Target resets this.                                |
|---------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| ++Challenge 1         | There are multiple static Targets that exit the   |
|   ===========         | range after one hit. There are a total of fifteen |
|     --Bronze: 1,400   | Targets that must be destroyed within forty       |
|     --Silver: 2,000   | seconds. This Challenge is easy to pass and easy  |
|     --Gold: 2,800     | to Gold in. Take your time, zoom in on the        |
|                       | Target, and aim at the center.                    |
|-----------------------+---------------------------------------------------|
| ++Challenge 2         | There are multiple moving Targets that leave the  |
|   ===========         | Range automatically. This is easy to pass with    |
|     --Bronze: 2,000   | the regular Pistol but you will need the AP       |
|     --Silver: 10,000  | Pistol to get the Gold. It will take a few tries  |
|     --Gold: 20,000    | to get Gold as you learn where the Targets appear |
|                       | and move.                                         |
|                       |                                                   |
|                       | When you learn where the Targets appear then move |
|                       | sideways, using the Left Analog Stick, to line    |
|                       | yourself up with it. This will make it easier to  |
|                       | quickly aim at the center and maximize your       |
|                       | score. Move sideways to your next Target while    |
|                       | reloading.                                        |
|-----------------------+---------------------------------------------------|
| ++Challenge 3         | There is one moving Target that goes one way      |
|   ===========         | (starting on the right side of the Range), turn   |
|     --Bronze: 650     | around and stop for a few seconds, then turn      |
|     --Silver: 3,000   | around and proceed to the other side. This        |
|     --Gold: 15,000    | pattern will continue until time runs out.        |
|                       |                                                   |
|                       | This is easy enough to pass but to get Gold you   |
|                       | need to use the AP Pistol and move sideways along |
|                       | with the Target. The nice thing is that you will  |
|                       | run out of ammo and automatically reload before   |
|                       | it reaches the end of a run.                      |
|                       |                                                   |
|                       | By the time it turns around again then you should |
|                       | be fully reloaded for another run to the other    |
|                       | side.                                             |
0===========================================================================0
|++++++++++++++++++++++++++++[ Submachine Guns ]++++++++++++++++++++++++++++|
0===========================================================================0
| --Micro SMG: Buy / find either the Micro SMG or SMG or pass Hand Gun      |
|              Challenge 1.                                                 |
| --SMG: Buy / find or pass Micro SMG Challenge 2.                          |
|---------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Hitting Targets increases your score multipler up to three times. You get |
| one free miss with automatic weapons.                                     |
|---------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| ++Challenge 1         | There will be five static Targets with their      |
|   ===========         | backs to you. One Target at a time will turn      |
|     --Bronze: 4,000   | around for a short time so you can shoot it then  |
|     --Silver: 6,000   | it will turn back around. You have thirty seconds |
|     --Gold: 12,000    | to score as many points as possible.              |
|                       |                                                   |
|                       | To get Gold you should use the SMG. Learn when    |
|                       | and where the Targets turn around so you know     |
|                       | where to aim to get the most points. You should   |
|                       | also know when to stop shooting so you don't risk |
|                       | shooting the back of a Target and lose your       |
|                       | multiplier.                                       |
|                       |                                                   |
|                       | At a couple of points during the Challenge there  |
|                       | will be a long pause. Use this to reload your SMG |
|                       | so you don't run out of ammo while shooting at a  |
|                       | Target.                                           |
|-----------------------+---------------------------------------------------|
| ++Challenge 2         | There will be four Targets, one behind the other, |
|   ===========         | that will move in a staggered pattern and turn    |
|     --Bronze: 1,250   | around and stop at one side of the Range then,    |
|     --Silver: 2,500   | after a few seconds, turn around and proceed to   |
|     --Gold: 7,500     | the other side.                                   |
|                       |                                                   |
|                       | The Targets will start in the center and you have |
|                       | twenty six seconds to score as many points as     |
|                       | possible.                                         |
|                       |                                                   |
|                       | To get Gold you should use the SMG. This          |
|                       | Challenge is similar to Hand Gun Challenge 3. To  |
|                       | get the most points you need to move sideways     |
|                       | with the Targets. But focus only on the closest   |
|                       | one - ignore those behind it. Use the long pauses |
|                       | to reload your SMG.                               |
|-----------------------+---------------------------------------------------|
| ++Challenge 3         | There will be a combination of static and moving  |
|   ===========         | Targets of varying heights that will disappear    |
|     --Bronze: 3,000   | automatically. You have thirty three seconds to   |
|     --Silver: 5,000   | score as many points as possible.                 |
|     --Gold: 10,000    |                                                   |
|                       | To get Gold you should use the SMG. It will take  |
|                       | a few tries as you get the hang of where each     |
|                       | Target appears so you can move around to put      |
|                       | yourself in position to score maximum points and  |
|                       | to know when to stop shooting so you don't lose   |
|                       | your multiplier.                                  |

|++++++++++++++++++++++++++++[ Assault Rifles ]+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++|
0===========================================================================0
| --Assault Rifle: Buy / find the Assault Rifle or pass Submachine Gun      |
|                  Challenge 1.                                             |
| --Carbine Rifle: Open from start.                                         |
| --Advanced Rifle: Buy the weapon or earn a Gold Medal in any Assault      |
|                   Rifle Challenge.                                        |
|---------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Hitting Targets increases your score multipler up to three times. You get |

| ++Challenge 1         | You will be presented with static Targets and     |
|   ===========         | they will only disappear after you hit it three   |
|     --Bronze: 2,500   | times. You have a total of seventeen Targets and  |
|     --Silver: 3,550   | you need to score as many points as possible in   |

|                       | The keys for this Challenge is to know when to    |

|                       | If you're good with moving with your Targets then |
|                       | this should be easy to both pass and get Gold in. |
|-----------------------+---------------------------------------------------|

|                       | Gold as you learn the patterns of the Targets.    |

            /=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=\
 /=========================================================================\
| >GHF11. Other 100% Completion Activities                                  |
 \=========================================================================/
            \=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=/

Before going onto the Main Story there are several smaller activities that
are required for 100% Completion:

0===============0
| Robbing Stores \
0=========================================================>

  Although there is an Accomplishment for robbing Stores in Online Mode you 
  do need to rob one Store for 100% Completion. Go into a Store, bring out a 
  weapon, aim at the guy behind the counter, and wait for him to throw the 
  money over. Then grab the small amount of cash and get rid of the 2-Star 
  Wanted Rating you generate.

0============0
| Prostitutes \
0=========================================================>

  In previous GTA installments you could use Prostitutes to regain health and 
  it was optional to do so. However, in GTA V, this becomes a 100% Completion 
  requirement. They appear at night, stand by certain street corners, and 
  wear trashy looking clothes.

  When you get her into your car then you need to take her someplace secluded 
  so you can do business. She can be a bit picky on where you can do things 
  but I found the second or third level of a parking garage to be a good 
  choice. You have three levels of service to choose from and I recommend 
  getting the most expensive one just to be safe.

0================================0
| Private Dancing and Booty Calls \
0=========================================================>

  Another 100% Completion activity is to get a Private Dance at a strip club. 
  The only one available at this stage of the game is the Vanilla Unicorn 
  which is near your Safehouse. Doing a Booty Call is another Completion 
  percentage activity and you can get one at the Vanilla Unicorn as well.

  You can get a Booty Call from some but not all of the strippers there. 
  According to gta.wikia.com they are:

    --Sapphire
    --Juliet
    --Nikki
    --Infernus

  There are also a couple of other people you can get Booty Calls from but 
  they occur later in the game.

  The strippers can be found roaming the floor and dancing on the stage. 
  Unfortunately, they don't give out their names when you walk past one. And 
  you won't know who they are unless you take one for a Private Dance. 
  Another way to find out a stripper's name is to get close to the one that 
  is dancing. Her name is part of her Like Meter.

  "Make it rain" to start filling up her meter. It should be noted that how 
  much she likes you initially will depend on what character you use. For 
  instance, she will like Franklin more than Trevor which means that Franklin 
  can spend less money to fill up the Like Meter and Trevor needs to spend 
  more.

  After awhile her set will finish and she will return to the main floor 
  where you can get her for a Private Dance. You will be given controls to 
  compliment and to touch her. Before touching her you need to wait for the 
  guard to leave first or you will be thrown out. Compliment and touch her as 
  much as you can to fill up her Like Meter.

  While doing one dance should be enough for Completion percentage it will 
  take more than one to completely fill out her meter unless you "made it 
  rain" a lot while she was dancing on stage. When you fill it up then you 
  can get the option to do a Booty Call.

  Pick her up behind the club and take her home to do the Call and add to 
  your Completion percentage. You will also get her name added to your 
  Contact list.

0================0
| Watching Movies \
0=========================================================>

  The last 100% Completion activity of this group is watching a movie at any 
  of the Movie Theaters on the map. At this stage there are only two movies 
  you can watch, an animated film and a pretentious art film. Any one of them 
  will work.

With that done, it is time to finally move onto.....

  /==++====++==\                                             /==++====++==\
 /==++====++====++====++====++====<<##0##>>====++====++====++====++====++==\
| >SND3. The Main Story Missions                                            |
 \==++====++====++====++====++====<<##0##>>====++====++====++====++====++==/
  \==++====++==/                                             \==++====++==/

Each Mission is broken into several sections:

0=========0
| Overview \
0=======================>

  What the mission is about.

0========0
| Weapons \
0=======================>

  Weapons used on the mission. Each weapon listed should have a lot of ammo 
  for it before doing the mission attempt. If there are no weapons used then 
  this section won't be displayed.

0======0
| Notes \
0=======================>

  Additional information and other musings. This also includes any prep work 
  suggestions prior to doing the mission. If there are no notes then this 
  section won't be displayed.

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  How to do the mission.

0===========0
| 100% Score \
0=======================>

  What the Requirements are and the strategies necessary to get a 100% Score. 
  I will include additional notes if necessary.

0=======0
| Reward \
0=======================>

  What you get for your efforts. However, most missions won't reward you with 
  anything so I will only list it if you are rewarded with something.

With that explained, I will now finally move on to the story starting
with.....

  0==================================0
 / The Main Story \+++++++++++++++++++\
0==========================================================================\
| >MSY2. Simeon Yetarian                                                    +
0==========================================================================/

Simeon runs a semi-reputable car dealership that both Franklin and Lamar work
for. Simeon doesn't pay them much but it is a steady job at least. Go over to
the dealership for the next mission.....

  0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0
 / Simeon Yetarian \
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+\
| >SMN1. Repossession                                                       0
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+/
| Overview /                                            \ Simeon Yetarian /
0=========0                                              0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0

  Simeon names Franklin employee of the month which upsets both him and 
  Lamar. But Simeon needs them to go and repossess another vehicle.....

0========0
| Weapons \
0=======================>

  --SMG.
  --Assault or Carbine Rifle.

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  Go to Vespucci Beach. When you get there then follow Lamar. Climb the fence 
  and head to the end of the street. When you get to the end of the street 
  then start looking through the three garages. One of them on the left will 
  have some Body Armor.

  Choose the garage on the right and you will find that the bike isn't there. 
  You will also be ambushed by the Vagos and this starts a fight between you 
  and them. The game will instruct you on how to use the weapon wheel and 
  cover. Take your time and go for headshots.

  As you near the gate the bike owner will drive off with the vehicle and you 
  must chase him. Even though the game tells you to shoot him off you can 
  just knock him off and run him over. When you take the bike then head to 
  the Car Wash near your home. When you get there then Franklin and Lamar get 
  into a heated exchange and the mission will end successfully.

0===========0
| 100% Score \
0=======================>

  >>Time (6:30)
    ***********
      Use Stunt Jump [LSO-J18] as a nice little shortcut to get to Vespucci 
      Beach quickly. Blow up the large propane tank and car to speed things 
      along.

  >>Trail Blazer
    ************
      You need to shoot the gasoline trail. The game will instruct you to do 
      this during the course of the mission so it is almost automatic.

  >>Headshots (6)
    *************

  >>Accuracy (70%)
    **************
      Run over the bike owner to save ammo and maintain accuracy.

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

  At this point the Pump Shotgun will now be available at all Ammu-Nations.

            /=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=\
 /=========================================================================\
| >GHF12. Strangers and Freaks                                              |
 \=========================================================================/
            \=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=/

At this point in the game you will get a message about the Strangers and
Freaks. They are additional missions involving people not connected to the
Main Story. Some know the character you are currently using, others are
random. Each character has their own set of Strangers. There are twenty of
these Stranger encounters that must be done for 100% Completion.

Only Franklin's encounters count towards completion percentage. The ones for
Michael and Trevor do *NOT* count for 100% Completion. You don't have to do
them but they usually have easy Gold Medal requirements that can be useful
towards the {Solid Gold, Baby!} Accomplishment.

Each Stranger encounter will appear as a "?" and the first one will appear
across the street from your Safehouse. However, there is something else that
has been opened up and I will do that first before proceeding.....

            /=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=\
 /=========================================================================\
| >GHF13. Letter Scraps                                                     |
 \=========================================================================/
            \=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=/

If you listen to the radio you may hear a radio report about the unsolved
murder of actress Leonora Johnson and the rumor of a torn up confession
letter. There is also a website dedicated to the murder along with a list of
possible suspects.

The case of Leonora Johnson is the game's version of the infamous Black Dalia
murder that occurred in the forties. It is probably Los Angeles' most famous
unsolved murder and it has been the focus of many books and even a movie or
two.

At this point you can now look for the Letter Scraps that will piece together
who killed Leonora. There are fifty of these Scraps and can be found all over
the state. When you get close to one you can hear paper rustling. The fastest
way to acquire the Scraps is by the use of a helicopter (although there are
some that can't be collected that way).

Collecting all fifty Scraps is required for 100% Completion. This will also
open up a Stranger mission where you can confront her killer and acquire an
Accomplishment.

0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0
| A. Blaine County |~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~\
0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0

[BLC-LS1] - Location: In the marshes of Lago Zancudo.
            Neighborhood: Lago Zancudo.
            Map: (E-2).
            Directions: Go into the road tunnel that sits under Fort Zancudo. 
                        From here, head north and out of the tunnel. After 
                        some distance you should get to the intersection for 
                        the road that goes to the north entrance of the Fort. 
                        But it also intersects with a dirt road that goes 
                        around the west end of the military complex.

                        Go onto this dirt road, go around the end of the 
                        fort, and under the freeway bridge. After going under 
                        the bridge you should see a concrete drainage opening 
                        on the right side of the road after a short distance.

                        However, continue going forward past this one and 
                        look for a second one. When you find it then go past 
                        it to find a small group of bushes about sixty feet 
                        ahead. Stop at these bushes. Go to the east side of 
                        these bushes and go straight south towards the main 
                        river.

                        When you get to the clearing just before the water 
                        then stop and look around to find the Scrap nearby.

[BLC-LS2] - Location: Under a bridge.
            Neighborhood: Zancudo River.
            Map: (D-3).
            Directions: Go to the Zancudo River Ammu-Nation along Route 68. 
                        From here, head east. After some distance you should 
                        find a short bridge that goes over a dry creek bed. 
                        The Scrap can be found under this bridge.

[BLC-LS3] - Location: On top of a rocky cliff.
            Neighborhood: Raton Canyon.
            Map: (C-3).
            Directions: Go to the bridge on Great Ocean Highway that crosses 
                        over Cassidy Creek. Under the south end of the bridge 
                        is a dirt road that heads east into Raton Canyon. 
                        Head south from the end of the bridge to get to the 
                        road. From the intersection with the freeway you need 
                        to go exactly a half mile.

                        When you get to an intersection with a smaller dirt 
                        road that runs alongside Cassidy Creek continue along 
                        your current road. You will eventually drive over a 
                        drainage pipe.

                        After a short distance you should find a large rock 
                        hill with some trees on the left side of the road. 
                        Carefully climb it then go to the north side to find 
                        the Scrap.

[BLC-LS4] - Location: By an antenna near the Cult Compound.
            Neighborhood: Chiliad Mountain State Wilderness.
            Map: (C-3).
            Directions: On the Great Ocean Highway, at the west side of the 
                        map, there is a bridge that goes over Cassidy Creek. 
                        Starting from the north end of this bridge, head 
                        north on the highway. After some distance you should 
                        see several vehicles parked on the right side of the 
                        road.

                        This is also the beginning of a dirt road that 
                        proceeds into the hills. Go along this road and, when 
                        you get to the intersection of two major roads, turn 
                        left. At this point you will head upwards. As you 
                        near the next intersection you should see a water 
                        tank to your left.

                        When you get to the intersection then angle right. As 
                        you proceed along this path you should see the south 
                        wall of the Compound to your left. Continue until you 
                        reach a wooden bridge then stop. Proceed up towards 
                        the antenna mast.

                        Climb up the ladders to reach the antenna where you 
                        should find the Scrap nearby.

[BLC-LS5] - Location: Along a road that leads to the Lumber Yard.
            Neighborhood: Paleto Forest.
            Map: (B-4).
            Directions: From the Cable Car Depot, head southwest on the Great 
                        Ocean Highway. Just as you get onto the Highway you 
                        should see the Lumber Yard on your left. Angle left 
                        towards the lumber sign. Just before you get to the 
                        sign turn left and head east along the dirt path. 
                        Eventually you will get to where the path splits.

                        Take the left path and you should come to an 
                        intersection with a smaller dirt road. Continue 
                        forward from here and stop at another intersection 
                        with a smaller dirt road. At the north corner of this 
                        intersection is a group of three rocks. The Scrap can 
                        be found here.

                        It should be noted that Cougars tend to spawn around 
                        here so arm yourself before going to acquire this 
                        Scrap.

[BLC-LS6] - Location: On the patio of a house.
            Neighborhood: Paleto Bay.
            Map: (B-4).
            Directions: Go to the intersection of Dulouz Ave. and Procopio 
                        Drive. At the west corner of this intersection is a 
                        house with a rooftop patio. The Scrap can be found 
                        here.

[BLC-LS7] - Location: At an abandoned house.
            Neighborhood: Paleto Bay.
            Map: (B-4).
            Directions: Behind Beeker's Garage to the northwest is an 
                        abandoned house. The Scrap can be found in the 
                        partially covered porch by the back door.

[BLC-LS8] - Location: At the cable car station at the top of the mountain.
            Neighborhood: Mount Chiliad.
            Map: (B-4).

[BLC-LS9] - Location: At the restroom of a rest stop.
            Neighborhood: Mount Chiliad.
            Map: (B-5).
            Directions: At the east end of the Procopio Beach area there 
                        should be a small road loop on Great Ocean Highway. 
                        This loop is for a rest stop. The restrooms are at 
                        the east side of this loop and the Scrap can be found 
                        by the door at the north end of this building.

[BLC-LS10] - Location: At a tent inside Dignity Village.
             Neighborhood: Mount Chiliad.
             Map: (B-5).
             Directions: Just southeast of [BLC-LS9], and across the Great 
                         Ocean Highway, is the entrance for this village. Go 
                         through the entrance and turn right. At the 
                         southwest corner of this village is a medium sized 
                         building with a silo.

                         Just to the east of it is a white tent with a 
                         "Social Justice For All" banner. The Scrap can be 
                         found inside this tent (this is also where you can 
                         find some Health).

[BLC-LS11] - Location: On a small peninsula.
             Neighborhood: Mount Chiliad.
             Map: (C-4).
             Directions: Go to the Calafia Bridge at the northwest corner of 
                         the Alamo Sea. From here, head east on North Calafia 
                         Way. After a short distance you should see another 
                         bridge. Park on the left side of the road just 
                         before you get to the bridge.

  don't apply to him.....

0=======================>

  him but it is best to chase him. Use your Pistol or Micro SMG to shoot out

| >GHF14. Random Events                                                     |
 \=========================================================================/
            \=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=/

One of the 100% Completion categories is for Random Events. These are various
situations that appear at random throughout the state. There are a bunch of
them but you only need to do fourteen of them for Completion percentage. Once
you fill up that category then you don't need to do them anymore.

However, some of them do have certain rewards that can be helpful to you,
like Skill increases, large monetary rewards, and even contacts for future
heists. Most of these can be done by all three characters but some can be
only done by one or two.

In some cases you may need to pass time by sleeping in order to make certain
situations appear. This is why you should do the mission "Chop" prior to
doing any of these Events - so you can free up your Safehouse.

These events are broken into three types:

0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0
| A. ATM Robberies |~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~\
0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0

There are many ATM Machines scattered throughout Los Santos and the various
towns to the north. You can use them to view your money and to even attack
those who try to use them.

However, if pass by one, you may encounter a robbery that you did not
initiate. You can chase down the robber, take him down, and take the money
for yourself. But you do have the option of returning the money back to its
rightful owner for a small reward.

You can do more that one but only the first ATM Robbery will count towards
100% Completion - any others you do afterwards will not.

0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0
| B. Security Vans |~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~\
0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0

Another event is the Security Van. When you drive by certain areas you may
find a large blue dot on your map. This signifies a special Securicar. It
will be manned by two guards and you can rob these vehicles for far more cash
than what you can with the regular vans.

Sometimes you can encounter a Van while it is parked and with one of the
guards carrying briefcase containing the money. Confronting the guards will
give you an automatic 2-Star Wanted Rating but you can quickly run over or
shoot the money carrying guard, grab the case, and make a quick exit before
the Police arrive.

Other times the Van will be driving along the road. In this case the money is
inside. Following the Van until it stops is pointless because it never does.
You can shoot up the back of the Van to open the doors and cause the money to
fall out. However, the moment you start firing you will get a Wanted Rating
and it may take many shots to blow open the doors thus Cops may interfere
before you can get the money to fall out.

The best thing to do here is to throw a Sticky Bomb on the doors and blow it
open that way. You won't get a Rating until the doors open and you can
quickly grab the money and run off before too many Cops show up.

You cannot jack the Van but you can take it when the guards leave it. This
may help you when dealing with the Police as you can easily grab the armored
vehicle after you quickly dispatch of the guards.

There are a total of ten of these Vans and you can do them repeatedly.
However, only the first time you do a Van will count towards Completion
percentage. But, unlike with the ATM Robberies, when you find a new Van it
will count for percentage.

A GameFAQs user, elduende05, suggested sleeping for about a week (after doing
a Van) in order to make another one (or the same one) appear. Others have
suggested that it doesn't take as long (about four days minimum) but I found
that sleeping about a week pretty much guarantees you can get a Van to spawn
when you get near any of its locations which are are follows:

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

  >>Van #1
    ******
      Neighborhood: Paleto Bay.
      Map: (B-4) [Main Map].

| C. Encounters |~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~\
0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0

The last kind of Random Event are Encounters. These are little mini-missions
that appear randomly during the course of the game. There are approximately
forty six of these Encounters but not all of them will trigger at the same
point of the game. Some can be triggered now, others can pop up during the
remainder of the game.

You do not have to do them all but there are some you should do as they have
special rewards that can help you. You can get Skill increases, monetary
rewards, and contacts for Heists and Booty Calls.

Just after the mission "Mr. Philips" you can do some of these as Trevor and
be allowed to take people up to a Cult Compound in Blaine County. Some of the
early Encounters do have people you can take up there but should be saved for
later.

You can go from Encounter to Encounter in one run but there are some that
only appear at certain hours of the day or night. In addition, some may not
appear right away even if you pass by its location several times. In this
case you should head to your Safehouse and sleep for a couple of days or
until you reach a specific point of the day to get them to appear.

The names for each of the Encounters comes from the Rockstar Games Social
Club website. GameFAQs user EarlJenson started a topic concerning when these
Encounters appear, eventually writing his own guide about them, and his data
is being presented in this document, along with my own observations. He was
able to determine that eleven of these Encounters appear at this point of the
game.

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

  >>Sport Bike Thief
    ****************
      Neighborhood: Richman, on N. Rockford Drive just north of Richman 
                    Street.
      Map: (A-2) [Detail Map].
      -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      Notes: You should bring a high-end car for this one. A high-end 
             motorcycle is stolen and you need to chase it down. Knock the 
             thief off the bike and return it to its owner.
      -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    ++Reward: Nothing.

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

  >>Snatched
    ********
      Neighborhood: Rockford Hills, on S. Mo Milton Dr.
      Map: (B-2) [Detail Map].
      -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      Notes: You should have the Micro SMG for this one (another 
             recommendation is modifying your vehicle with armor and 
             bulletproof mods).

             A woman is being taken by The Lost and thrown into a van. There 
             are three kidnappers and they pack weapons. Drive up and stop 
             near them. They are invincible as they put her in the van but 
             shoot them with the Micro SMG anyway to get their attention.

             If you do this right they will immediately get out of the van 
             instead of you having to chase them. Quickly kill them with the 
             submachine gun. After that then get the woman out of the van and 
             drive her to Chumash.

             As you drive there more Lost members show up on bikes behind 
             you. Even though they use Sawed-Off Shotguns they are accurate 
             from a distance and may kill you quickly if you don't do 
             anything.

             Stop and use the Micro SMG to get rid of them before they can do 
             a lot of damage. After that then continue to the marker in 
             Chumash to end the encounter.
      -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    ++Reward: Nothing. However, if you wait until later and unlock Trevor, 
              then you have the option to take her to the Cult Compound. I 
              highly recommend taking her up to there for reasons I will 
              explain later in the guide.

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

  >>Robbery 1
    *********
      Neighborhood: Rockford Hills, at the Rockford Hills Barber Shop.
      Map: (C-3) [Detail Map].
      -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      Notes: You will need to enter this place once before being allowed to 
             activate this Encounter.

             When you walk into the Shop you will interrupt a robbery. After 
             the robbers leave then immediately arm yourself with an machine 
             gun. Try to get them before they leave the scene.

             If they drive off then chase them down and shoot them with 
             either your Pistol or Micro SMG. When you kill them both a large 
             duffel bag will drop from the vehicle.
      -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    ++Reward: Nothing if you return the bag but $2,000 if you keep it.

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

  >>Construction Accident
    *********************
      Neighborhood: Little Seoul, near the intersection of Lindsey Circus and 
                    Dutch London St.
      Map: (C-4) [Detail Map].
      -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      Notes: The driver of the truck is trapped and you need to move the 
             pipes out of the way before it explodes. Use the nearby Dozer to 
             push the pipes away from the passenger door. The driver will 
             then exit and the encounter will end successfully.
      -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    ++Reward: Nothing.

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

  >>Bus Tour
    ********
      Neighborhood: Downtown Vinewood, on Vinewood Blvd just west of the 
                    Vinewood Movie Theater.
      Map: (D-3) [Detail Map].
      -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      Notes: Enter the van which will cost you $40. Go through the entire 
             tour to successfully complete.
      -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    ++Reward: Nothing. But this Encounter can be repeated if you want.

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

  >>Escape Paparazzi
    ****************
      Neighborhood: Downtown Vinewood, in an alley south of the Downtown 
                    Vinewood Movie Theater.
      Map: (D-3) [Detail Map].
      -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      Notes: Use a fast car for this one. Go into the alley and take the 
             actress away from the photographers. After you lose them then 
             take her back to her home.
      -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    ++Reward: $750. However, if you wait until later and unlock Trevor, then 
              you have the option to take her to the Cult Compound. If you 
              don't want to take the woman from "Snatched" up to the Compound 
              then I recommend taking the actress there instead.

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

  >>Mugging 2
    *********
      Neighborhood: In an alley in Alta, on Hawick Avenue between Power St. 
                    and Meteor St.
      Map: (D-3) [Detail Map].
      -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      Notes: Quickly drive in from the north and run over the mugger which 
             allows the victim to run off safely.
      -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    ++Reward: Nothing.

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

  >>Mugging 3
    *********
      Neighborhood: Pillbox Hill, on Vespucci Blvd. near Peaceful St.
      Map: (C-4) [Detail Map].
      -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      Notes: A woman will have her purse stolen. Quickly run over the thief 
             to retrieve the purse.
      -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    ++Reward: $200 or $2,000 depending on whether or not you return the purse 
              to the victim. This can sometimes be mistaken for an ATM 
              Robbery.

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

  >>Bike Thief City 2
    *****************
      Neighborhood: East Vinewood, on Bridge St.
      Map: (E-3) [Detail Map].
      -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      Notes: Run over the thief and return the bike to its owner.
      -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    ++Reward: Nothing.

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

  >>Getaway Driver
    **************
      Neighborhood: Strawberry, near the south corner of Strawberry Ave. and 
                    Macdonald Street.
      Map: (D-5) [Detail Map].
      -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      Notes: You should take a four-door car with you. Take the two robbers 
             away and lose the 2-Star Wanted Rating. As you drive away you 
             find that one of the robbers worked in Liberty City. That robber 
             is Packie McReary - who worked with Niko in GTA IV.

             One of the best ways to lose the Rating is the train tunnel loop 
             near the intersection of Carson Ave. and Brouge Ave. There is 
             the incline in the middle of the intersection that goes down 
             into the loop and you can easily lose sight of them down here.

             After you lose the Wanted Rating then take them to Cypress Flats 
             to complete the Encounter.
      -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    ++Reward: $1,000 plus Packie McReary contact for Heists which you will be 
              doing later in the game. Interestingly enough you can take both 
              Packie and his friend to the Cult Compound. But I highly 
              recommend not doing that because Packie is very useful for 
              Heists plus you get some good money from him at this point of 
              the game.

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

  >>Bike Thief City 1
    *****************
      Neighborhood: Rancho, on Little Bighorn Ave. between Carson Ave. and 
                    Macdonald Street.
      Map: (D-5) [Detail Map].
      -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      Notes: Knock thief from the bike and return to its owner.
      -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    ++Reward: Nothing but you will get a message later in the game from 
              somebody named Gary Nicholson who will give you $100,000 in 
              Animal Ark shares.

              This can be used to quickly acquire the {Trading Pure Alpha} 
              Accomplishment. I recommend cashing out the stocks as soon as 
              you get the message as they go down in price over the course of 
              the game.

After doing these it's time to go back to Strawberry.....

 / Franklin Clinton \
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+\
| >FRN1. Chop                                                               0
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+/
| Overview /                                           \ Franklin Clinton /
0=========0                                             0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0

  After avoiding Aunt Denise, Franklin encounters Lamar and his dog, Chop. 
  Lamar wants Franklin to accompany him on a simple walk around the 
  block.....

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  Apparently Lamar wants to do a kidnapping of another gangmember named D. 
  Get into the van and head up to Vinewood. When you get there you then 
  confront D who takes off on a fast bike. However, you have to drive a slow 
  van. Keep up with him and he will eventually wipe out near a bus terminal.

  At this point Chop will be let out of the van and you have to chase D into 
  the train area. You will be instructed on how to quickly change characters 
  and open boxcars. After failing to find D then Chop will run off and do the 
  "wild thing" with another dog. Pull Chop off then resume the search for D.

  After finding D then Chop will chase him a short distance and take him 
  down. After you put D in the van then drive back to Lamar's House. 
  Unfortunately, Lamar uses his cellphone to make the ransom call which 
  upsets Franklin because the call can be easily traced.

  Because of this you need to led D out. After letting him go then drive to 
  the Rec Center. When you drop off Lamar then the mission is completed 
  successfully.

0===========0
| 100% Score \
0=======================>

  >>Not a Scratch
    *************
      You need to do the mission with minimal damage to the van. Because the 
      van is slow you can easily avoid obstacles and this should be easy to 
      get.

  >>Homedog
    *******
      You need to remain within Chop's perspective for ten seconds. Quick 
      switch to Chop and stay in this perspective for awhile. For some laughs 
      let him do the "wild thing" while you're him.

  >>Advanced Reflexes
    *****************
      You need to use Franklin's Special for seven seconds. If you have maxed 
      out his Special then use it when you are prompted to by Lamar and let 
      it run out to easily obtain this Requirement.

            /=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=\
 /=========================================================================\
| >GHF15. 100% Completion Tasks (Part One)                                  |
 \=========================================================================/
            \=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=/

After the mission you'll also get a call from Lamar. He wants you to let Chop
stay at your place for awhile. Franklin agrees. This will bring up a bone
icon at your house where you can play with Chop. It is important to note that
spending a little time to play with him is *REQUIRED* for 100% Completion and
falls into the Miscellaneous category. Play fetch with him for a bit to
complete this requirement.

 / Strangers (Franklin) \
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+\
| >SFK3. Shift Work (Hao)                                                   0
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+/
| Overview /                                       \ Strangers (Franklin) /
0=========0                                         0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0

  Hao is another one of Franklin's friends. He is heavy into the street 
  racing scene and challenges Franklin to a race.....

0======0
| Notes \
0=======================>

  You may want to get a fast car or mod your Buffalo with the most recent 
  mods available.

  According to Callum x360a at www.xboxachievements.com this mission will 
  count towards the {Multi-Disciplined} Accomplishment even if you don't get 
  a Gold Medal during this mission.

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  This mission is only available between 20:00 and 5:00.

  Make your way to the marker near your home. This will begin a two lap 
  checkpoint race with five other cars. The course winds through the 
  Strawberry, Rancho, and Davis areas.

  This is a fairly easy race course-wise and opponent-wise as you can get 
  into first place quickly with the right car. When you get into first place 
  then be conservative around the course so you don't smack into things. The 
  traffic isn't too bad so that helps. If you finish the race in first place 
  then the encounter is completed successfully.

0===========0
| 100% Score \
0=======================>

  >>Fastest Lap
    ***********
      You need to complete a lap in less than 1:20. If you're good with your 
      driving, regardless of car, you can get this easy.

  >>Underdog
    ********
      You need to finish the race in less than 2:50. This is also pretty easy 
      with a good car and good driving.

  >>Clean Race
    **********
      You need to finish the race with less than five collisions. This is 
      probably the hardest to get because of the jousting for position 
      between the other cars and yourself near the beginning of the race. 
      Keep your distance and pass them clean. If you can get into first place 
      without any scrapes you can drive more conservative and avoid other 
      possible collisions.

0=======0
| Reward \
0=======================>

  $200.

            /=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=\
 /=========================================================================\
| >GHF16. Street Races                                                      |
 \=========================================================================/
            \=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=/

In addition to the race you just completed more Street Races will now begin
to appear starting with one in Downtown Vinewood. There are a total of five
races in all and they are required for 100% Completion. They will appear on
your map as a car with a checkered flag. And, like the last race, they are
only available between 20:00 and 5:00.

Each race requires an entry fee and you can win much more than you pay into.
Winning a race will also give you a Gold Medal. When you successfully
complete a race it will have a checkmark next to it.

The last four races will appear through texts from Hao at various points in
the early part of the story. When they appear will depend on how fast you go
through the story. For this reason I am grouping them all together here in
this chapter:

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

0==================0
| Downtown Vinewood \
0=========================================================>

  ++Entry Fee: $500.
  ++Winnings: $2,250.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Notes: This is a long course through this part of the city. Even so it is 
           easy to get into first place early. After taking the lead then 
           focus on going through the course and avoiding collisions. A 
           pretty easy race overall.

0========0
| Airport \
0=========================================================>

  ++Entry Fee: $1,000.
  ++Winnings: $4,500.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Notes: This two-lap race will take you through the Airport, Maze Bank 
           Arena, and Grove St. areas. At the beginning of the race you need 
           to be careful when going up the onramp for the Arena - you could 
           end up on the wrong ramp when it splits or hit the median. 

           Another area to be careful of is the railroad tracks prior to the 
           Grove St. area. The posts for the railroad gates are solid and 
           will cause you to stop if you hit them. Outside of these areas the 
           rest of the course is easy and you can keep far ahead of your 
           rivals.

0========0
| Freeway \
0=========================================================>

  ++Entry Fee: $1,250.
  ++Winnings: $5,625.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Notes: This two-lap race involves the freeway loops on the Olympic Fwy. 
           This is a much harder race than the others. Getting into first 
           place is tricky because of the off-ramps going down and up. A 
           couple of hard areas involve the down ramps as you can get some 
           air and lose control resulting in flying off the course. You need 
           to slow down a little in those parts.

           Another major problem area is the center where you need to cut 
           across the freeway and change direction. This becomes more 
           problematic if you are still jockeying for position. When you get 
           into first place then focus on going through the course without 
           hitting any of the traffic on the freeway - especially those on 
           the ramps because of the narrow roadway.

0================0
| Vespucci Canals \
0=========================================================>

  ++Entry Fee: $1,500.
  ++Winnings: $6,750.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Notes: This is a two-lap race that goes around the Vespucci Canals, Del 
           Perro, and Vespucci Beach areas. This is an aggravating race due 
           to the fact that you have to use a motorcycle which you need to 
           have before you are allowed to race. The best one to use is an 
           Bati 801 or a Dinka Double-T (you may want to mod them first just 
           to be safe).

           It is much easier to wreck and you will be doing a lot of that if 
           you are not too careful. Take it easy around curves or you can 
           easily crash. A bad area is the Prosperity St. Promenade shopping 
           area. If you can go through this area unscathed you will be in 
           great shape since the other riders tend to wreck here.

           After winning this race you will get a call from Hao 
           congratulating you on your prowess.

  0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0

      activate your Special just before you get to him. When you get to him 
      then Beverly will start his punch and that should be enough to get 
      Madison.

    ***************
      You need to help Beverly snap and inspect three photographs. Keeping up 
      with the limo until it speeds ahead should allow you to give Beverly 
      the opportunities he needs to get this Requirement.

  Beverly wants Franklin's help in getting a shot at America's newest 
  sweetheart doing the "wild thing".....

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  Follow Beverly into the hotel grounds. Eventually he will lead you to where 
  Poppi and her boyfriend are getting it on. The game will instruct you on 
  how to use the camera. After awhile you will be seen and you will be chased 
  by her and her security.

  driving as you are being pursued by her. At this point you need to keep the

      few quick seconds to jump in to get the Requirement.

    **********
      You need to achieve full facial recognition during the chase (a minimum 
      of 90% I think). Pull the zoom all the way out as this will make it 
      much easier to keep the camera on her face.

 / The Main Story \+++++++++++++++++++\
0==========================================================================\
| >MSY3. Michael De Santa                                                   +
0==========================================================================/

Michael is a former bank robber who is now living in a luxurious home in
Rockford Hills. He is also married and has two kids. But, as you may have
already seen so far, things are far from perfect.

Michael starts off with $7,860 and a Pistol with 120 rounds. If you stay with
him for a short bit he will get a message from his wife telling him about the
Tennis court he never uses. This will open up all of the Tennis courts in the
Los Santos area. This will also open up the Golf Course for him to use. His
personal car is the Tailgater.

Michael's Special Ability is to slow down time while on foot. This will give
him an advantage in combat. He will also have two Stranger missions specific
to him as well as the next Main Story mission at his house. But there are
things to do before resuming with the story.....

            /=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=\
 /=========================================================================\
| >GHF18. Sports                                                            |
 \=========================================================================/
            \=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=/

Now is time to go over the two Sports that have been opened up. These Sports
are required for 100% Completion and can be used to improve your Strength
Skill. However, because of the easy to use Bus Stomping Trick, you can have
your Strength maxed out before doing these and make them easier to do.

0=====0
| Golf \
0====================================================>

  This activity is open between 6:00 and 18:00 and you have to pay $100. You 
  can choose up to three other players to play with you or you can play by 
  yourself. This is a nine hole course and you can unlock other challengers 
  by completing a round. You need to get par or better in order to get 
  Completion percentage.

  The controls are fairly straightforward. There is a gauge on the right side 
  of the screen. Pull back on the Left Analog Stick to begin your swinging 
  motion and quickly push up when you reach the yellow point on the gauge. 
  This will complete your swing.

  You can add spin to the ball by going left or right in the stick while the 
  gauge is in motion. You also need to account for wind when aiming yourself. 
  You use the Right Analog Stick to aim where you would like for the ball to 
  go. You can see where you are aiming by looking at the hole outline on the 
  left side of the screen.

  When you are putting there will be a grid overlay that will determine the 
  contour of the course so you can make proper adjustments to your swing.

  It's not too hard to get par on this course even on your first time. After 
  completing a round you will get the Golf Club added to your Weapon Wheel.

0=======0
| Tennis \
0====================================================>

  Unlike the single Golf Course there are multiple places to play Tennis, 
  even your own home. The game gives simple instructions on how to play. You 
  use the Left Analog Stick to swing and the face buttons are used for 
  various spins of the ball.

  You can select the number of games and difficulty of opponent. To quickly 
  get Completion percentage I recommend one game and easy difficulty.

  The main thing to do is to get your opponent to be on one side of the court 
  and to hit the ball to the other side to get it past him. It's not 
  difficult to do although it will take some time to get the hang of the 
  controls and general gameplay. You also get $12 for winning.

| >GHF20. Properties                                                        |
