            \=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=/

If you look at your map you may see a building with a "$" down around Grove
St. This indicates a Property you can buy. There are a multitude of places
you can purchase throughout the game. Each Property purchased is colored
coded to whichever character bought it. Some Properties open up now and
others will open up later.

The place that Franklin can purchase is a car garage. It costs $30,000 and is
used to store vehicles found in the street and purchased online. When you
switch to Michael he will have his own garage that he can purchase - the
Vinewood Garage. Just like the one on Grove St. it is mainly used for storing
vehicles and costs $30,000.

There will be some money making Businesses that will open during the game and
I will cover them later.

 \=========================================================================/
            \=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=/

If you've gone and acquired some of the Hidden Packages and done the Random
Event Encounter "Bike Thief City 1" then you should have a lot of money. The
building at Grove St. is a vehicle garage where you can store multiple cars.
This building does not generate money so buying it does not count for
Completion percentage.

However, you will need it so you can buy a vehicle from the web which is
required for 100% Completion. Buy the garage (for $30,000) then go onto the
internet and to Travel and Transport - www.southernsanandreassuperautos.com.
Then purchase any vehicle to add towards Completion percentage. I recommend
the Faggio as it is the cheapest of the vehicles.

On the map you will see marker for both Michael and Franklin. Let's stay with
Franklin and do the one at his house.....

| The Plan \
0=======================>

  Get in the car and drive to the Ammu-Nation. When you get there you need to 
  buy the Flashlight mod for your Pump Shotgun. If you don't already have the 
  Shotgun then you will need to buy it. If you have plenty of money then fill 
  up your ammo and buy the Suppressor. After buying what you need then drive 
  over to the meeting at the Recycling Plant.

  When you get to the building then enter it and proceed up. You will then 
  meet D, the same person you tried to kidnap earlier. You also discover that 
  you have been set up and you need to get out of the Plant alive. You can 
  use your Pump Shotgun or, better still, the Assault Shotgun as you proceed 
  carefully along the hallways and kill any of the Ballas you encounter.

  Slowly proceed through the first floor and kill the Ballas quickly before 
  they can do much damage. After getting rid of them then leave through the 
  door going outside. At this point you now have a 3-Star Wanted Rating.

  Now you have to deal with a Police chopper. Kill the gunman quickly with an 
  Assault Rifle to make it go away. Proceed through the Junkyard and to the 
  street. At this point more Cops will show up. But someone just left behind 
  a car right in front of you. Take it and lose the Cops.

  One of the best ways is the train tunnel loop east of Grove St. Quickly 
  pause the game and put a GPS marker at the intersection of Carson Ave. and 
  Brouge Ave. This usually means turning around and going through the rapidly 
  approaching Cops. Quickly follow the marker and get to the intersection. 
  Then go down the tracks into the tunnel to lose the Police. After losing 
  the Cops then drive back to your home to successfully complete the mission.

| Notes \
0=======================>

  Upgrading your Lung Capacity Skill may also be recommended but not

| The Plan \
0=======================>

  To start, drive the both of you down to the Bike Rental Stand. When you get 
  there then select a bike and start pedaling. Following the assigned path to 
  the end of the pier to beat Jimmy. After the race Jimmy points out that 
  Tracey is on a big boat nearby. She has been sleeping around with various 
  producers in an attempt to get famous. This angers Michael and he decides 
  to swim to the boat.

  Swim out to the boat and confront her friends. This will start a chase on 
  Seasharks. They will chase and shoot at you. Go through the canals and to 
  the south end of the beach to lose them. You also have the option of 
  killing them with either your Pistol or Micro SMG. After losing or killing 
  them then head to the marker at the beach. This will start a cutscene that 
  ends the mission successfully.

0===========0
| 100% Score \
0=======================>

  >>Fastest Speed
    *************
      You need to reach the top speed on the Seashark. You need to get above 
      100% on the vehicle. Just drive the skiboat as fast as you can to the 
      end of the beach area and you should get this easy.

  >>Stabilizer
    **********
      You need to finish the race without falling off the bicycle. Following 
      the assigned path without smacking into anything should make this 
      automatic.

  >>Faster Than Fish
    ****************
      You need to swim out to the boat within one minute. The timing is a 
      little tight so swim as quickly as you can out to the boat. Swimming 
      underwater will make you go faster so upgrading your Lung Capacity 
      Skill may be useful for this if you have trouble getting this 
      Requirement. The longer you can swim underwater, the faster you can get 
      to the boat.

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

  Now, before we continue with things, I am going to take a lengthy detour 
  that will net you some major rewards.....

            /=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=\
 /=========================================================================\
| >GHF22. The Epsilon Program                                               |
 \=========================================================================/
            \=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=/

Not far from Michael's house is a large building for this cult-like religion
that is loosely based on the real life Scientology movement. The Epsilon
Program was introduced in San Andreas and brought back for this installment.
This time you can actually interact with the cult and do encounters with them
but only as Michael.

But, before doing them, you will need to have about $100,000 at hand. This is
the main reason for going after the Hidden Packages earlier in the game when
you unlocked Michael.

It is important to note that doing these encounters is *NOT* required for
100% Completion. But there are some rewards worth noting:

  --The {Kifflom!} Accomplishment.
  --Three potential Gold Medals.
  --Over two million dollars.

That last reward alone is why you should do these encounters as it will set
up Michael real good, money wise, at this stage of the game.

The earliest you can deal with the cult is the mission "Father/Son" but I
decided to put this chapter here so there would be no missions at the house
at this time. You also have to have done Franklin's Stranger mission "Pulling
Favors" too before you are allowed to interact with the cult. But, if you've
followed the order of the guide thus far, then this should not be a problem.

Some of the information presented here comes from
www.xbox360achievements.com.

To start things off you need to go onto the Internet and enter
www.epsilonprogram.com in the search bar at the top of the screen. If you
have one I recommend using a keypad that can be attached to the joypad, such
as the Xbox 360's ChatPad.

Once you are at the website then complete the identity evaluation. After
seeing your score then leave the website. If you look at your map then you
should see a "?" marker in Raton Canyon. This is your first encounter.....

0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0
| A. Seeking the Truth |~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~\
0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0

When you get to the marker you will find a red pickup. You will then start a
cutscene where Michael reads the Epsilon tract but is attacked by a couple of
followers. He will then wake up almost naked near the radar dishes in the
Grand Senora Desert. This will end the encounter.

After this then go back to the website and make a donation of $500. This will
unlock the next encounter, which is The Epsilon Program symbol, roughly
twenty four hours after the donation.

0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0
| B. Accepting the Truth |~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~\
0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0

When Michael walks into the storage building he meets Marnie (as in Marnie
Allen, the prostitute Niko saved in GTA IV). She tells him about an
"incredible education tool" that will help him. But he needs to pay $5,000 to
get it. After the encounter ends then make the $5,000 donation to unlock the
next encounter which appears about twenty four hours after you make the
payment.

0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0
| C. Assuming the Truth |~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~\
0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0

When Michael meets Marnie again in Grapeseed he finds that he needs to
acquire vehicles for the "higher beings". After the encounter then leave the
area to get an email from Marnie outlining the vehicles needed:

  --Pegassi Vacca ($240,000)
  --Benefactor Surano ($99,000)
  --Declasse Tornado
  --Enus Super Diamond ($250,000)
  --Dinka Double-T

As you can see you can buy some of the vehicles listed but they are pretty
expensive. Thankfully, if you don't have the money or just want to be cheap,
you can find them in the wild either randomly or at the following locations
(which are hinted in the pictures that accompany the email):

  ++Pegassi Vacca
    =============
      3659 Wild Oats Dr. in Vinewood Hills.

  ++Benefactor Sureno
    =================
      At a small parking lot at the east side of the small road loop in the 
      center of Lake Vinewood Estates in Vinewood Hills.

  ++Declasse Tornado
    ================
      At the Car Shop (with the signage "Domestic - Japanese - European") at 
      the east side of the intersection of Elgin Ave. and Spanish Avenue in 
      Hawick.

  ++Enus Super Diamond
    ==================
      Parked behind Leopold's which is along Dorset Ave. between Heritage Way 
      and Palomino Ave. in Rockford Hills.

  ++Dinka Double-T
    ==============
      At the LifeInvader offices at the intersection of Boulevard Del Perro 
      and Dorset Drive.

Although there are many YouTube videos that show you where to find the cars
they neglect to inform you that these vehicles will *NOT* appear in the wild
until *AFTER* you start the encounter. If you want any of these vehicles for
yourself then take it to your garage - the game will spawn another one to
replace it.

Another thing to note is that these cars will spawn at these locations only
during the duration of the encounter - not before and not after. If you want
any of them then you should get them now.

When you find a car then take it to the Epsilon symbol in Vinewood Hills.
After delivering all five vehicles then you will receive another email which
sets up the next encounter twenty four hours after this one.

0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0
| D. Chasing the Truth |~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~\
0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0

Michael meets up with Marnie and with actor Jimmy Boston. They want you to
search for alien artifacts using a special device. The device will light up
blue when you get close to an artifact. It will also vibrate and make noise
as you get close.

When you start, head west towards some houses. Eventually you will find an
old TV sitting on the ground. This turns out to not be the artifact. Continue
looking.

From here, head back east until you reach a dry creek bed then turn north
along the west edge. Continue until you find a car battery. This is also not
the artifact. You need to continue looking.

From here, cross the creek bed to the east edge and head south. Eventually
you will find a trio of tree stumps and an old boot. Michael proclaims to
have found the artifact and Marnie declares him ready for the next level.
This will complete the encounter.

You will also get Jimmy Boston's contact for your phone. Go back to the
website and make two $5,000 donations to unlock the next encounter which
appears about twenty four hours after the donation.

0===========0
| 100% Score \
0=======================>

  >>Use the Force
    *************
      Find the alien artifact without the detector. This is easy if you use 
      only the vibrate function of your controller or just listen to the 
      beeps.

0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0
| E. Bearing the Truth |~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~\
0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0

When you meet Marnie again she is in front of a wall apparently praying to
something. In order to prove yourself to Cris you need to get the Epsilon
Robes and wear them for ten days straight.

Go back to the website and order the robes for $25,000. Then head home and
sleep for about a day and a half then leave your room to get the delivery
confirmation message. Go to your Closet and select the Epsilon Robes. Then
sleep for ten days. You will also get a notification on how long you have
worn the robes.

After you sleep the ten days then leave your room and head downstairs. You
should get a message from Cris telling you that you will be summoned later.
Shortly afterwards you will be summoned by Jimmy and this unlocks the next
encounter.

From this point forward you need to stay in your robes until you complete all
of the remaining encounters.

0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0
| F. Delivering the Truth |~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~\
0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0

When you get to the beach near Fort Zancudo you then need to fly the nearby
plane to Jimmy. Get in the plane, take off, and fly east along the Zancudo
River. Along the way you'll be contacted by Jimmy. He instructs you to fly to
Sandy Shores Airfield. Land the plane at the Airfield then leave it and go to
Jimmy nearby. This will successfully end the encounter and unlocks the next
one (about twenty four hours after this one).

It should be noted that you can take the Ocelot F620 nearby back to Los
Santos and place it into your garage to keep it.

| 100% Score \

  >>Touchdown
    *********

      down. Gradually slow down over the runway and gently put it down.

  >>Zondar the Bridge
    *****************
      Fly under a bridge along Lago Zancudo. Use the large freeway bridge 
      just after takeoff. This is probably the best one to use for this 
      Requirement.

0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0
| G. Exercising the Truth |~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~\
0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0
When Michael gets to the Grand Senora Desert and meets with the others then
he needs to run five miles through the desert to further prove himself.

The best way to do this, based on what others have been doing, is to get a
short distance within the Desert, tape your Left Analog Stick in a diagonal
position, and make Michael walk around in a circle while you go do something
else (taping down the Run Button as well will speed things up). Using the
System Hardware Pause Trick will *NOT* work for this.

The game will mark your progress every tenth of a mile. After you do the five
miles then you will receive a call from Cris Fromage. This will end the
encounter and immediately unlock the last one. You will also need $50,000
before doing this encounter.

0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0
| H. Unknowing the Truth |~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~\
0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0

When Michael meets Cris then he needs him to deliver the money to Cris'
helicopter. Follow the convoy the short distance to the Drop-Off Point, which
is next door to a Los Santos Customs. Get out of the vehicle and follow one
of the followers down to receive your ultimate reward which is.....an old
tractor. Yep, you just got shafted and your money is gone to boot.

So how are you supposed to get all of that money? That's right, you have to
kill or evade everybody. Evading them is difficult and killing them is hard
too. Not necessarily because they're resilient but because they are very
accurate with their firearms, even more-so than the Cops and that's saying
something.

Before you do this option you should have a Micro SMG, an Assault/Carbine
Rifle, and an RPG with lots of ammo for each.

When you start the encounter then back up a little bit and kill the Guard
behind you with the Micro SMG. This will start the fight. Stay in your car as
this will provide some important cover. The helicopter will fly and hover
directly above you. As the others are coming in from either behind or in
front of you go and kill the other foot Guard in front of you.

As you are fighting off the Guards the Cops will get involved so you need to
keep an eye out for them too. Once you have managed to kill off all of the
ground forces then you will need to get rid of the helicopter.

The chopper will always stay near the car so use that to your advantage. Get
out of your car and run enough of a distance so you can get a good angle on
the helicopter. Then quickly blow up the helicopter with the RPG before the
shooter inside can do a lot of damage. Wait for the wreckage to drop down
before running back to the car.

At this point you will get an automatic 3-Star Wanted Rating. It is important
to note that there is no Police helicopter so it will be easier to lose the
Rating. Use the alleys to lose pursuit while at the same time heading for the
Los Santos River. If you can't lose them by the time you reach the river then
head for the sewer/subway construction tunnel at the north end.

When the Rating finally disappears then you will complete this encounter and
finally finish with The Epsilon Program.

0===========0
| 100% Score \
0=======================>

  >>Cult Intervention
    *****************
      Kill all Epsilon security. You have to kill everybody, and I do mean 
      *EVERYBODY*. After killing the Guards at the main building then you 
      need to go to the Drop-Off Point to kill the two Guards there.

  >>Show Me the Money
    *****************
      Steal the Epsilon money and escape.

0=======0
| Reward \
0=======================>

  $2,100,000 and the {Kifflom!} Accomplishment.

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

  In addition, regardless of outcome, Marnie will text you telling to look 
  for Epsilon Tracts hidden throughout the state. These are not required for 
  100% Completion so I will not cover them.

With all of that tedious stuff done it is on to the next task.....

            /=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=\
 /=========================================================================\
| >GHF23. Triathlons                                                        |
 \=========================================================================/
            \=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=/

When you completed the mission "Daddy's Little Girl" you also opened up this
multi-sport race. You need to swim, bike, and run your way to the finish
line. Any character can do this.

Before doing this it is highly recommended that you max out your Stamina
Skill so you don't have to worry about draining your health. Upgrading your
Lung Capacity Skill beforehand is optional.

You compete against seven other participants. There is no money to enter but
you don't get any money for completing either. Successfully completing all of
the Triathlons is required for 100% Completion. Getting a Gold Medal in a
Triathlon will add towards the {Multi-Disciplined} Accomplishment.

Successfully completing a race will open up the next. There are a total of
three Triathlons in the game - Vespucci Beach, Alamo Sea, and Sandy Shores.

When you start the race you will see your position, time, and Stamina in the
lower right corner of the screen. Maxing out your Stamina Skill before the
race makes the Stamina Bar irrelevant.

The main thing you have to do is to continually tap your Run Button. Swimming
underwater for short stretches actually makes you swim faster, great for
getting an early lead. Having your Lung Capacity Skill maxed out before the
race may allow you to swim farther underwater thus allowing you to get a nice
lead on your rivals.

While the first two races aren't too bad the third one, Coyote Cross Country
Triathlon in Sandy Shores, is probably the longest race ever put into any of
the GTA games - a race that will take you about half an hour to finish.

You can use the swimming part to get a nice big lead but that won't make much
of a difference. The reason is because, on the biking segment, the
programmers put in "rubber-banding", a lazy programming method that gives
artificial challenge by allowing the computer to quickly catch up and blow
past you regardless of how much of a lead you have and how fast you are going
(a tactic that I wish was totally outlawed).

The best thing to do in this segment, which is very long, is to keep the
course and make any cornering shortcuts that you find. The goal is to be
either in the lead or very close to it when you reach the end of the segment.
Thankfully, there is no rubber-banding on the running portion. Once you get
into the lead then you should be able to keep it through to the end. It took
me twenty seven minutes to complete this race.

If your fingers and wrist start to tire and hurt then use the Pause Button to
take a break before resuming. No reason to give yourself carpal tunnel over a
game.

With this done let's go to Lester.....

 / The Main Story \+++++++++++++++++++\
0==========================================================================\
| >MSY4. Lester Crest                                                       +
0==========================================================================/

Lester is an old friend of Michael. He helped him plan heists together before
things changed. He is nerdy and reclusive but highly technical. He also
serves as a go-between for fences who take care of the stolen merchandise. He
spends his time dealing in the stock market where he gets the majority of his
money these days.

Michael needs his help in dealing with Mr. Madrazo which leads to the next
mission.....

  0+=+=+=+=+=+=0
 / Lester Crest \
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+\
| >LSR1. Friend Request                                                     0
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+/
| Overview /                                               \ Lester Crest /
0=========0                                                 0+=+=+=+=+=+=0

  After re-acquainting himself with Lester, Michael is needed to take down a 
  lying scumbag, at least according to Lester anyway.....

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  To start, you need to go to the SubUrban Store in Vinewood. When you get 
  there you need to get into an appropriate outfit. You need to buy pants and 
  a top before you can proceed - any combination will work. After changing 
  into the necessary clothes then head to the LifeInvader Offices. As you 
  drive there Lester will call you with further instructions.

  When you get there then go to the rear entrance and you will be let in 
  after a cutscene. Follow the Programmer and he will lead you to a computer. 
  You need to run the anti-virus software before proceeding. You have to get 
  rid of all of the ads before you are allowed to activate the software.

  You can't just click on the ad to make it go away - you have to click the X 
  in the upper right corner. After cleaning up the computer then you will be 
  instructed to rig the Prototype.

  After doing your dirty work then leave the building. From here, go back to 
  your house to watch the keynote speech. Wait for Jay Norris to pull out the 
  Prototype then give him a call. This results in his death and a successful 
  end to the mission.

0===========0
| 100% Score \
0=======================>

  >>Time (8:30)
    ***********

  >>Popups Clear
    ************
      You need to clear all popups within thirty two seconds. This is very 
      annoying due to the fact that you are using a joypad instead of a 
      mouse and that more popups appear as you try to clear the others. The 
      Left Analog Stick is very imprecise for this task and makes it hard to 
      get to the X's in a reliable manner because it is too fast.

      The timing is way too tight for such lousy controls. It will take you 
      quite a few tries before you can get this.

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

  Lester will also call you and give you a link to the stock markets. This 
  will also open up all of the Clothing Stores in the area. This will give 
  you more options in changing your appearance. Later, you will get a message 
  from Los Santos Customs telling you of more parts to upgrade your vehicles.

  Later still, you will get a mysterious phone call from someone who worked 
  at LifeInvader. After the Jay's death he finds himself needing additional 
  work since his shares of LifeInvader stock plummeted. This will put Rickie 
  Lukens in your contact list as a potential Heist crew member.

  But, before proceeding with the Main Story, there are a couple of other 
  things that should be done first.....

| >GHF25. Accomplishments (Part Two)                                        |

Now it's time to go after another of the Accomplishments, {Los Santos
Customs}. Although the shops are open from the beginning of the game you can
only get this after the mission "Friend Request". The reason is that one of
the necessary upgrades required for this Accomplishment is finally unlocked
at this point of the game (Bulletproof Tires).

PowerPyx over at www.xboxachievements.com made a video about getting this
Accomplishment. However, you do not need to buy everything, just one of each
category should suffice. Nothing on your vehicle should be considered stock -
everything should be upgraded or simply changed. You should get the
Accomplishment when you exit the facility.

If you've done the Hidden Packages and sold your Animal Ark shares then you
should have more then enough money for this. Save your game prior to going to
the shop then, after you get the Accomplishment, reload the save to get your
money back.

While you're Franklin I recommend using your Western Bagger motorcycle for
this. Below is the list of what is recommended to get this Accomplishment for
this bike:

  --Armor upgrade (cheapest)
  --Brake upgrade (cheapest)
  --Engine upgrade (cheapest)
  --Exhaust upgrade (cheapest)
  --Fairing (remove)
  --Frame (cheapest)
  --Fuel Tank (cheapest)
  --Horn (cheapest)
  --Lights (Xenon Lights)
  --Plate (any other than what you already have)
  --Respray (any color that what you already have)
  --Saddle Bags (Leather Saddle Bags)
  --Transmission (cheapest)
  --Turbo (Turbo Tuning)
  --Wheels
      ++Wheel Type
          --Front Wheel (any other than what you currently have)
          --Rear Wheel (any other than what you currently have)
      ++Wheel Color (any other than what you currently have)
      ++Wheel Accessories - Custom Tires, Bulletproof Tires, Black Tire 
                            Smoke

Switch back to Michael and you may get an urgent phone call from Amanda which
sets up the optional mission.....

 /=========================================================================\
| >GHF26. Setting Up Heists                                                 |
 \=========================================================================/
            \=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=/

At several points during the game you will perform various heists and raids. 
Right now you will begin work on robbing the Vangelico Jewelry Store. There
are several things that need to be done in order to perform a successful
heist:

0===================0
| Scoping Things Out \
0=========================================================>

  The first thing you need to do is to go to the location and perform several 
  tasks to gain intelligence about the place.

0===================0
| The Planning Board \
0=========================================================>

  Near the tail end of the intelligence mission you will be presented with a 
  planning board where you can go over what you know about the place that you 
  are going to raid.

0=============0
| The Approach \
0=========================================================>

  You will be presented with two options for raiding: The Loud and Obvious 
  Approach and The Smart and Stealthy Approach. There are some additional 
  setup missions that need to be performed and which ones you do will be 
  dependent on which approach you wish to take.

0=========0
| The Crew \
0=========================================================>

  Here you need to choose three additional people to help in your raid - a 
  driver, a gunman, and a hacker. Each has various levels of skill. The 
  better they are, the more smoothly the robbery will go. However, they work 
  for a percentage of the take. Therefore, the more skilled they are, the 
  more expensive they are and the less you can get for yourself.

  If you're thinking that going cheap on all members of the Crew will result 
  in a huge amount for yourself that's probably not a good idea. This type of 
  Crew will move slower which may result in less being stolen and you may 
  also risk the chance of one of them crashing and losing part of the take 
  during the getaway which reduces your cut even further and may even result 
  in a complete mission failure.

  The best way to ensure success while getting a good payday is to do what I 
  call a Balanced Crew - one high-level, one mid-level, and one low-level 
  member.

  At the end of the heist your Crew members will get a significant increase 
  in overall skill. If you keep the same Crew throughout the entire game you 
  can create a really nice skilled Crew by the time you get to the heavy 
  stuff. It should also be pointed out that their cut won't change even if 
  they become real skilled near the end of the game.

  In addition, you can get additional Crew members to choose from by doing 
  certain Random Event Encounters.

    ++The Driver
      ==========
        A good driver will research the route and determine what is the best 
        vehicles for the getaway as well as make sure that everybody follows 
        him and takes the proper route. He will also be helpful in robbing 
        whatever place you raid. Right now you have two drivers to choose 
        from: Eddie Toh and Karim Denz. You can get another driver to choose 
        from later in the game.

    ++The Gunman
      ==========
        A good gunman will be very helpful in necessary crowd control and 
        won't make bad decisions. He will also be quick in grabbing the 
        merchandise which will improve the overall take. And he will be less 
        likely to crash during the getaway.

        If you've done the Random Event Encounter "Getaway Driver" you should 
        have three gunmen to choose from: Gustavo Mota, Packie McReary, and 
        Norm Richards.

    ++The Hacker
      ==========
        A good hacker will suppress the alarm system as long as possible thus 
        allowing you maximum time to grab all that you need and want. Right 
        now you should have three hackers to choose from: Paige Harris, 
        Christian Feltz, and Rickie Lukens.

0==========0
| The Setup \
0=========================================================>

  After choosing the Crew then you go and acquire what you need based on what 
  approach you go with. These missions will appear quickly one after the 
  other upon completion.

0==========0
| The Heist \
0=========================================================>

  After completion of the last setup mission then you begin the robbery 
  itself. How well it goes will be dependent on your Crew members.

0================0
| Mission Replays \
0=========================================================>

  If you choose to do a Mission Replay of the Heist to get Requirements you 
  will be sent back to the Planning Board where you can choose a new Approach 
  and Crew. However, you can't do skill increases for Crew members on 
  Replays. Any Skill increases for a Crew member will be removed and they 
  will return to their original skill level. This can be annoying at later 
  stages of the game.

  It is also important to point out that if you choose a different Approach 
  you cannot do any setup missions related to it - you will go straight to 
  the heist with all the necessary equipment you need.

  If you need to do a Mission Replay on a setup mission that is before the 
  Heist you will have to wait until after the raid since you will immediately 
  start the Heist after the last setup mission.

With all of that explained let's move on.....

  0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0
 / The Vangelico Heist \
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+\
| >VHT1. Casing the Jewel Store                                             0
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+/
| Overview /                                        \ The Vangelico Heist /
0=========0                                          0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0

  After talking to Lester the both of them head out to Vangelico to scope the 
  place out.....

0======0
| Notes \
0=======================>

  If you haven't already done so get Suppressors on your Pistol and Micro SMG 
  prior to doing this mission along with plenty of ammo for each (1,000+ 
  rounds). This is mainly for the missions ahead. I also highly recommend 
  doing the "Getaway Driver" Random Event Encounter to unlock Packie McReary.

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  Go to the store in Rockford Hills. As you head there you are given some 
  special glasses that contain a camera. When you get to the marker then head 
  to the Jewelers and you will be given instructions on how to use your 
  glasses. Lester will also tell you what he needs - pictures of the security 
  features (alarm system, ventilation, cameras).

  Go inside and take pictures of what he needs. Everything should be just 
  inside the fron doors. After getting the pictures then talk to the Shop 
  Assistant. After talking to her then leave the Store.

  Next, Lester needs to know about the ventilation on the roof. Get in the 
  car and drive to the southeast corner of the block to find a construction 
  area. Get inside and climb to the roof. When you get there then you need to 
  go to the large unit at the north side of the roof.

  The main ventilation system you need to take a picture of is behind a 
  walled area with some razor wire. The vantage point is on the lower rooftop 
  north of this. You need to climb up the building there in order to get the 
  shot of the system. After getting the shot then head back down to the car 
  and go back to the Garment Factory.

  Now you need to choose the approach and Crew. Here are my recommendations 
  for the Crew:

    >>The Driver (Eddie Toh)
      **********************
        Karim won't exactly do his homework and will have the wrong vehicles 
        for the task. He also isn't very helpful and gets lost in the 
        tunnels. So I recommend Eddie as your high-end member for the 
        Balanced Crew approach. He will get you dirtbikes for the tunnel,
        knows the route very well, and makes sure you follow it.

    >>The Gunman (Packie McReary)
      ***************************
        Norm is slow and will more than likely crash during the getaway (he 
        might also kill a hostage or let her run if you go Loud). Even though 
        Packie is just as good as Gustavo he can be technically be considered 
        mid-level even though he is only two percentage points cheaper. 
        Besides, if you played GTA IV, why wouldn't you want to have Packie 
        on your crew?

    >>The Hacker (Rickie Lukens)
      **************************
        Rickie is inexperienced and won't be able to keep the alarm 
        suppressed for very long. However, this should be enough to do what 
        you need to do given the other experienced members of the Crew to 
        compensate. He is easily the cheapest member and would be the 
        low-level part of the Balanced Crew.

  After making your choices then you can go over and make sure this is what 
  you want. When you make your final selection then the mission is 
  successfully completed.

0===========0
| 100% Score \
0=======================>

  >>Time (8:00)
    ***********
      Choosing the crew does *NOT* count towards this so take your time 
      there. When replaying this mission it will end when you get back to the 
      factory.

  >>Picture Perfect
    ***************
      You need to capture all three security features within one picture. 
      When you enter the store you should see the keycarded door to the left. 
      A vent and a camera should also be close to it. Get all three in the 
      same picture. It should be noted that you can get this Requirement even 
      if you got pictures of any of the other features elsewhere in the store 
      - just make sure you get one picture of all three.

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

  Michael will call Franklin to tell him of the job. He will call him back 
  when he has things put together. Afterwards you will get a message from 
  Lester which starts the setup missions.....

| A. Bugstars Equipment (The Smart Approach) |~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~\
0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0

0========0
| Weapons \
0=======================>

  Pistol (silenced).

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  When you arrive near the business you are told to steal and deliver a 
  Bugstars Van. There are three to choose from. There are also employees both 
  outside and inside the business. The best thing to do is to approach the 
  business from the backside which is the west side.

  There is one guy with his back turned to you. Go into Stealth Mode, bring 
  out your Pistol, carefully sneak behind him, and pistolwhip him. Then 
  silently get into the van and quickly back out. From here, drive back to 
  the Garment Factory to successfully complete the mission.

  Michael will call Lester about the van. Lester will tell you that you need 
  some gas for the job. The gas is made on the coast but a truck makes its 
  way to the city every now and then. This will put another marker on the 
  map which starts the second setup mission related to The Smart Approach.

0===========0
| 100% Score \
0=======================>

  >>Sneaky Pest
    ***********
      You need to get the van without being spotted.

0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0
| B. BZ Gas Grenades (The Smart Approach) |~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~\
0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0

0========0
| Weapons \
0=======================>

  --Pistol (silenced).
  --Micro SMG (silenced).

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  Go to the moving marker on the road to start this mission. Get behind the 
  van and shoot at the doors. The goal is to open the doors and get the gas 
  to fall out without incurring any problems from the driver. Using a 
  silenced weapon will help in this regard.

  When the doors open and the gas falls out then grab it and lose the Wanted 
  Rating (which should be at 1-Star). After losing the Rating then head back 
  to the Garment Factory. After dropping off the gas inside the upper level 
  room then you will call Lester.

0===========0
| 100% Score \
0=======================>

  >>Loose Cargo
    ***********
      You need to shoot open the back doors to release the gas.

  **NOTE: Go to Chapter VHT2.

0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0
| C. Carbine Rifles (The Loud Approach) |~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~\
0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0

0========0
| Weapons \
0=======================>

  Micro SMG (silenced).

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  Lester will text you to let you know about an LSPD Van that is carrying the 
  Carbine Rifles you need for the job. This will put the marker on the map. 
  You must intercept the Van before it can get to the Mission Row Police 
  Station or you will fail the mission.

  While you are talking to Franklin and before Lester texts you drive to 
  Elgin Ave. and park close to the northeast exit ramp for the Olympic Fry. 
  This is where the Van will exit. It will take awhile for the Van to come to 
  you but sit tight.

  When it gets close to your position then move the car across the exit ramp 
  to block it. When it gets real close then use your Micro SMG and kill all 
  four SWAT within the Van while you are still inside your car. After they 
  are dead then quickly switch vehicles and evade the 3-Star Wanted Rating.

  Go under the freeway bridge and turn north into the hobo encampment to the 
  north. The irritating thing about this is that the tents are 
  indestructible. But get far enough inside to hopefully get out of sight.

  If you do then sit still and maybe the Cops won't find you and the Rating 
  goes away. If the Cops end up finding you again then head to the Los Santos 
  River and go inside the tunnel at the north end to lose them. After losing 
  the Rating then go to the Garment Factory to successfully complete the 
  mission.

0===========0
| 100% Score \
0=======================>

  >>Swift Getaway
    *************
      You need to lose the Wanted Rating within two minutes. If you manage to 
      lose the Cops while inside the hobo encampment then this should be 
      enough to get this Requirement.

      If you have to do this on a Mission Replay it is important to note that 
      you will start just behind the Van near Backlot City. However, it will 
      eventually pass by the the broken railing you used to drop down onto 
      the freeway during the Heist.

      So speed ahead of the van and stop at the signal light near the 
      railing. Then ambush the Van the same way you did the first time. After 
      switching vehicles then drop down onto the freeway and drive into the 
      subway construction tunnel. You should lose the Rating very quickly.

      As you are losing the Rating simply drive all the way to the other end 
      since that is the direction you need to go to reach the Garment 
      Factory.

  After completion of these setup missions then you will automatically begin 
  the heist.....

  0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0
 / The Vangelico Heist \
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+\
| >VHT2. The Jewel Store Job (Both Approaches)                              0
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+/
| Overview /                                        \ The Vangelico Heist /
0=========0                                          0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0

  Now it's time to do the job at hand.....

0========0
| Weapons \
0=======================>

  --Micro SMG.
  --Carbine Rifles.

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  >>The Smart Way
    *************
      Get in the car and drive to Vangelico's. When you get to the marker 
      then you will auto switch to Franklin and now you need to climb to the 
      roof. Head to the marker at the north side of the roof. When you climb 
      to the marker then you need to switch to the Gas Grenades in your 
      Weapon Wheel. Aim the marker just inside the large vent and throw two 
      of them. This will be enough to knock out everybody in the store.

  >>The Loud Way
    ************
      You will start the mission as Franklin. Get in the Van and drive it to 
      Vangelico's.

  At this point you will auto switch back to Michael. Get into the Store and 
  get as much as you can. The better the hacker you chose, the longer you can 
  stay. Even if you picked Rickie you should be able to get a very good take 
  before the alarm goes off. Note that the amount must be in the green before 
  it can be considered successful. Your hacker should tell you when the alarm 
  will go off. Get out before it does.

  **NOTE: If you chose The Loud Approach a person may leave the safe room and 
          enter the store area. How well this situation plays out will depend 
          on what gunman you chose.

  Once you get outside then you will auto switch back to Franklin and now you 
  must follow the Crew on a motorcycle. At this point there will be a 4-Star 
  Wanted Rating and you will be shot at by the Cops. Following your Crew will 
  lead you to the subway construction tunnel. Continue following them and you 
  will exit into the flood control channel. Unfortunately, the Cops are 
  crawling all over the place.

  You will then auto switch back to Michael and you now need to get rid of 
  the Cops chasing the Crew. Although you can shoot at them the best thing to 
  do is simply use the huge truck and ram the cars away from the Crew. This 
  is fairly easy to do and will allow you to get rid of them quickly.

  As you head near the south end of the channel you will finally get rid of 
  the Police and you can go to the Rendezvous Point safely. After everybody 
  enters the van then your crew will get experience points. From here, head 
  to the Lockup to successfully complete the mission.

0===========0
| 100% Score \
0=======================>

  >>Quick Grab
    **********
      You need to steal the minimum amount of jewelry in under fifty seconds. 
      According to Sterling P. de Mille you start at the front left of the 
      store. Go clockwise around the store quickly from this point which 
      should put you near the entrance by the time you grab the last jewel 
      and in time.

  >>Protege Protected
    *****************
      Protect Franklin during the LS River Chase. If you're quick in getting 
      rid of the Cops then this should be automatic.

  >>Clean Sweep
    ***********
      Steal the jewelry from all twenty glass cases. Even with Rickie as your 
      hacker you should be able to get this, especially with Stephen's tip.

0=======0
| Reward \
0=======================>

  This will depend on how much you got from the Store minus the various cuts 
  for Madrazo and the Crew. In addition, you will get the {Diamond Hard} 
  Accomplishment. If you didn't already have the Carbine Rifle in your Weapon 
  Wheel and you did the Loud Approach then you should now have the weapon in 
  your possession.

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

  At this point you will auto switch back to Franklin who will be enjoying 
  himself at the Vanilla Unicorn. He has a conversation with Tanisha but she 
  doesn't believe that Franklin can change from what he currently is. After 
  the conversation you will get Lester's contact for your phone along with a 
  text message from Michael telling you to go to his house to celebrate and 
  get your cut of the take.

  Both the Carbine Rifle and Tear Gas will now be available at all 
  Ammu-Nations.

  A member of GTAForums, Jozzborne, wrote a short little guide on making 
  money using the stock market. One of the things he noted is that the stock 
  for Vangelico may change after this mission (VAG on LCN Exchange). 
  Sometimes it crashes, sometimes it won't. If it crashes it may or may not 
  recover.

  Because of the randomness I don't recommend trying to do anything with 
  this. If you do want to try I recommend using some spare save slots so you 
  don't screw yourself over. Save in one slot after the mission and use the 
  others to save after crashing (and after investing all money in the VAG 
  stock) and one if it recovers (if it does so at all).

  At this point there is only one marker at Michael's house so let's go 
  there.....

 / Michael De Santa \
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+\
| >MCL5. Mr. Philips                                                        0
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+/
| Overview /                                           \ Michael De Santa /
0=========0                                             0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0

  Both Michael and Franklin celebrate their success. But an old FIB buddy, 
  Dave Norton, bursts in wondering what is going on with Michael. He is also 
  worried that Trevor may find out that Michael is alive and cause trouble. 
  Michael believes that Trevor is dead and that he himself had nothing to do 
  with the Heist.

  But Dave turns on the television to show Michael a news report. The news 
  report is about the Heist and a security guard is being interviewed. 
  Michael turns off the TV.

  But in another part of the state we see someone having sex with a woman 
  while listening to the report: Trevor. The guard tells the reporter 
  something that was said to him by the robbers and this triggers a memory 
  within Trevor. He angrily walks away from the woman who happens to be 
  Ashley Butler who we last saw in Liberty City. She is as much of a junkie 
  now as she was then.

  As Trevor walks out of the trailer he encounters an angry Johnny Klebitz, 
  the main character of "The Lost and Damned". Johnny is upset that Trevor is 
  having sex with his girl. He also implies that he is a meth head just like 
  Ashley. After the two of them talk then Trevor viciously attacks Johnny by 
  stomping his head, killing him in the process. After the attack Trevor 
  decides to take down The Lost.....

0========0
| Weapons \
0=======================>

  --Pistol.
  --Micro SMG.
  --Assault Rifle.
  --Carbine Rifle.
  --Pump Shotgun.

0======0
| Notes \
0=======================>

  Interestingly enough you can kill Ashley as she is grieving over Johnny. 
  The only way you can do that is to run her over - you can't shoot her 
  (bullets have no effect). This will also change Wade's dialogue. You can 
  also shoot Johnny's body and "kill" him.

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  To start, you need to get in the truck. If you check your Weapon Wheel 
  beforehand you will find that all you have is a Pistol with sixty five 
  rounds and a Pump Shotgun with sixty five rounds. You also have $108,654 to 
  spend. After you get in the truck then Trevor will instruct one of his 
  buddies, Wade, to find Michael. His other buddy, Ron, will be in the 
  passenger seat.

  You will be instructed to go to Grapeseed. However, it may be best to go 
  around the state and find some free weapons (such as the SMG, Assault 
  Rifle, Carbine Rifle, Molotov, and Body Armor) then go to Ammu-Nation, buy 
  a Micro SMG, and load up on ammo and modifications. After that then head to 
  Grapeseed.

  When you get there then you will encounter Johnny's friends Terry and Clay. 
  After the cutscene then you need to chase the gang. You have to keep 
  reasonably close to the van but use the Micro SMG to kill both Terry and 
  Clay. They both go down easily. Follow the van back to Stab City.

  Here you will get in a firefight with The Lost. You will also be told about 
  Trevor's rage mode and how to fill it up. If you got some powerful weapons, 
  such as the Assault and Carbine Rifle, then this will become easier. Use 
  the trailers as cover as you attack and kill the bikers. When you kill 
  enough of them then the rest will flee on foot. You can choose to chase 
  them or let them go. After the battle then go back to the truck.

  Go to the Riverside Trailer and deal with someone named Ortega. When you 
  get there then you need to ram the trailer into the river. After ramming 
  the trailer into the river then you will confront Ortega. You can let him 
  live or let him go. After dealing with him then get back to the truck and 
  go back to Ron's place. This will end the mission successfully.

0===========0
| 100% Score \
0=======================>

  >>No Survivors
    ************
      You need to kill all fleeing bikers. This is probably one of the 
      harder Requirements to get. Before tackling this one it may be best to 
      max your Shooting Skill and have lots of ammo for your Carbine Rifle. 
      Based on some research over at GTAForums what you need to do is to work 
      your way clockwise from your starting point around the edge of the 
      park. Do not attack anybody in the center.

      Use the trailers as cover as you proceed around and kill everybody with 
      the Carbine Rifle. There will be a one in a truck that will stop near 
      the entrance and a couple on bikes. Keep going around the perimeter of 
      the park until you reach the north end. When you get there then stay 
      here and let the bikers come to you.

      When you get down to the last four, and they should be near the center, 
      then they will flash blue and red and will make a run for it. These 
      are the ones you need to kill for the Requirement. Because they should 
      be close together then they should also be running in roughly the same 
      direction - south and out of the park. Run behind them and shoot 
      them in the back as they flee.

      Even if they disappear from the radar they should still be alive so 
      continue to follow and kill them - even chasing them into the hills if 
      need be.

  >>Headshots (12)
    **************

  >>Time (12:00)
    ************
      If you went around and got some weapons on the initial play-through 
      then you will have to do this in a Mission Replay. With the advanced 
      weapons the gang battle becomes easier as you can kill them quicker and 
      just let the survivors flee.

  >>Trailer Trashed
    ***************
      You need to cause $5,000 worth of damage to Ortega's Trailer. Smashing 
      into it and pushing it into the water should be enough to get this 
      Requirement.

  >>Lost and Damned
    ***************
      You need to kill Terry and Clay during the chase. They go down easy 
      regardless of weapon used so this isn't hard to get.

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

  You will also open up the Tattoo Parlors. In addition, you will get a "C" 
  on your map indicating a Chinese contact as well as a "?" which indicates a 
  Stranger mission. You will also be notified about Off-Road Racing which 
  will open a marker in Raton Canyon. You will also see a property purchase 
  in Los Santos. This is a garage that Trevor can use and costs $30,000.

  You also won't be allowed to switch to either Franklin or Michael for now. 
  And, if you go into Stab City as Trevor, any Lost that see you will 
  automatically become hostile to you. A little bit later you will open a "T" 
  marker at your Safehouse.

  But, before we go further.....

  0==================================0
 / The Main Story \+++++++++++++++++++\
0==========================================================================\
| >MSY5. Trevor Philips                                                     +
0==========================================================================/

Trevor is also a former bank robber who worked with Michael. He is a loner
who now lives in Sandy Shores. Unlike Michael, Trevor lives in a beat up
mobile home. He runs a meth lab and is in competition from various gangs.

Trevor starts off with $108,654, a Pistol, and a Pump Shotgun. Of course, how
much money you have at this point depends on how much you spent during the
last mission. His personal vehicle is the Bohdi.

Trevor's Special Ability is to enter into Rage Mode while on foot. This makes
him much harder to kill and his weapons become more powerful. This will give
him an advantage in combat.

            /=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=\
 /=========================================================================\
| >GHF27. Building Up Trevor                                                |
 \=========================================================================/
            \=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=/

Just like with Michael you should go around and build up Trevor's Skills just
like you did with Mike using the various tricks already outlined. Even though
you should have some spending money it is recommended to do some laps around
the state collecting Hidden Packages to get some more for later in the game.

            /=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=\
 /=========================================================================\
| >GHF28. Off-Road Races                                                    |
 \=========================================================================/
            \=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=/

One of the other things that are opened at this point are the Off-Road Races.
The first one, Canyon Cliffs, is located at the west end of Raton Pass. There
are a total of six races with a variety of vehicles and there is no entry
fee. For each race won you will earn $500.

Each race is required for 100% Completion. By acquiring Gold in an any
Off-Road race you will also add towards the {Multi-Disciplined}
Accomplishment. Unlike with the Street Races each race will unlock after you
complete the previous one:

0==============0
| Canyon Cliffs \
0=========================================================>

  This race is easy and even easier if you have maxed out your Driving Skill. 
  You will race on a quad bike and your rivals will be riding a mixture of 
  bikes and quad bikes. The race goes from one end of Raton Pass to the other 
  end.

  You can easily knock off the other riders by smacking into them and get 
  into first place quickly. After that then drive quickly but conservatively 
  so you don't crash on the course. In addition to the money you win you will 
  also add the Moto X Outfit to your wardrobe.

0==========0
| Ridge Run \
0=========================================================>

  This race is located in Great Chaparral and you race in an offroad vehicle. 
  You can't really knock these guys around too much but you can easily jostle 
  past them in the turns to get into first place easily. After getting into 
  first place then focus on the course so you don't end up off the road and 
  losing position.

0================0
| Mineward Spiral \
0=========================================================>

  This race is located at Davis Quartz and can only be done between 20:00 and 
  3:00. This course has a lot of twists and turns but it isn't too hard. You 
  will be racing on a motobike so knocking off other riders isn't a 
  possibility.

  But you can really turn into the corners and this will allow you to get 
  into first place quickly. Focus on the course after that and you should win 
  easily.

0=============0
| Valley Trail \
0=========================================================>

  This race is located near the Calafia Bridge and runs from there to an 
  intersection close to the Great Ocean Highway. This race is a little 
  tougher to stay in first place because there are some straightaways that 
  will allow the other riders to keep up with you. But it still not hard to 
  stay in front since most of them tend to wreck behind you.

0================0
| Lakeside Splash \
0=========================================================>

  This race is located in Sandy Shores and runs from there to Grapeseed. This 
  is another easy race as there is plenty of room to get by your rivals. Once 
  in first place then focus on the course until the end of the race.

0=============0
| Eco Friendly \
0=========================================================>

  This course is located at Ron Alternatives Wind Farm. This is easily the 
  hardest of the races but not because of the course. It is because of your 
  vehicle. But how hard the race will be will be determined by the vehicle 
  you end up with.

  If you are in the BF Injection then the race will be easier because it is a 
  good handling car. If you end up in the other SUV type then the race will 
  be harder because it is a piece of shit - slow, handles poorly, spins out, 
  and rolls over easily.

  It's hard enough to get a handle on the SUV let alone the course and your 
  rivals. This may take you a couple of tries as you get the hang of the car 
  long enough to finally win the race.

With that done, let's move on.....

  0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0
 / Trevor Philips \
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+\
| >TVR1. Nervous Ron                                                        0
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+/
| Overview /                                             \ Trevor Philips /
0=========0                                               0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0

  The Lost went over to Trevor's house and smashed up his place. Considering 
  how much of a pig sty his house is this doesn't amount to a whole lot. 
  However, Trevor is upset that they smashed his Impotent Rage figure. Wade 
  walks in while Trevor is looking over his trashed house. Trevor once again 
  instructs him to find Michael. After chasing off Wade then Trevor needs to 
  go over to Ammu-Nation.....

0========0
| Weapons \
0=======================>

  --Assault Rifle.
  --Carbine Rifle.
  --Sniper Rifle (provided).

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  Get onto the ATV and Trevor tells Ron to check Sandy Shore Airfield. When 
  you get to Ammu-Nation then get the Sniper Rifle, which is free, and the 
  Suppressor and Advanced Scope for it, which is also free. You will, 
  however, have to purchase some ammo for it (I recommend about 250 rounds 
  just to be extra safe).

  From here, head to the water tower where Ron is waiting. Climb up to the 
  top and wait. Ron will make his way to a point near the airfield. Bring 
  your sights on him to start things off. He will point out a biker that is 
  standing near the control tower. Kill him then shoot out the three nearby 
  lights as a Lost van approaches. Wait for the van to stop and the driver to 
  emerge before killing him.

  Next you need to kill a guard on the top of the tower then one at the 
  bottom then another one at the top. After that then train your sights on 
  Ron again. He will lead you to another building. You will need to kill 
  another guard and his buddy that will emerge from the building. After that 
  then Ron will continue moving. Another guard will drive up on a bike. Kill 
  him before Ron is discovered.

  Then a chopper will show up. Quickly move the scope up and shoot the pilot. 
  This will cause the aircraft to go down and you will go back to ground 
  level. Now you need to secure the airstrip from The Lost. If you maxed out 
  your Shooting and Strength Skill as well as use the Carbine Rifle this will 
  become easier.

  Use cover and pick off all of The Lost guarding the airstrip. When you 
  clear them out then get in the Plane. Actually you get on the wing and Ron 
  will drive you to the next one. At this point more Lost will show up. Kill 
  them from the wing using the Assault Rifle (you cannot switch to another 
  weapon). Take advantage of the tanker and blow it up to kill several of the 
  bikers.

  Some of them will come from behind and you will turn slow while on the 
  wing. Continue to kill the bikers until you arrive at the next plane. Take 
  off even though you have a biker hanging from the wing. After getting in 
  the air he will eventually fall off. Follow Ron along the canyon until you 
  get to the ocean.

  From here, you need to follow Ron to a contact who is buying the guns you 
  are currently stealing. Avoid Fort Zancudo and drop the cargo in the 
  designated area. After that then race Ron back to McKenzie Airfield in 
  Grapeseed. Carefully land the plane and drive it into the hangar to 
  successfully complete the mission.

0===========0
| 100% Score \
0=======================>

  >>Headshots (5)
    *************

  >>Time (12:30)
    ************
      You have to move fast between the start, Ammu-Nation, and the water 
      tower since there is little room for error afterwards. Killing The Lost 
      quickly during the gunbattle will also help.

  >>Nervous Twitch
    **************
      You need to win the race against Ron. This is very easy to do and you 
      will probably get this during your initial play-through.

  >>6 Bridges, 1 Plane
    ******************
      You need to fly under any six bridges found along the flight path. This 
      is fairly easy to do since most of them are large and easy to fly 
      under. Put the landing gear down to slow down the plane and help keep 
      it under control when flying under them.

      More than likely, if you followed the guide, then this should be the 
      first time you will fly under these bridges thus completing part of the 
      "Under the Bridge" activity.

      Since you will gain Flying Skill by going under these bridges for the 
      first time then you should max out Trevor's Flying Skill by obtaining 
      this Requirement. Trevor's Flight Skill is pretty high to begin with so 
      you only needed to do a little bit to get it to its maximum.

  >>Death on a Wing
    ***************
      You need to kill all of the bikers while on the wing. You pretty much 
      need to kill all of them just to survive.

0=======0

0=======================>

  $62,680.

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

  You will also open up some of the Businesses:

    >>The Hen House - $80,000.
    >>McKenzie Field (Trevor only) - $150,000.
    >>Los Santos Customs (Grand Senora Desert) (Franklin only) - $349,000.
    >>Hookie's - $600,000.

  I will go over them later in the guide. You will also acquire the Sandy 
  Shores Airfield which will become your property. You will also get another 
  Stranger encounter marker but I will deal with that later. You will also 
  get another message from Los Santos Customs informing you of more car 
  modifications.

  You will also get a message from Ammu-Nation informing you of the 
  availability of the Sniper Rifle. If you are thinking of going back and 
  purchasing the maximum amount of ammo for it you should consider whether or 
  not you want to do the Cletus Stranger encounter which are not required for 
  100% Completion.

  After completing his second encounter, "Fair Game", you will lose all but 
  ten rounds of ammo for the Rifle. Considering that it costs $18,000 for 
  maxing it out that's a lot of money to lose. If you wish to do his 
  encounters then you should keep the ammo amount low until you finish.

  But, before I go further.....

At this point the vast majority of Encounters will now open up. There is a
only a few more left but they will appear later on. Although these actually
open up after "Mr. Philips" it is best to do these after "Nervous Ron" so you
can free up your Safehouse to sleep if you need to make certain Encounters
appear.

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

  >>Stag Do Running Man
    *******************
      Neighborhood: Zancudo River, on Route 68 just east of the Zancudo River 
                    Ammu-Nation.
      Map: (D-3).
      -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      Notes: It is probably best to use a fast car for this one. You will 
             encounter a nearly naked man tied to a telephone post. The man 
             is going to be married and needs his suit and other stuff. Take 
             him to his home in Vinewood Hills. You have a five minute timer 
             to complete the Encounter.

             When you get to his home then you have to switch cars and wait 
             for him to come back out. Next, drive him to Hookie's to pick up 
             the best man. Then head up to the Church in Paleto Bay to 
             successfully complete the Encounter.
      -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    ++Reward: The Super Diamond car (if you choose to keep it in a garage).

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

  >>Car Thief 1
    ***********
      Neighborhood: North Chumash, on the Great Ocean Highway near Hookie's.
      Map: (C-2).
      -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      Notes: Chase down the target vehicle and kill the driver with your 
             Pistol (using the Micro SMG can risk damaging the car too much). 
             After killing the driver and acquiring the vehicle then take it 
             back to its owner to successfully complete the Encounter.
      -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    ++Reward: 5% Driving Skill.

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

  >>Border Patrol 3
    ***************
      Neighborhood: Raton Canyon, just west of the railroad tracks. From the 
                    Calafia Bridge, head south for a bit until you get to a 
                    fork in the road. Take the left fork to get onto the road 
                    where the Encounter occurs.
      Map: (C-4).
      -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      Notes: You will be approached from behind by a trio of rednecks who 
             think you are an immigrant. They will fire on you with Sawed-Off 
             Shotguns and are very accurate with them and will kill you 
             quickly if you don't take immediate action.

             But, you will hear them before they will appear on your radar. 
             When you do then immediately get out of your vehicle and 
             activate your Special. Use your Assault Shotgun to put them down 
             before they can do any damage.
      -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    ++Reward: Whatever money and ammo they drop.

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

  >>Deal Gone Wrong
    ***************
      Neighborhood: Chiliad Mountain State Wilderness, at a dead-end dirt 
                    road on Bell's Pass just northeast of the bridge on Great 
                    Ocean Highway that crosses Cassidy Creek.
      Map: (C-3).
      -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      Notes: You will encounter several red blips on the screen. Although 
             there is quite a bit of carnage there are survivors. Go to the 
             one on the lower area to find a suitcase. Grab it and go back to 
             your vehicle. After driving a short distance you will be 
             ambushed from behind by a couple of gunmen on bikes. Drive-by 
             them with the Micro SMG to put them down.
      -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    ++Reward: $25,000.

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

  >>Burial
    ******
      Neighborhood: Paleto Bay, near the east end of Procopio Promenade and 
                    at the south side of the beach park at the northeast end 
                    of the town.
      Map: (A-4).
      -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      Notes: This should probably be done at night. Two thugs are trying to 
             bury a tied up woman. Keep some distance, get out of your 
             vehicle, and kill them both with the Carbine Rifle. (be careful 
             not to hit the woman or you will fail the Encounter).

             After rescuing her then take her to Vinewood Hills. Along the 
             way you find out she is the daughter of a powerful mobster (and 
             drops some names that should be familiar to those who played GTA 
             IV). When you drop her off at her destination then the Encounter 
             is successfully completed.
      -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    ++Reward: Shortly after the Encounter you will get a phone call from her 
              and you will be given $60,000. You could also take her to the 
              Cultists but, because of the large amount of money involved, it 
              is highly recommended that you rescue her instead.

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

  >>Crash Rescue
    ************
      Neighborhood: Mount Chiliad, on the Great Ocean Highway between the 
                    Procopio Truck Stop and the Braddock Tunnel.
      Map: (B-5).
      -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      Notes: You will encounter a crashed vehicle with a dead body nearby. 
             But you will also find a survivor alongside the road. You need 
             to take her to Sandy Shores.

             Turns out she was part of a small crew that knocked over a pawn 
             shop but was ambushed by the Cops. Then her partner decided to 
             ambush her while they were fleeing the Cops - this caused the 
             crash. Take her to her friends in Sandy Shores to successfully 
             complete the Encounter.
      -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    ++Reward: You will add Taliana Martinez to the list of potential Crew 
              members for later Heists. I highly recommend that you do this 
              one as soon as possible since she is almost as good as Eddie 
              Toh and a hell of a lot cheaper.
