| A. The Altruist Cult |~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~\
0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0

After the mission "Mr. Philips" go and check your emails. One of them will be
from Ron. He will tell you about this place in the hills where the people are
looking for lost souls to save. They apparently want to have them for dinner
although it appears that Ron has misunderstood what it actually means (the
Cultists are actually cannibals).

As noted earlier, when you do certain Encounters as Trevor you can take
people up to the Cult instead of their actual destination. You can get $1,000
per person you take up there. The first person you deliver to them will also
get you the {Altruist Acolyte} Accomplishment.

You can deliver up to four people up to them. When you deliver the last
person to them then they will turn on you and you will be involved in a major
shootout with them.

When the fight starts then use your Special and kill the others nearby with
your Carbine Rifle and Assault Shotgun. Then head to the large building to
your left and use it as cover as you kill off most of the others. Go on the
covered porch to get some Body Armor and continue to kill off the remaining
Cultists. Some of them are on higher ground.

After killing all of them off then go around the Compound. In addition to the
weapons, Health, and Armor that normally spawn there you will also find four
briefcases that contain $25,000 each (for a total of $100,000). They can be
found on the porches of the homes on the west side of the Compound. Killing
all of the Cultists will also cause them to disappear from the game which
will make it easier to go in and out of the Compound.

Listed below are the Encounters where you can take people up to the Compound,
whether or not you should deliver them to the Cult, and why (rewards are
based on money not Skill increase):

0=====================================================================0
| Getaway Driver     | No  | Unlocks Packie for Heists, $1,000 reward |
|--------------------+-----+------------------------------------------|
| Snatched           | Yes | No reward                                |
|--------------------+-----+------------------------------------------|
| Escape Paparazzi   | Yes | Very small reward                        |
|--------------------+-----+------------------------------------------|
| Burial             | No  | $60,000 reward                           |
|--------------------+-----+------------------------------------------|
| Drunk Driver 1     | Yes | Very small reward                        |
|--------------------+-----+------------------------------------------|
| Drunk Driver 2     | Yes | Very small reward, two victims           |
|--------------------+-----+------------------------------------------|
| Hitch Lift 2       | No  | Unlock Ursula for Booty Calls            |
|--------------------+-----+------------------------------------------|
| Hitch Lift 3       | Yes | No reward                                |
|--------------------+-----+------------------------------------------|
| Hitch Lift 4       | Yes | No reward                                |
|--------------------+-----+------------------------------------------|
| Domestic           | No  | Unlock Golfing partner                   |
0=====================================================================0

As you can see there are plenty of opportunities for victims. If you've
followed the guide then you should've done "Getaway Driver" already to get
the use of Packie for the Vangelico Heist.

It should also be pointed out that, according to EarlJensen, the Hitch Lift
Encounters don't unlock until after the mission "Friends Reunited". In
addition, if you deliver one of the hitchhikers from any of the Hitch Lifts,
then you might not be able to activate any of the other Hitch Lift
Encounters.

So, at this point in the game, this leaves about six Encounters, more than
enough to get the victims you need.  My recommendations, in order, are
"Snatched" (or, if you don't want to fight The Lost, "Escape Paparazzi"),
"Drunk Driver 2", and "Drunk Driver 1".

With all of this done I will go to one of the Stranger encounters starting
with the one in southeast Grapeseed.....

            /=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=\
 /=========================================================================\
| >GHF30. Special Bonds (Maude)                                             |
 \=========================================================================/
            \=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=/

Maude is a bail bondsman and requires others to bring in those who have fled.
Doing bounty hunter work is *NOT* required for 100% Completion but doing one
and bringing the target back alive will get you the {Wanted: Alive or Alive}
Accomplishment.

Even though it is not required for Completion percentage you can earn up to
$10,000 per person you bring in alive. There are a total of four targets to
chase down and you can earn up to a total of $40,000. Not bad money. You
should use a car for these bounties as your targets won't go on bikes.

When you start a bounty you need to get away from Maude then she will email
you the whereabouts of the target. After the first target it usually takes
about twelve hours before you get the email for the next target. After
bringing in the target she will email you again with the next one. Listed
below are the four targets:

0================0
| Ralph Ostrowski \
0=========================================================>

  He will be at the lowest part of Davis Quarry. As you approach him he will 
  go to his vehicle. As he is getting in then blow out the front tires with 
  your Micro SMG. This will stop the chase before it can begin. Once he gets 
  out then approach him. Lead him to your vehicle, let him get in, and drive 
  him to Maude to successfully complete the bounty.

0=============0
| Larry Tupper \
0=========================================================>

  He will be hiding out at an abandoned barn in the Great Chaparral area. The 
  barn is near where you found Letter Scrap [LCY-LS22]. You should sneak up 
  the hillside from the east with a Sniper Rifle.

  There are four people there including your target. Snipe the two inside the 
  truck to get things started. Your target will run and the remaining 
  survivor will attack. Ignore him and go after your bounty. Even if he gets 
  way ahead of you you will still have no problem catching up to him.

  Either nail him with your Stun Gun or hit him to bring him down. Then take 
  him back to your vehicle and to Maude's to successfully complete the 
  bounty.

0===============0
| Glenn Scoville \
0=========================================================>

  He will be hiding out at the top of Mount Chiliad. When you get to the top 
  of the mountain grab the Parachute found at the Cable Car building as you 
  will need it. Glenn will be at the south side of the top of the peak.

  As you approach he will jump before you can get at him. Jump behind him and 
  open your Parachute. He will be far ahead of you but keep up. He will land 
  near the Alamo Sea. The next task is to land on him.

  Aim yourself as you are coming down and you should land on him or, at the 
  very least, get close to him. Regardless, either nail him with the Stun Gun 
  or hit him just to be sure.

  Once you have him then you need to procure a vehicle since either you left 
  yours at the top of the mountain or you took the Cable Car. You will need 
  to jack a car from the nearby road and take Glenn to Maude to successfully 
  complete the bounty.

0==============0
| Curtis Weaver \
0=========================================================>

  He will be hiding at Dignity Village which is across the Great Ocean 
  Highway just southwest of the Procopio Truck Stop in north Mount Chiliad. 
  When you enter the encampment then get out of your vehicle and walk towards 
  the west end.

  As you get close then he will appear on the radar and fire on you with a 
  Pistol. Rush him and he will start running. Get close to him and either hit 
  him or use your Stun Gun. After he surrenders then lead him to your vehicle 
  and take him to Maude to successfully complete your last bounty.

From here, head back to Sandy Shores and to the next Stranger contact.....

| >TVR2. Trevor Philips Industries                                          0

| Overview /                                             \ Trevor Philips /
0=========0                                               0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0

  Trevor meets Mr. Tao Cheng Jr. who appears to be pretty high on something. 
  This upsets Trevor and walks out. But Mr. Cheng's translator convinces him 
  to do business.....

0========0
| Weapons \
0=======================>

  --Carbine Rifle.
  --Grenade Launcher (provided).

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  First order of business is to go to the Meth Lab. Along the way Trevor 
  calls Chef, the meth cooker. Chef tells him that the Aztecas are coming 
  because they think Trevor took down their boss. So Trevor is needed to help 
  defend the operation.

  When they get there Trevor puts the Chinese in "cold storage" while the 
  defend the kitchen. When Ortega's men arrive then you need to kill them. 
  Use the red propane tanks near the vehicles to destroy most of them 
  quickly. When one of them breaks through the gate then follow Chef outside. 

  Blow up the large gas tanker to kill most of them and use your Carbine 
  Rifle to finish off anybody left. Then follow Chef again to the other side 
  of the building. Here you need to deal with another group of Aztecas. Use 
  the red propane tanks and motorcycles to blow up most of them.

  Chef will tell you he has a weapon for you - a Grenade Launcher. Use it to 
  blow up any survivors. Follow Chef again to the lower floor. Shoot up 
  anybody who comes through the front door.

  Eventually you will meet Ortega again (even if you killed him in the 
  mission "Mr. Philips"). Kill him then all of the remaining survivors will 
  flee. Then Trevor will go and get the Chinese out of the ice box to 
  successfully complete the mission.

    *********

    ***********

  first.....

| >SFK13. Fair Game (Cletus)                                                0
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+/
| Overview /                                         \ Strangers (Trevor) /
0=========0                                           0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0

  Now Cletus wants Trevor's help in hunting elk.....

0========0
| Weapons \
0=======================>

  Sniper Rifle (provided).

0======0
| Notes \
0=======================>

  This encounter also contains a well known Wanted Rating exploit. After 
  Cletus leads you into the forest then sneak away and drive anywhere you 
  please. You can fully explore both Fort Zancudo and Los Santos 
  International Airport without any Police interference. You can use this to 
  acquire the otherwise hard to get Minigun for your Weapon Wheel and a 
  military jet, or helicopter, for the Sandy Shores Airfield hangar.

  When you are doing the exploit you will notice that the engine noises of 
  your vehicles are greatly muted. There will also be very little or no 
  traffic on the roads. In addition, you can fail the mission by blowing up 
  something or running over people.

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  As you walk, Cletus will give you some information on elk hunting. The main 
  thing is to stay downwind of it or it may catch your scent and run away 
  before you can do anything. You will now see a wind direction marker at the 
  lower right corner of the screen. You want the marker to be either pointing 
  towards you or away from the Elk.

  Go into Stealth Mode and enter the red circle when the wind marker is where 
  you want it. Find the first Elk. It should be behind some rocks and bushes. 
  It's hard to see so wait for it to raise its head. Although you can shoot 
  it in the head it is better to get a body shot, specifically the area below 
  its neck. After killing the first Elk then follow Cletus.

  He will tell you to use the Elk Whistle. Use it and another one will appear 
  nearby. You can see it easily even though you are out of the red circle. 
  Once again nail it with a body shot. After that then follow Cletus again. 

  Use the Elk Whistle again to bring a mating pair. Cletus only wants you to 
  kill the male Elk - he will have antlers. The problem is that there are 
  some large bushes and trees in the way so you will have to move to a point 
  west of them to get a good shot. After killing the male Elk then Cletus 
  will leave. But he will tell you to hunt another Elk and send a picture of 
  it.

  After he leaves then use the Elk Whistle to find any nearby Elks. When one 
  appears then find it and kill it with a body shot. Approach the dead Elk, 
  bring out your phone, and use the camera function to take a picture of it. 
  Send the picture to Cletus and he will call you. This will end the 
  encounter successfully.

0===========0
| 100% Score \
0=======================>

  >>Downwind
    ********
      You need to do this mission without being detected by any Elk. This is 
      fairly easy to get since the wind seems to be facing you most of the 
      time.

  >>Heart Hunter
    ************
      You need to kill three Elk with a heart shot. This is also pretty easy 
      to do if you go for the body shot each time.

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

  This will also end Cletus' encounters and you will get the Hunting Outfit 
  added to your wardrobe. As noted before, you will lose all but ten rounds 
  of Sniper Rifle ammo after this encounter. It is recommended that you go 
  back to Ammu-Nation to refill it, especially for the next mission at hand.

  You will now open up the Hunting icon where you can hunt animals and make 
  some money. This activity is *NOT* required for 100% Completion so I won't 
  be covering it.

  Now let's go to the next Stranger contact in Sandy Shores.....

            /=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=\
 /=========================================================================\
| >GHF31. Rampages                                                          |
 \=========================================================================/
            \=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=/

This Stranger marker isn't really a encounter but the first of five Rampages
that can only be done by Trevor. The Rampages are *NOT* required for 100%
Completion but doing them all will earn you the {Red Mist} Accomplishment.
The other four Rampages will unlock later in the game.

During the cutscene Trevor takes a weapon, an Assault Rifle, from one of the
rednecks and proceeds to go nuts. This will start the Rampage.

The Rampages in GTA V work similar to those you did in GTA3 and Vice City.
You have a specific weapon with unlimited ammo that you use to kill your
targets. For this Rampage you use an unmodified Assault Rifle to kill
Rednecks. You also have the use of twenty five Grenades to blow up vehicles
and clusters of tagets.

You have two minutes to kill twenty five Rednecks. Overall this isn't too
hard to do. Even though you are in a kind of rage you can still use your
Special to inflict even more damage. Having your Shooting, Stamina, and
Strength Skills maxed will make this easier.

Killing the minimum required for the Rampage is pretty easy. But there are
also Gold Requirements to go after as well. In this case you need to kill 45
Rednecks, blow up two cars, and get three headshots. These are not too hard
to get but what makes this a little bit harder is unlike the Requirements in
the other missions you have to get all three Requirements at one time - you
can't just focus on one.

The best way to get Gold is to use Assisted Aiming which will help you lock
onto a target allowing you to kill him quickly so you can quickly move onto
the next one. This is pretty much the only way to get Gold, even if you don't
like Assisted Aiming.

To start, focus on getting to the kill Requirement as quickly as possible. As
you get near the number then focus on headshots and vehicle destruction.
Although this might sound crazy it is better to stay on open ground instead
of cover. This will give you a better chance of hitting more targets. For the
most part your targets will be using Pistols which won't do much damage.

When vehicles approach try to kill the people inside - this will give you
some easy headshots. This will also keep them from running you over. They
won't do a whole lot of damage if they hit you but will slow you down as you
will need to get up off the ground.

Once you get the hang of this strategy this will make the other Rampages
easier as this will apply to all of them but with minor tweaks.

Getting one Gold in the Rampages will count towards the {Solid Gold, Baby!}
Accomplishment.

Now let's move on.....

 / Trevor Philips \

| >TVR3. Crystal Maze                                                       0
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+/
| Overview /                                             \ Trevor Philips /
0=========0                                               0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0

  When Trevor meets Mr. Cheng Jr. again he finds that they want to go a 
  different route. This upsets Trevor and threatens them to tell him who they 
  are working for. That turns out to be the O'Neil brothers. Now he needs to 
  deal with these competitors.....

0========0
| Weapons \
0=======================>

  --Sniper Rifle (silenced).
  --Carbine Rifle (silenced).

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  To start, go to O'Neils Ranch. When you get to the marker then go to the 
  top of the hill. Use the Sniper Rifle and snipe those at the Ranch. Kill 
  them quickly before anybody is alarmed. If you alarm the guards then they 
  will head to your position which will make it much harder on you. They 
  carry a mixture of weapons and can kill you easily unless you get rid of 
  them quickly.

  Take advantage of those standing one behind the other since the Sniper 
  Rifle can shoot through more than one target. In addition, there will be a 
  van parked in front. At one side of the house you will see a pair of 
  workers rolling some barrels around a corner. Then they, along with 
  another, will get in the van and drive off. Let them go as this will make 
  it easier to snipe the others without risking alarm.

  After dealing with those outside then head to the ranch house. However, 
  don't go to the front door. Instead, go to the back door and sneak in 
  (assuming you didn't alarm anybody).

  After sneaking inside then gently look right and shoot the first guy you 
  see in the head to put him down quietly. Head to the hallway and go left. 
  You should get to the kitchen but look to the right when you get to the 
  entranceway. You should see the back of someone. Snipe him then move left 
  quickly and snipe his partner before he can sound the alarm.

  After that then turn left and look through the other kitchen entranceway. 
  You should see three guards sitting and watching TV. Snipe all three of 
  them quickly. You will probably alarm the remaining guards at this point 
  but all that would be left are three and they are near the stairs leading 
  down into the basement.

  After killing them then go downstairs and kill the one person at the lab. 
  Now you have to use the Jerry Can and make a trail leading outside. Pour 
  the gas using the Fire Button and follow the yellow trail. When you get 
  outside and finish then use any firearm to ignite the gas. After you blow 
  up the ranch house then get away from it to successfully complete the 
  mission.

0===========0
| 100% Score \
0=======================>

  >>Headshots (10)
    **************
      This is actually tougher than it sounds. You can kill several of the 
      first group of guards with headshots but you will need to do it quietly 
      so you don't alert them otherwise it will be harder to get what you 
      need. If you can quietly get into the ranch house then it will be much 
      easier to get the remainder since they will be either standing or 
      sitting.

  >>Unmarked
    ********

  >>2 Birds 1 Stone
    ***************
      You need to kill two enemies with one shot. There are a couple of 
      opportunities to get this with the first group and is easy to get.

  >>Accuracy (80%)
    **************

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

  At this point the Jerry Can will now become available at all Ammu-Nations.

| >TVR4. Friends Reunited                                                   0
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+/
| Overview /                                             \ Trevor Philips /
0=========0                                               0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0

  When Trevor arrives back at his home he finds Wade waiting for him. Wade 
  wasn't able to find Michael Townley but found a Michael De Santa with a 
  wife named Amanda. This was what Trevor wanted to know. He then gives Ron 
  control of Trevor Philips Enterprises and goes off to Los Santos.....

0========0
| Weapons \
0=======================>

  --Pistol (silenced).
  --Sticky Bomb (provided).

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  To start, you need to go to the Trailer Park. Trevor needs to do something 
  else before leaving. It turns out that another chapter of The Lost has 
  arrived and Trevor needs to do something about it.

  When you get there you need to plant Sticky Bombs on the trailers within 
  the park. You will also be given a Silenced Pistol, assuming you don't have 
  one already. Carefully sneak inside the park and go in a clockwise 
  direction.

  As you reach the first trailer you will see red dots appear. These are the 
  bikers you need to either kill or avoid. Like the Cops they have vision 
  cones so you know where they are looking. It is best to avoid killing any 
  of the bikers because their bodies may be discovered. If you are found out 
  then you will be attacked and your task becomes harder.

  After planting the first bomb then angle towards the nearest trailer inside 
  the loop. Stay near the north end of the trailer as there will be a couple 
  of bikers riding away. After planting the bomb then head back to the outer 
  edge and continue clockwise. Jump over the next fence and plant the next 
  bomb. There will be a couple of guards nearby but don't worry about them. 

  After planting the bomb then jump the fence at the outside edge and 
  continue clockwise. Plant the next bomb and head close to the entrance. 
  What you should do is approach the last trailer from the south since there 
  are a couple of guards nearby.

  After planting all five Sticky Bombs then get a safe distance away and 
  detonate them before leaving the park. After that then return to Wade 
  despite the fact that you will now be attacked by The Lost.

  From here, head to the marker in Los Santos. After the little cutscene then 
  return to your vehicle and drive to Wade's Cousin's Apartment. When you get 
  there then follow Wade upstairs to successfully complete the mission.

0===========0
| 100% Score \
0=======================>

  >>Headshots (5)
    *************
      You will need to get into a firefight with The Lost to get this one. 
      Killing off the survivors after the explosions is a good way to get 
      this.

  >>Mystery Gift
    ************
      You need to destroy the trailers without being detected.

  >>Unmarked
    ********

  >>Perfect Gift
    ************
      You need to plant all five bombs and destroy all the trailers at once.

0=======0

0=======================>

  Nothing but you will now have Floyd's Apartment as a Safehouse.

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

  also get a message from Ron about the Flight School at Los Santos

    >>Towing Impound (Franklin only) - $150,000.
    >>Downtown Cab Co. (Franklin only) - $200,000.
    >>Smoke on the Water (Franklin only) - $204,000.
    >>Car Scrapyard - $275,000.
    >>Pitchers - $750,000.

            /=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=\
 /=========================================================================\
| >GHF32. Flight School                                                     |
 \=========================================================================/
            \=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=/

The Flight School is located just before the runway fence at the Airport.
There are twelve lessons that you need to get at least a Bronze in for one
character for 100% Completion. Acquiring a Gold Medal will count towards the
{Multi-Disciplined} Accomplishment. You can only do the lessons in order -
the next one won't unlock until you successfully pass the current one.

In addition, you will increase your Flying Skill as you complete the lessons.
The higher the medal, the greater the increase. This is by far the fastest
way to increase your Flying Skill.

0===========================================================================0
| ++Training Take Off       | This is very easy to get Gold in. Pull back   |
|   =================       | on the Left Analog Stick just as soon as you  |
|     --Bronze: 60 seconds  | get moving and retract your landing gear the  |
|     --Silver: 50 seconds  | moment you get in the air. This will give you |
|     --Gold: 32 seconds    | the speed you need to get through the         |
|                           | checkpoints quickly enough for the medal.     |
|---------------------------+-----------------------------------------------|
| ++Runway Landing          | To get Gold you need to quickly descend and   |
|   ==============          | fly close to the ground before bringing down  |
|     --Bronze: 1:10        | your landing gear. Slow down enough to land   |
|     --Silver: 55 seconds  | and stop in the last marker to successfully   |
|     --Gold: 35 seconds    | complete this lesson.                         |
|---------------------------+-----------------------------------------------|
| ++Inverted Flight         | To get Gold you need to perform the necessary |
|   ===============         | moves as quickly as possible. After going     |
|     --Bronze: 2:20        | through the first checkpoint then fly north   |
|     --Silver: 2:00        | over the water so you don't risk crashing     |
|     --Gold: 1:40          | when you do the multiple rolls. Pretty easy   |
|                           | to get Gold in.                               |
|---------------------------+-----------------------------------------------|
| ++Knife Flight            | To get Gold you need to perform the moves as  |
|   ============            | quickly as possible. After the first          |
|     --Bronze: 1:40        | checkpoint then fly out over the water.       |
|     --Silver: 1:15        |                                               |
|     --Gold: 54 seconds    | This should be pretty easy considering the    |
|                           | fact that this plane is a stunt plane that    |
|                           | will allow you do certain moves better than   |
|                           | other planes.                                 |
|---------------------------+-----------------------------------------------|
| ++Flat Hatting            | This is a low altitude course that takes you  |
|   ============            | over the Terminal area. The first third is    |
|     --Bronze: 3:00        | pretty easy. The middle third you will need   |
|     --Silver: 2:35        | to use your rudders to steer but this isn't   |
|     --Gold: 2:15          | too hard even at full speed. The last third   |
|                           | is pretty easy.                               |
|                           |                                               |
|                           | Getting Gold is fairly easy even going at     |
|                           | full speed the whole way.                     |
|---------------------------+-----------------------------------------------|
| ++Touch Down              | Now things get harder. You need to land on a  |
|   ==========              | bridge and stop as close as you can to the    |
|     --Bronze: Finish      | final marker. After going through the first   |
|     --Silver: 45 feet     | marker then hold down the Brake Button until  |
|     --Gold: 10 feet       | your engine stops and glide down to the       |
|                           | bridge.                                       |
|                           |                                               |
|                           | Be careful of the traffic as you land. You    |
|                           | need to touch down close enough to the marker |
|                           | so you don't stop too far.                    |
|                           |                                               |
|                           | When you get to the final marker then use     |
|                           | your Right Rudder to make the plane smack     |
|                           | into the railing and get it to completely     |
|                           | stop. This should be enough for the Gold.     |
|---------------------------+-----------------------------------------------|
| ++Loop the Loop           | To get Gold you need to do the moves as       |
|   =============           | quickly and smoothly as you can. After going  |
|     --Bronze: 2:05        | through the checkpoint then turn left and go  |
|     --Silver: 1:40        | over the water to avoid crashing. While level |
|     --Gold: 1:35          | you should go up at a slight angle to give    |
|                           | you more height for the next stunt.           |
|---------------------------+-----------------------------------------------|
| ++Helicopter Course       | This is a course that takes you through the   |
|   =================       | city and ends with a landing. To get Gold you |
|     --Bronze: 3:45        | need to keep the Ascend Button down the whole |
|     --Silver: 3:15        | time. You can still go down by using the      |
|     --Gold: 2:40          | Descend Button but you won't slow down.       |
|                           |                                               |
|                           | It will probably take a few tries as you get  |
|                           | the hang of the course. There are some        |
|                           | markers you can't go directly at or you will  |
|                           | be forced to slow down.                       |
|                           |                                               |
|                           | Those would be the first one into the city,   |
|                           | the one before the one at the top of the      |
|                           | building, and the one at the control tower.   |
|                           | Swing wide before approaching them and get    |
|                           | them at a better angle to maintain speed.     |
|                           |                                               |
|                           | How you deal with these three will determine  |
|                           | how much time you save.                       |
|---------------------------+-----------------------------------------------|
| ++Helicopter Speed Run    | This is another course that takes you through |
|   ====================    | some of the city and ends with a landing but  |
|     --Bronze: 3:30        | the emphasis is on speed. The course isn't    |
|     --Silver: 3:00        | too hard but it will take you a few tries to  |
|     --Gold: 2:10          | get Gold as you learn the course and how to   |
|                           | shave off time.                               |
|                           |                                               |
|                           | It's a little tough to get Gold because the   |
|                           | time is tight. Getting to the last marker     |
|                           | before you land as quickly as possible will   |
|                           | give you enough time to safely land the       |
|                           | chopper.                                      |
|---------------------------+-----------------------------------------------|
| ++Skydiving               | You need to jump from a high altitude and     |
|   =========               | land on a stationary target. It may take a    |
|     --Bronze: 20 feet     | few tries to get Gold as you learn the        |
|     --Silver: 10 feet     | controls and make better landings, especially |
|     --Gold: 3 feet        | ones where you don't get killed.              |
|---------------------------+-----------------------------------------------|
| ++Drop Zone               | This time you need to jump and land on a      |
|   =========               | moving target. Once again, it may take you a  |
|     --Bronze: 20 feet     | few tries to get Gold as you learn how to     |
|     --Silver: 7 feet      | approach the target from behind and make      |
|     --Gold: 0 feet        | better landings.                              |
|---------------------------+-----------------------------------------------|
| ++Earn Your Wings         | This final lesson requires that you fly       |
|   ===============         | through a course with a stunt plane. There    |
|     --Bronze: 3:40        | will be special markers that you need to      |
|     --Silver: 3:15        | either knife fly or fly upside down through.  |
|     --Gold: 2:50          | This makes the course reasonably tough.       |
|                           |                                               |
|                           | The good news is that the markers are         |
|                           | forgiving so you don't need to be perfect,    |
|                           | just get close enough to doing the stunt and  |
|                           | touch the markers. It may take a few tries to |
|                           | get Gold as you learn the course and perform  |
|                           | the necessary stunts without crashing.        |
0===========================================================================0

            /=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=\
 /=========================================================================\
| >GHF33. Under the Bridge                                                  |
 \=========================================================================/
            \=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=/

For this particular activity you need to fly under most of the many bridges
on the map. There are fifty that can be flown under but you only need to do
25 of them for 100% Completion. Doing all fifty of them, in conjunction with
the Knife Flights (explained next), will earn you the {Close Shave}
Accomplishment.

Although this, along with the Knife Flights, are open from the start of the
game it is best to wait until after opening up the Flight School and maxing
out your Flight Skill to make these tasks easier.

But, even if you don't do the Flight School, you can still increase your
Flight Skill quickly by flying under bridges regardless of character.
However, only the first time under will add to your Skill, just like with the
Stunt Jumps earlier. Flying under the same bridge multiple times will not add
Flying Skill.

The best aircraft for this is the Buzzard that can be found at the top of the
N.O.O.S.E. Building in the Palomino Highlands region (unless you snagged one
from Fort Zancudo using the Wanted Rating Exploit in the mission "Fair Game"
(Cletus) and stored it at the Sandy Shore Airfield).

Most of these bridges aren't difficult but there are some that can be real
tricky. For those bridges it is recommended that you go into first person
mode.

You can't hit the bridge or nearby walls or it won't count. You also need to
move quickly under them or it won't count either. You don't need to go real
fast but a moderate steady speed. Take it slow when approaching so you can
line yourself correctly over the water then gently tilt your aircraft forward
so you can make a smooth run under the bridge.

            /=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=\
 /=========================================================================\
| >GHF34. Knife Flights                                                     |
 \=========================================================================/
            \=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=/

The next activity is the Knife Flights. For this you need to fly a plane
sideways between certain tall buildings, all in Los Santos. Doing the Knife
Flights at the Flight School should give you an idea on what to do here.

Although some people prefer to use a jet it is best to use a much slower
plane to better make adjustments while flying through gaps. There are three
planes you can use for this task:

0===========================================================================0
| Mammatus | These planes tend to land at Sandy Shores Airfield. When one   |
|          | lands then you can grab it and use it for yourself.            |
|          | Unfortunately, this is not a good plane to use for the Knife   |
|          | Flights and should only be used on the easy ones where you can |
|          | fly high off the ground or building.                           |
|----------+----------------------------------------------------------------|
| Duster   | This bi-plane is used around the McKenzie Airfield in          |
|          | Grapeseed. This is a much better plane than the Mammatus but   |
|          | is still a little hard to use with the trickier Knife Flights. |
|----------+----------------------------------------------------------------|
| Mallard  | This plane is only available from the website                  |
|          | www.elitastravel.com. If you collected enough Hidden Packages  |
|          | then you should have enough to purchase the plane ($250,000).  |
|          | It is by far the best plane to use since it is a stunt plane   |
|          | and perfectly suited for this activity.                        |
|          |                                                                |
|          | Of course, you will need a hangar to store it in before you    |
|          | can purchase it so this is best suited for Trevor at this      |
|          | point in the game since he already has one.                    |
0===========================================================================0

When flying around in either of these plane then practice rolling around with
it for awhile before attempting any Knife Flights.

One handy tip: before grabbing a plane you may want to drive around and find
the Knife Flight buildings first. Then mark them on your map using the Points
of Interest markers. You only have ten markers though so you need to be
judicious in using them.

Just before you approach a Knife Flight do a Quick Save. That way if
something goes wrong then you can reload and try again.

There are a total of fifteen Knife Flights but you only need to do eight for
100% Completion. However, doing all fifteen plus all fifty Under the Bridges
will earn you the {Close Shave} Accomplishment. Most of the Knife Flights are
pretty easy but there will be a small number that may give you problems.

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

[KF-1] - Location: The Von Crastenburg Hotel towers located along Playa 
                   Vista.
         Neighborhood: Pacific Bluffs.
         Map: (A-3).
         --------------------------------------------------------------------
         Notes: Can be approached from either direction.

[KF-2] - Location: Between the Lombank Building and the Crastenburg Hotel at 
                   the west end of Boulevard Del Perro.

 - AND -

[KF-3] - Location: Between the Bluff Tower Office Complex and an un-named 
                   office building directly south, and on the same block, as 
                   [KF-2].
         Neighborhood: Del Perro.
         Map: (B-3).
         --------------------------------------------------------------------
         Notes: Because of how these buildings are clustered you will have to 
                do both at once. Follow along W. Eclipse Blvd. and approach 
                from the north. The first gap is narrow and there is a large
                building before it (The Banner Hotel) that will be to your 
                right you will need to avoid or you may crash into it before 
                you get to the gap.

                Roll to the left before you get to The Banner Hotel and pull 
                up on the stick after making the first gap so you can make 
                the second.

[KF-4] - Location: Between a large parking garage and a fancy apartment 
                   building at the west end of The Archipelago just east of 
                   the intersection of Morningwood Blvd. and Marathon Ave. 
                   north of Backlot City.
         Neighborhood: Rockford Hills.
         Map: (B-3).
         --------------------------------------------------------------------
         Notes: This is one of the toughest gaps to fly through. The 
                buildings are low and you have Backlot City to the south and 
                a large building to the north that makes any approach 
                difficult. After multiple failures going from the south I 
                found success going from the north.

                Angle down over the large building then quickly level out 
                before the gap. Quickly roll and fly through the gap then 
                immediately level off and fly over the movie studio the 
                moment the game registers success.

                Reader Sterling P. de Mille had his own suggestion for doing 
                this:

                  "Approach along the road slightly to the north west of the 
                   location over the building adjacent to the one mentioned 
                   in your guide. It is slightly lower and easier to adjust 
                   when going for the knife flight. You just have to get into 
                   knife flight position immediately after going over the 
                   building ahead of it and then press gently on the 
                   thumbstick to turn through the knife flight all while on 
                   your side."

[KF-5] - Location: Between the Richards Majestic Building and the Weazel 
                   Plaza Building at the intersection of Heritage Way and 
                   Movie Star Way.
         Neighborhood: Rockford Hills.
         Map: (B-3).
         --------------------------------------------------------------------
         Notes: Can be approached from either direction (west or east).

[KF-6] - Location: Between the Schlongsberg Sachs Building and the tall 
                   un-named building, with the tall construction crane, south 
                   of it across W. Eclipse Blvd. near the intersection with 
                   Rockford Dr.
         Neighborhood: Rockford Hills.
         Map: (C-2).
         --------------------------------------------------------------------
         Notes: Best to approach this one from the west.

[KF-7] - Location: Between the Schlongsberg Sachs Building and the tall 
                   un-named building north of it across S. Mo Milton Dr. near 
                   the intersection with W. Eclipse Blvd.
         Neighborhood: Rockford Hills.
         Map: (C-2).
         --------------------------------------------------------------------
         Notes: Best to approach this one from the east.

[KF-8] - Location: The twin Lombank Buildings located at the northwest corner 
                   of San Andreas Ave. and Palomino Ave.
         Neighborhood: Little Seoul.
         Map: (C-4).
         --------------------------------------------------------------------
         Notes: Best to approach this one from the south.

[KF-9] - Location: Between the Whirlgig Theater and Vinewood Video Building 
                   across the street south of the Movie Theater.
         Neighborhood: Downtown Vinewood.
         Map: (D-3).
         --------------------------------------------------------------------
         Notes: The buildings are short but this is not too hard if you 
                approach from the north. After you fly over the Theater then 
                immediately roll.

[KF-10] - Location: The gap between the Vinewood Gardens Hotel and an 
                    un-named building at the northeast corner of Power St. 
                    and Spanish Avenue.
          Neighborhood: Hawick.
          Map: (D-3).
          -------------------------------------------------------------------
          Notes: This is a difficult gap because part of it is very narrow. 
                 The south part of this is the narrow part so approach it 
                 from the south. You don't have to get the whole plane in the 
                 narrow part - part of the wing will do. And you can barely 
                 clip the building and still get credit.

[KF-11] - Location: Between the IAA Building and the FIB Building at the 
                    southeast corner of Power St. and Swiss St. in Pillbox 
                    Hill.
          Neighborhood: Pillbox Hill.
          Map: (D-4).
          -------------------------------------------------------------------
          Notes: Can be done either going east or west but it may be best to 
                 go through at a southwest direction so you can also do the 
                 next two Knife Flights in quick succession.

[KF-12] - Location: Between the Schlongberg Sachs and the Go Postal Building 
                    at the northeast corner of Peaceful St. and Vespucci 
                    Blvd. in Pillbox Hill.

 - AND -

[KF-13] - Location: Between the LS Quik Building and the Slaughter, 
                    Slaughter, and Slaughter Building (and over a 
                    red-and-white parking garage) at the southwest corner of 
                    Peaceful St. and San Andreas Ave.
          Neighborhood: Pillbox Hill.
          Map: (D-4).
          -------------------------------------------------------------------
          Notes: These two are relatively close together and can be done at 
                 once if you approach from the northeast. However, if you do 
                 [KF-9] going at a southwest direction, then you can do all 
                 three in one run. After doing [KF-11] then fly past the 
                 large Maze Bank Building and approach [KF-12].

[KF-14] - Location: Between the LS Quik Building and the Go Postal Building 
                    at the intersection of Peaceful St. and Vespucci Blvd.

 - AND - 

[KF-15] - Location: Between the Slaughter, Slaughter, and Slaughter Building 
                    and Schlongberg Sachs Building at the intersection of 
                    Peaceful St. and San Andreas Blvd.
          Neighborhood: Pillbox Hill.
          Map: (C-4).
          -------------------------------------------------------------------
          Notes: These next two gaps involve some of the same buildings used 
                 in the last two. However, you are simply flying along 
                 Peaceful St. and can do both at once. This is best 
                 approached from the south.

            /=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=\
 /=========================================================================\
| >GHF36. Rampages (Part Two)                                               |
 \=========================================================================/
            \=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=/

At this point the remaining Rampages become available. One will open up after
successful completion of the previous one:

  >>Rancho (30 Mexican Gang Members)
    ********************************
      Time: Two minutes.
      Weapon: Micro SMG.
      Gold Requirement: 45 kills, 6 headshots, 2 vehicles destroyed.
      -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      Notes: They will also spawn on rooftops and throw down Molotovs from 
             time to time so kill them quickly. If you are hit by a Molotov 
             this will slow you down as you roll on the ground aflame. One 
             annoyance is that the submachine gun has a small magazine so you 
             will be reloading often which will also slow you down.

  >>Chamberlain Hills (30 Ballas)
    *****************************
      Time: Two minutes.
      Weapon: Assault Rifle.
      Gold Requirement: 50 kills, 6 headshots, 2 vehicles destroyed.
      -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      Notes: When the Rampage starts then head into the alley. The alley will 
             funnel most of the Ballas inside which will make for easy kills. 
             This will also make it easy to get headshots when vehicles 
             approach because they will head in a straight line towards you. 
             On occasion a Balla will appear with an RPG so gun him down 
             quickly before he can do any damage.

  >>Great Chaparral (35 Soldiers)
    *****************************
      Time: Three minutes.
      Weapons: Assault Rifle and Grenade Launcher.
      Gold Requirement: 45 kills, 6 headshots, 2 tanks.
      -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      Notes: It's pretty easy to get the kills since you can blow up the 
             vehicles as they approach. But stay out of the road or you may 
             get run over frequently.

             Keep an eye open for the tanks. When one appears then focus your 
             attention on it and use the Launcher to fire a few rounds to 
             blow it up. Keep moving as you do so it can't get a bead on you 
             otherwise you risk instant death.

             Keep blowing up vehicles to get your kills until you blow up the 
             second tank. After that then let the Soldiers come to you and 
             focus on headshots until the timer runs out.

  >>Mirror Park (20 Hipsters)
    *************************
      Time: Two minutes.
      Weapon: Sawn-Off Shotgun.
      Gold Requirement: 30 kills, 10 headshots, 2 vehicles.
      -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      Notes: This is fairly easy in that the Shotgun has a wide spread which 
             allows you to take down multiple targets. You need to focus a 
             little more on headshots since that Requirement is higher than 
             in previous Rampages.

After completing the last Rampage then you should have the {Red Mist}
Accomplishment. Now let's go to the Stranger contact in Vinewood Hills.....

You need to get into Tyler's compound and steal his Clothes. Go to the south

            /=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=\
 /=========================================================================\
| >GHF38. Friend Activities                                                 |
 \=========================================================================/
            \=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=/

At this point of the game, now that Trevor is unlocked, it is time to do some
Friend Activities. You can do activities with all three characters together
even though they haven't all met officially yet. You can also do activities
with side characters such as Lamar and Jimmy.

It is important to note that your friend may not be able to do any activities
at the time of the call and may have to either wait later or go with another
friend. Once you make arrangements to meet your friend you can call him back
and cancel if you need to. Drive to the meeting place to pick him up.

While there are a large number of activities you can do together there are
only four you need to do for 100% Completion:

  --Darts
  --Movie
  --Strip Club
  --Bar

For these four it may be best to do them with just two characters, preferably
Michael and Trevor. After the first activity you have the option to drop off
your friend. However, you can do all of these activities in one run and get
them over with.

For the Movie let it run completely just to be safe. For the Strip Club just
hang around for awhile and throw some money at the strippers for a bit. Just
walk out of the club to get your friend to follow you. For the Bar you'll
automatically walk in and you'll stagger out of the bar drunk.

Although you can do some of the activities earlier in the game it is best to
wait until after you unlock Trevor since that is when Darts is opened up.
Speaking of which.....

0+=+=+=+=+=0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0
| A. Darts |~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~\
0+=+=+=+=+=0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0

There is only one place to play Darts in the entirety of the state and that
is the Yellow Jack Inn at the Grand Senora Desert. The rules of this are
almost exactly like that of the same game within GTA IV. You can choose to
play a number of Legs (single game) and Sets (a sequence of Legs).

Your goal in Darts is to get to zero. You start with 301 points and you must
get to zero before your opponent. You have three darts to use to score your
points. The dart board is broken up into many zones. The outer thin ring is
the double zone where you score double points. The inner thin ring is the
triple zone where you score triple points. The other zones are single score.

The inner bulls-eye will score you 50 points and the outer bulls-eye will
score you 25 points. To win the game you must hit zero with your dart landing
on a double zone or in the center bulls-eye.

When you take your turn you will find that your aiming cursor is wobbly and
constantly moving around. You have to be patient when aiming. After you throw
your three darts then it will be your opponents turn.

With these activities out of the way there is something else you can do
together.....

            /=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=\
 /=========================================================================\
| >GHF39. Accomplishments (Part Three)                                      |
 \=========================================================================/
            \=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=/

Now it's time to go after another Accomplishment, {Three Man Army}. Although
www.xboxachievements.com says it can be done after "Mr. Philips" or "Friends
Reunited" I found that the earliest I could do it is right after "Fame or
Shame" because Michael's phone has both Franklin's and Trevor's contacts.

Before doing anything you should save your game then get a four door vehicle
and have it outfitted with armor and bulletproof tires. Call up one friend
and call the other before you pick up the first one. Hopefully both are
available at the same time. After picking them both up then head to Los
Santos International Airport.

Go onto the tarmac to initiate the automatic 3-Star Wanted Rating. Then drive
laps around the runways while keeping the Cops close to your car. Do this for
three minutes and the Accomplishment is yours. Then reload your saved game to
easily get rid of the Wanted Rating and get your money back for car
modifications.

Now switch to Franklin and go to his Stranger encounter which was also opened
up after "Fame or Shame".....

            /=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=\
 /=========================================================================\
| >GHF40. Far Out (Omega) and the Spaceship Parts                           |
 \=========================================================================/
            \=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=/

Out in the middle of the desert Franklin encounters a weird individual. He is
Omega and he is convinced that he was contacted by aliens but their ship
crashed before he could be abducted. He shows Franklin a part of their
spaceship and wants all of the Parts.

At this point you open up another group of collectibles. Collecting all fifty
of the Parts is required for 100% Completion and you will also get the {From
Beyond the Stars} Accomplishment. When you get near a Part you should hear a
humming sound. Acquiring all of the Parts will also open up another mission
with Omega. Everybody can collect the Parts but only Franklin can deal with
Omega.

0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0
| A. Blaine County |~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~\
0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0

[BLC-SP1] - Location: Under a covered wooden bridge (which is also [BLC-B3]).
            Neighborhood: Zancudo River.
            Map: (D-4).
            Directions: Go to the intersection of Zancudo Grande Valley and 
                        Route 68. North of this intersection is a dirt road 
                        with a wooden covered bridge. The Part can be found 
                        under the east end of the bridge.

[BLC-SP2] - Location: In a nook along the Zancudo River.
            Neighborhood: Zancudo River.
            Map: (D-4).
            Directions: Go to the intersection of Joshua Road and Calafia 
                        Road. From here, head west towards Stab City. Just 
                        after you cross the small bridge then turn left onto 
                        the dirt road that immediately appears after the 
                        bridge.

                        After going under the railroad bridge you should see 
                        a small group of trees on the riverbank ahead of you. 
                        Just before this group you should find the nook where 
                        you can find the Part within.

[BLC-SP3] - Location: On top of a rocky cliff near the top of the mountain.
            Neighborhood: Mount Josiah.
            Map: (D-4).
            Directions: Although you can climb up here by foot it is best to 
                        use a helicopter for acquiring this Part. West of 
                        Stab City are a pair of large tanks. North of that, 
                        on the railroad tracks, are some railroad lights and 
                        a small storage area. Go just past this then turn 
                        left and fly up the mountain.

                        To your right should be some rock ridging. Continue 
                        going up the mountain until you reach the top of the 
                        grassy area. Look to your right at the ridges. On a 
                        ledge near the top of this ridged wall is the Part. 
                        Land at the top and walk down to acquire the Part.

[BLC-SP4] - Location: On a bridge arch under the bridge going over Cassidy 
                      Creek on the Great Ocean Highway.
            Neighborhood: Raton Canyon.
            Map: (C-3).
            Directions: This is a very tricky one to reach. The Part is near 
                        the top of the south bridge arch facing the ocean. 
                        You can acquire this one of two ways.

                        You can either Parachute in (the rest of the arch 
                        should allow you to climb down without too much 
                        injury) or you can use a helicopter (preferably the 
                        Buzzard) to land near the part. Landing the Buzzard 
                        here is difficult but it can be done.

use of the Space Docker vehicle.

 / The Main Story \+++++++++++++++++++\
0==========================================================================\
| >MSY6. Federal Investigation Bureau                                       +
0==========================================================================/

The F.I.B. is the agency that Dave works for. Many years ago Michael and Dave
struck a deal that allowed Michael to enter witness protection and Dave to
get enough glory to rise through the ranks. However, the Vangelico Heist has
brought Dave back into Michael's life and that leads to the next mission.....

  0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0
 / Federal Investigation Bureau \
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+\
| >FIB1. Dead Man Walking                                                   0
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+/
| Overview /                               \ Federal Investigation Bureau /
0=========0                                 0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0

  Michael meets Dave at the Observatory. Trevor's re-appearance has 
  complicated things. It has endangered Dave's career and needs Michael's 
  help to ensure that it stays intact for both their sakes. Dave needs 
  Michael to take a picture of a supposedly dead body. Michael questions how 
  he is going to get inside. Dave solves the problem by knocking out 
  Michael......

0========0
| Weapons \
0=======================>

  --Combat Pistol (provided).
  --SMG.

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  You wake up in a body bag. After it is opened up then wake up to surprise 
  the interns. This will also attract agents. After changing clothes then 
  sneak up and knock him out. Notice that you don't have any weapons on you 
  at this point. Grab his Combat Pistol and proceed.

  Check out the bodies. One of them will have the tag of your target but it 
  is on the incorrect body. You will automatically call Dave and he will tell 
  you to get upstairs. As you make your way there you will be attacked by 
  multiple agents using a variety of firearms including Shotguns. Kill them 
  and take their weapons. You can find some Health on the reception desk if 
  you need it.

  As you get near the stairs you will be attacked by another agent. As you 
  get near the stairs then Dave will tell you that your weapons on the top 
  floor. As you climb up the stairs you will be attacked by some more agents. 
  When you reach the top floor you will need to fight off multiple agents, 
  including some that will come in from the stairwell, before you can reach 
  your weapons. After reclaiming your weapons then escape through the window. 

  After escaping then you will need to lose the Police as you now have a 
  3-Star Wanted Rating. Go to the train tunnel loop at Carson Ave. and Brouge 
  Ave. southeast of your position. This will allow you to easily lose the 
  Rating.

  After losing the Rating then meet Franklin at the Murrieta Oil Fields. You 
  will also call Dave and he will tell you that you need to meet his boss 
  Downtown. When you meet with Franklin then the mission is completed 
  successfully.

    **************

  >>Headshots (14)
    **************

  >>Time (9:30)
    ***********
      Kill the agents quickly then use the train tunnel loop as outlined to 
      quickly lose the Rating and quickly speed to Franklin.

  >>Focused Killer
    **************
      You need to kill four enemies using Michael's Special Ability. The 
      lower floor area is the best place to get this. Use it the moment the 
      game prompts you to and go up the hallway killing agents as you go. If 
      you maxed out your Special earlier then you should have more than 
      enough to kill several agents before it runs out.

  >>Unmarked
    ********

  F.I.B. marker. Let's go there first.....

 / Federal Investigation Bureau \

| Overview /                               \ Federal Investigation Bureau /

  Michael now goes to meet Dave's boss and to see what's up.....

0========0
| Weapons \
0=======================>

  --AP Pistol (provided).
  --SMG.
  --Heavy Sniper (provided).

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  When you get to the plaza then find Dave. Here you get to meet his boss, 
  Steve Haines. After what has happened at the morgue the I.A.A. has stepped 
  up interrogation of Mr. K, who was your target in the previous mission, and 
  wants him found before he talks. After the cutscene then walk with Dave to 
  his car.

  From here, drive to the Meeting Point at the Oil Fields. Along the way 
  you're forced to call in Franklin and you also find out the Trevor has been 
  pulled in to do a job involving extracting Mr. K. When you get there then 
  you start a cutscene with all three of them together for the first time. 

  After the cutscene then you will auto switch to Trevor and you need to fly 
  to the Agency Headquarters. When you get to that point then you auto switch 
  to Michael and you need to rappel down to where you need to go. You need to 
  go down without being seen. Doing long jumps will help here.

  When you get to the right place then use the cinematic camera to see what 
  is going on inside. After awhile then you will be prompted to smash the 
  window. At this point you need to quickly switch to Franklin who is across 
  the way with a Sniper Rifle. After shooting several of the agents then you 
  will be prompted to switch back to Michael.

  When you get back then you need to quickly kill all of the agents before 
  you can leave. Then you will auto switch back to Franklin who now needs to 
  shoot down the Choppers. One will approach you and try to kill you. Shoot 
  the pilot to bring it down quickly. From here, you can switch to either 
  Trevor or Michael.

  Don't try to shoot down any more choppers. Just switch to Trevor and let 
  Michael shoot down the choppers as you fly back to the Oil Fields. As you 
  fly there Michael should be shooting down the other choppers.

  If things go right then he should shoot down the last chopper just before 
  you get there. If not, just hover above the depot until the last one is 
  downed. After Michael shoots down the last chopper then land the chopper at 
  the depot to successfully complete the mission.

  >>Time (7:30)
    ***********
      Timing is pretty tight with this one. The biggest key is to switch to 
      Trevor after you shoot down the chopper as Franklin. Michael can shoot  
      down the other choppers on his own easier and faster when you control 
      Trevor.

  >>Accuracy (60%)
    **************
      Switching to Trevor when flying out helps here because you aren't doing 
      any shooting on the way back to the Oil Fields.

  >>Headshots (10)
    **************
      With the Heavy Sniper as Franklin you should be able to get most of 
      this then get the rest when you switch back to Michael.

  open up the next mission.....

| Notes \
0=======================>

  When you start then you can switch to Trevor to speed things up at the 
  beginning.

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  When you get to the building you find Trevor. After the cutscene where you 
  are introduced to Devin Weston then Michael is requested to go somewhere 
  and kill somebody. From here, drive to the House in Rockford Hills.

  When you get there then you find out that it was the wrong house. After 
  that then you auto switch back to Trevor and now you need to torture Mr. K 
  to get the right information. Pick a torture device and you will be given 
  instructions on how to use it. Be careful not to push Mr. K too far or you 
  will stop his heart. After using a device then Mr. K will give you 
  additional information.

  From here, you auto switch back to Michael and you need to drive to the 
  next location. When you get there then you need to know who you are looking 
  for. Now you auto switch back to Trevor and you need to torture Mr. K some 
  more. After getting some more information then you auto switch back to 
  Michael.

  Turns out that there is a party over where the target is at and you need 
  more information to determine what the target exactly looks like. You then 
  auto switch back to Trevor and need to torture Mr. K some more. After that 
  then you go back to Michael. You still need more specific information. Then 
  switch back to Trevor.

  Torture Mr. K some more and he will give you the right information. The guy 
  will have a beard, smokes, and is left handed. When looking at the house he 
  will be the guy outside wearing a red long sleeve shirt.

    >>"It'll Check Out"
      *****************
        When you look inside the house for the first time your target will be 
        snorting coke from the coffee table on the second floor. Shoot him to 
        end the torture session early.

  After killing your target, regardless of method, then you will auto switch 
  back to Trevor. Then take Mr. K to the Airport to successfully complete the 
  mission.

0===========0
| 100% Score \
0=======================>

  >>Don't Stop Me Now
    *****************
      You need to torture Mr. K without stopping his heart. You need to look 
      at the screen every so often to check on his heart. There is also a 
      health bar in the upper left corner. When that empties then you will 
      cause his heart to stop.

      Regardless of device order save the Clips for last. When using the 
      Clips then spark it about ten times to scare him almost into submission 
      and use them for a few seconds which should get Steve to say stop. This 
      should allow you to keep Mr. K's heart from stopping.

      Of course, the easiest way to get this Requirement is to shoot your 
      target early which will stop the torturing before you can use all the 
      devices.

  >>Electrocutioner
    ***************
      You need to electrocute Mr. K.

  >>The Tooth Hurts
    ***************
      You need to pull out one of Mr. K's teeth.

  >>Wrenched
    ********
      You need to hit Mr. K with the Wrench.

  >>It's Legal!
    ***********
      You need to waterboard Mr. K.

  exhale. After the exercises Michael tries to attack Fabian and gets tossed 
  into the pool. After this then go up to Jimmy's Room.

  After a talk with him then Michael leaves with his son. Drive over to the 
  Burger Shot. When you get there then you meet Jimmy's friend. After the 
  meet then drive back to your house. As you drive you take a sip from 
  Jimmy's drink. However, is it spiked with some serious stuff and you begin 
  to trip out making you drive very erratically. You will eventually pass out 
  and be tossed from the car.

  When you finally wake up from your drug induced dream you will be in a 
  small park not far from your home almost naked. When you get back to your 
  home you find Amanda and the rest of the family gone. They have decided to 
  move out because of your recent behavior. This will also end the mission 
  successfully.

When you get to Vinewood then Beverly calls to inform you that Poppy Mitchell
is involved in a high speed chase with the Cops. Find her and chase her but
don't get too close as you don't want to hit the Cops. The chase winds
through the north part of the Vinewood area. The Casino is a bad spot so be
careful there.

Eventually she will crash and the Cop will then approach her. As he does then
bring out your camera phone and snap a picture of her in cuffs. After that
then send the picture to Beverly. Then get out of there quickly to
successfully complete the encounter.

You will find the necessary vehicle at the north end of the Lumberyard. You
need to get it to Barry's Apartment within four minutes. However, there are
unmarked Police vehicles staking out the place. If you are spotted leaving
then you will have to deal with a 2-Star Wanted Rating before you can take
the truck to Barry's.

The best way to avoid them is to go right at the corner then go right again.
Go through the alley and through the construction barrier to drop onto the
grass below. Then go northeast to El Rancho Blvd and quickly drive to
Barry's. When you get there then get out of the truck and run away from the
area to successfully complete the encounter.

 / Franklin Clinton \
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+\
| >FRN3. Hood Safari                                                        0
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+/
| Overview /                                           \ Franklin Clinton /
0=========0                                             0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0

  When Franklin returns home he is confronted by his Aunt and Lamar about 
  disloyalty. He hasn't been hanging with the crew or attending meetings. In 
  the middle of all this Trevor shows up. After chasing off Aunt Denise then 
  Trevor gets himself involved in Lamar's and Franklin's excursion.....

0========0
| Weapons \
0=======================>

  --Carbine Rifle.
  --Assault Shotgun.

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  To start, get in the Van. The plan is to do a business transaction with 
  Stretch to "move up the food chain". It will happen down on Grove St. When 
  you get there then go to the House. During the transaction Trevor finds 
  that they are being ripped off. This sets off an attack on the trio.

  Now you need to move up the street shooting up gangbangers as you go. 
  You'll be prompted to switch characters from time to time although you can 
  ignore it if you wish.

  There are lots of gangbangers and you'll need to take cover behind the 
  dumpsters as you will be taking lots of damage. Another option is to go 
  through the backyards and try to get some from behind. Use of the Assault 
  Shotgun can be very helpful during this mission.

  As you get halfway up the street then the Cops will be called resulting in 
  a 3-Star Wanted Rating. Follow Lamar and he will take you down to the 
  river. If you get too far away from him then you will fail the mission.

  Thankfully there is a video shoot being done with jetskis. Take the jetskis 
  and go. At this point you need to follow Lamar. He will lead you towards 
  the Terminal area and go under the Chum St. bridge. As you get close to 
  more open water then he will tell you to split up. Now you will need to 
  lose the Wanted Rating.

  Just as you get under the Buccaneer Way bridge then veer left towards a 
  ladder that leads back up to an area just under the bridge. Quickly jump 
  off the jetski and climb up the ladder. When you get to the top then turn 
  left and run to the train tunnel. Unfortunately, the Cops had a feeling you 
  would try that so there will be a couple of them waiting for you there. 
  Quickly kill them after the train passes then run north into the tunnel.

  Keep running until you find one of the tunnels going into the river then 
  stop within it. Shortly after stopping then the Rating should disappear and 
  the mission will be successfully completed.

0===========0
| 100% Score \
0=======================>

  >>Time (7:00)
    ***********
      Quickly killing the gangbangers and losing the Rating quickly is the 
      most important part of this. Using Assisted Aiming will help in getting 
      rid of the gang members quickly.

  >>Accuracy (70%)
    **************

  >>Headshots (12)
    **************
      Quickly killing the people inside the vehicles as they approach will 
      give you easy headshots.

            /=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=\
 /=========================================================================\
| >GHF44. Sea Races                                                         |
 \=========================================================================/
            \=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=/

There will be four of these races and they are required for 100% Completion.
If you've acquired at least one Gold Medal in the Shooting Range, Street
Races, Off-Road Races, Triathlons, and the Flight School then getting a Gold
Medal in one of the Sea Races should get you the {Multi-Disciplined}
Accomplishment.

Despite the waves the Seashark is easy to control. Use the Rudder buttons for
making sharp turns. This is pretty much the key for winning the races as you
have open space to easily get past your rivals.

At the end of the race you will be on the Seashark you rode on. If you drive
it to another race then you can use it instead of getting off and climbing on
the one at the race start.

Listed below are the four races from easiest to hardest.

0===========================================================================0
| Los Santos       | You have to compete against eight riders in this very  |
|                  | easy race. You can pretty much get into first place    |
|                  | from the get go and stay there.                        |
|------------------+--------------------------------------------------------|
| North East Coast | You have to compete against eight riders in a race     |
|                  | that weaves around the small islands.                  |
|------------------+--------------------------------------------------------|
| East Coast       | You have to compete against eight riders in a race     |
|                  | that weaves around some small islands. However, it is  |
|                  | a little more difficult to get into first place at the |
|                  | beginning because of the rock arch and the slight      |
|                  | aggressiveness of a couple of the riders.              |
|------------------+--------------------------------------------------------|
| Raton Canyon     | You have to compete against four riders in a race down |
|                  | the Zancudo River. This is the hardest of the four     |
|                  | races because of the narrow river, rocks, and rapids.  |
|                  | Take things a little carefully and you should have no  |
|                  | problem winning this race.                             |
0===========================================================================0

In-between the races you may get an email from Barry telling you about the
smoke-in. This will place a marker at City Hall.....

            /=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=\
 /=========================================================================\

 \=========================================================================/
            \=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=/

This mission is only available during the daytime hours of 8:00 and 20:00.
Head to City Hall and when you get there you find there is no one here. When
you call Barry you find him too high to do much of anything. This will also

At this point there are no more missions for Franklin so switch to Trevor and
do his Stranger mission, the one with the "B".....
