 / The Merryweather Heist \
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+\
| >MWH1. Scouting the Port                                                  0
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+/
| Overview /                                     \ The Merryweather Heist /
0=========0                                       0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0

  Trevor finds out that Floyd works at the docks and wants to know what is 
  interesting down there. So he gets all of them, including Wade, into 
  uniforms so they can check things out.....

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  To start, go to Pier 400. Along the way you find out a couple of things 
  about the Merryweather area. When you get there then go to Dispatch. When 
  he checks in the follow him. Eventually he will lead you to a container 
  handler. Get inside and go to the marked Containers.

  Position the crane part over the container and pick it up with D-Pad Right. 
  Then take it over to Area F and drop it off. Then repeat with the second 
  Container. When you are done with the Containers then run to the Crane and 
  climb it. When you get to the top you find that you are needed to operate 
  it.

  The game gives you instructions on how to operate the crane. You need to 
  lift a Container and move it to the other end then place it onto a truck. 
  Then go back and do it again with the second one. The camera angle makes 
  this a little tricky but you can make it easier by using the overhead view 
  (thanks to Sterling P. de Mille for that tip).

  After this then go up to the Vantage Point and take three pictures of the 
  boat - the front, a guard, and the back. Then send the photos to Ron. After 
  this then climb down to ground level. From here, climb into the truck and 
  drive to the Docking Area. When you get there then you will be confronted 
  by security.

  As Floyd is being attacked Trevor will make off with the manifest. Leave 
  the Restricted Area. Take the unattended truck nearby and drive to Floyd's 
  Apartment. When you get there then you need to plan out the next heist. You 
  can select either the Freighter or Offshore Approach. When you finish 
  selecting your Approach then the mission is successfully completed.

0===========0
| 100% Score \
0=======================>

  >>Time (20:00)
    ************
      Moving the Containers quickly into position is key to getting this 
      Requirement. Selecting the Approach doesn't count against your time.

  >>Employee of the Month
    *********************
      You need to complete the mission without damaging the containers. This 
      is actually pretty easy to get.

  >>Perfect Surveillance
    ********************
      You need to take all three photographs of the boat as instructed. Just 
      follow the instructions and this is automatic.

  >>An Honest Day's Work
    ********************
      You need to complete the mission without causing a disturbance at the 
      docks. Basically don't attack or run over anybody at the docks.

 / The Merryweather Heist \

| Overview /                                     \ The Merryweather Heist /
0=========0                                       0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0

  After bringing the guys together it's time to do the deed.....

0========0
| Weapons \
0=======================>

  Sniper Rifle (silenced).

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  To start, drive Franklin to his spot on the Miriam Turner Overpass. When 
  you drop him off then you auto switch to Franklin. Head to your Vantage 
  Point. After talking to Michael then snipe the two Guards shown. After 
  Michael climbs on board then you will auto switch to Michael.

  Plant the bomb on the pillar then switch back to Franklin. Snipe the three 
  Guards on the ship as Michael makes his way to the next bomb point. 
  Continue left along the ship and snipe all the Guards you see. This will 
  clear a path for Michael to enter the ship. After entering the ship then 
  the alarm will go off.

  Snipe the two Guards near the entrance. Then snipe all of the Guards from 
  the two vehicles that appear. Then a Buzzard will appear to confront you. 
  Snipe the pilot to bring it down. Michael will then leave the ship but 
  Guards will chase him as he does so. Snipe the Guards before they can do 
  damage to him. After sniping all of the Guards then Michael will jump off 
  the ship.

  Michael will tell you to Detonate the bombs from your phone. You will then 
  auto switch to Michael who will dive back under water. Use the sonar pings 
  to locate the Package. When you find it then you will auto switch to Trevor 
  who is in the Sub. Drive to the Package then lower yourself onto it to grab 
  it. Then drive it over to Pier 400 where Floyd is waiting.

  During the cutscene that follows Lester shows up. He was supposed to be in 
  a hospital but he found out about things and needed to get there before it 
  was too late. The Package is some kind of experimental weapon and taking it 
  would bring all kinds of major problems on everybody. So now you have to 
  give it back and therefore the entire Heist was all for naught. After the 
  cutscene then the mission ends.

0===========0
| 100% Score \
0=======================>

  >>Headshots (12)
    **************
      When you snipe the Guards you need to go for the head even if they're 
      moving.

  >>Accuracy (80%)
    **************
      The Sniper Rifle is a one hit kill weapon so you don't need to be 
      perfect to hit a Guard. As a result this is fairly easy to get.

  >>Ninja
    *****
      You need to kill at least twelve enemies using stealth attacks. Sniping 
      all of the Guards on the ship before they can sound alarms will help in 
      acquiring this Requirement.

  >>Container Hunter
    ****************
      You need to find the Package within sixty seconds. Just follow the 
      sonar pings and quickly swim to it to easily get this Requirement.

  >>No Alarms
    *********
      You need to get to the ship interior without being detected. Sniping 
      all of the Guards as Franklin should get you this Requirement.

  To start, as Michael, you need to drive out to Sandy Shores Airfield. When 
  you get there then get into the Cargobob. Use the Grappling Hook to grab 
  the sub then fly out to the assigned point near Paleto Cove. When you get 
  close then release the Sub close to the water. As you drop you will auto

  As you dive then use the Trackify app on your phone to find the Package. 
  When you get to it then you need to dive down deep to get it. After 
  acquiring the Package then ascend to the surface. After ascending to the 
  surface then switch to Michael. Lower the chopper down and pick up the Sub 
  then fly back to the Airfield.

  As you fly then you will be attacked by Merryweather guards. Switch to 
  Franklin and use one of the Machine Guns to shoot down any and all 
  approaching Choppers. If you don't shoot them down then they can destroy 
  your chopper. Use the D-Pad to quickly switch sides. Aim at the pilot to 
  quickly bring the aircraft down.

  After all of the Choppers are gone then continue flying to the Airfield. 
  When you get to the Airfield then lower the chopper and drop the Sub.

  During the cutscene that follows Lester shows up. The Package is some kind 
  of experimental weapon and taking it would bring all kinds of major 
  problems on everybody. So now you have to give it back and therefore the 
  entire heist was all for naught. After the cutscene then the mission ends.

  >>Salvager
    ********

      north of the test barge and dive quickly as you head north towards the

  >>Time (14:30)
    ************
      A good shortcut to the Airfield is to turn off the Senora Freeway just 
      before the Prison and angle northwest across the land towards the 
      Airfield. This will save considerable time. Finding and acquiring the 
      Package quickly as well as rising to the surface quickly will also help 
      in this regards.

  >>Show No Mercenary
    *****************
      You need to destroy all Merryweather enemies. You need to destroy all 
      of the Choppers and the boats. Once you get into the mountains then 
      they will stop coming so you need to destroy them fast. Destroy the 
      boats first then shoot the pilot to quickly bring down a Chopper so you 
      can move on to the next one.

  >>Weathering the Storm
    ********************
      You need to escape the pursuing Merryweather enemies in less than four 
      minutes. Destroying the Choppers quickly should get you this 
      Requirement.

 /=========================================================================\
| >GHF46. Businesses (Part One)                                             |
 \=========================================================================/
            \=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=/

If you've done everything properly you should have fifteen Businesses ready
for purchase:

    >>The Hen House - $80,000.
    >>McKenzie Field (Trevor only) - $150,000.
    >>Sonar Collections Dock - $250,000.
    >>Los Santos Customs (Grand Senora Desert) (Franklin only) - $349,000.
    >>Hookie's - $600,000.
    >>Towing Impound (Franklin only) - $150,000.
    >>Downtown Cab Co. (Franklin only) - $200,000.
    >>Smoke on the Water (Franklin only) - $204,000.
    >>Car Scrapyard - $275,000.
    >>Pitchers - $750,000.
    >>Tequi-la-la - $2,000,000.
    >>Cinema Doppler (Michael only) - $10,000,000.
    >>Ten Cent Theater (Michael only) - $20,000,000.
    >>Tivoli Cinema (Michael only) - $30,000,000.
    >>Los Santos Golf Club - $150,000,000.

You will notice that some of them are real expensive and can only be
purchased after making lots of money in the Stock Market. Fortunately you
only need to buy five of them for 100% Completion.

But which five to buy?

One thing that needs to be considered is what is called Management Tasks.
There are two types of tasks:

0===========================================================================0
| Random Tasks     | Certain Businesses will make money on their own which  |
|                  | you will get weekly. But, on random occasions, you may |
|                  | get a call from that Business asking you to do         |
|                  | something. That could range from a simple delivery to  |
|                  | protecting it from attacks. If you fail to do anything |
|                  | then you will lose that week's profits.                |
|                  |                                                        |
|                  | If you have a few of these types of Businesses and you |
|                  | are trying to do things off-mission or even going to a |
|                  | mission marker then these calls will become rather     |
|                  | annoying. So it is best to avoid buying these          |
|                  | Businesses right now.                                  |
|------------------+--------------------------------------------------------|
| Non-Random Tasks | Other Businesses do have similar tasks in order to     |
|                  | make money but you can do them whenever you want and   |
|                  | won't be bothered by others. You can basically "buy    |
|                  | and forget" these places but you won't make any money  |
|                  | from them unless you do their tasks.                   |
0===========================================================================0

There are also a couple of Businesses that don't even have any tasks at all
(Los Santos Customs, Los Santos Golf Club).

The Businesses that have Non-Random Tasks are the ones that I will focus on.
And three of these Businesses have Accomplishments attached to them so I will
buy them as well.

However, most people prefer to save these until after they have completed the
Finale missions and made their money in the stock markets. Makes sense of
course. But there is one Business that you should buy now which will allow
you to make some good money which will be useful just a little later. The
other four I will go over near the end of the guide.

0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0
| A. Sonar Collections Dock |~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~\
0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0

The Sonar Collections Dock can be found south of Paleto Bay. Purchase the
Dock and you will also get a message about the nuclear waste within the
waters around the state. You will now get the use of a Submarine similar to
the one you used during the Merryweather Heist.

You use the Sub to go and pick up the Barrels of Nuclear Waste. There are
thirty of them and you get $23,000 per Barrel picked up plus a $250,000 bonus
for collecting them all. You can make a $690,000 profit when you subtract the
cost of the Docks. And, while you're out there collecting the Barrels, you
can go after additional Hidden Packages and make an additional $143,000 on
top of what you're already getting.

Picking up the Waste is not required for 100% Completion but you will get the
{Waste Management} Accomplishment which is the reason to buy this Business.

Anybody can buy the Business and anybody can pick up the Barrels regardless
of who's owning but only the owner will get the money. I recommend getting
the poorest of either Franklin or Trevor and buy the Docks then collect the
Barrels.

Picking up the Barrels will take quite some time because the Sub is very slow
so you will have to patient. When inside the Sub there are some things to
note.

There will be a black bar at the bottom of the radar. The number on the left
side is for your current depth (in feet). The number on the right is the
depth to the ocean floor (in feet). The Sub's crush depth is 485 feet. If you
are below this depth then you will slowly be crushed. Stay down there for too
long and the Sub will implode and you will be Wasted.

While in the sub you use the Trackify app on your phone to find a barrel. On
the app the depth is for the target (in meters). It will only lock onto the
nearest one regardless of distance and whether or not there are any other
barrels close to it. This app makes it very easy to find the barrels even
though there is nothing that will tell you how far you are from one.

You cannot switch to another character while inside the Sub. You can leave
the Sub to some exploring nearby (and be outfitted with scuba gear). When you
leave then the Sub will automatically surface.

Listed below are all of the Barrels of Nuclear Waste starting with the
nearest one from the Dock and going clockwise. I will also list the Hidden
Packages so you can acquire them while going after the Waste. They are listed
based on the nearest land region:

 /=========================================================================\
| >GHF47. The Assassination Missions and Investment Advice                  |
 \=========================================================================/
            \=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=/

The marker for Lester is the beginning of what are known as the Assassination
Missions. There are five of these missions total and they are used to
manipulate the stock markets so you can make lots of money.

The majority of players prefer to save them until after the completion of the
Main Story since they will have lots of cash to invest. However, you need to
do the first Assassination Mission before doing "Blitz Play" or you won't be
able to do the Heist.

The reason I am doing it at this point is that, if you've acquired lots of
Hidden Packages for all three characters, did The Epsilon Program encounters
for Michael, and collected the Nuclear Waste with either Trevor or Franklin,
then you should have quite a bit of money now to invest in the stock being
affected in the following mission.

When investing money in the stock markets you will need to make time pass
until you have the stock you need to invest in or sell right where you want
it. You will need to get someone to sleep at a Safehouse to pass the time
quickly and check the stock being affected. You will also need to switch
between all three characters quickly to buy and sell so all can make money.

Although the Assassination Missions are the obvious ways to manipulate the
stock markets there are two Main Story missions ("Legal Trouble" and
"Meltdown") and a Random Event Encounter ("Hitch Lift 1") that will also help
you with the markets. I already covered "Hitch Lift 1" earlier and I will go
over investment information for the two story missions later.

One goal of this guide is to get between $250 million to $300 million per
character which is more than enough to purchase everything in the game if you
wish to do so. You can go higher if you want but I think that is a good range
for those who want it all but don't want to spend too much time to get it.
Below are some investment advice depending on where you want to do the
remaining Assassination Missions:

  >>After the Finale (with and without BAWSAQ access)
    *************************************************
      You should have your poorest character between $1 million to $1.5 
      million. The only way to get this is to do Hidden Package collecting. 
      It probably shouldn't take too long because at least two of your 
      characters should be close to that amount.

  >>Before the Finale (with BAWSAQ access)
    **************************************
      Your poorest character should have between $1.5 million to $2 million.

  >>Before the Finale (without BAWSAQ access)
    *****************************************
      I recommend that all three characters should have around $3.5 million 
      to $5 million. This will obviously take awhile but will be worth it in 
      the end.

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

If you have internet access and can get to BAWSAQ then get each character to
invest all of their money into Betta Pharmaceutical before proceeding. Then
switch back to Franklin and go to Lester.....

  0+=+=+=+=+=+=0
 / Lester Crest \
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+\
| >LSR2. Hotel Assassination                                                0
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+/
| Overview /                                               \ Lester Crest /
0=========0                                                 0+=+=+=+=+=+=0

  After a brief conversation with him, Lester wants Franklin to take down the 
  head of some pharmaceutical corporation so he can make some money from the 
  hit.....

0========0
| Weapons \
0=======================>

  Sniper Rifle (silenced).

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  To start, go to the Hotel. When you get there then you need to quickly find 
  a good place to snipe him but where you're standing is fine. You also have 
  ninety seconds before he checks out. When the counter goes to zero then 
  your Target will leave. Wait until he sits in his vehicle then snipe him in 
  the head. This will alert security who will go after you. However, quickly 
  leave the area to successfully complete the mission.

0===========0
| 100% Score \
0=======================>

  >>Sniper Boy
    **********
      You need to kill the Target using a Sniper Rifle.

0=======0
| Reward \
0=======================>

  $7,000 plus an additional $2,000 if you snipe him. So you can earn a 
  possible $9,000. You will also get a new Safehouse in Vinewood Hills. But 
  you will lose the old one in the process.

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

  After this mission you need to wait until the Betta Pharmaceutical stock 
  maxes out (around 50% or so) then sell it. After selling that stock then 
  wait for the Bilkington (LCN Exchange) to go down (to around $30) then buy 
  as much as you can. Wait for it to max out (around 100% or so) then sell 
  it. This will take multiple game days to sleep through before all is said 
  and done.

  The good news is that even if you can't buy Betta stock you can still buy 
  Bilkington stock because it is listed on LCN so you can still take 
  advantage of this mission even if you don't have internet access.

| A. Getaway Vehicle |~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~\
0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0

For this you need a fast but discreet car that can seat four. The cars that
the characters own, such as Trevor's Bohdi, cannot be used. You can do this
with any character. Heading north towards Vinewood should spawn some good
vehicles.

When you finally acquire one then you need to hide it somewhere discreet. The
best place to put it is a small parking area under one of the off-ramps for
the Olympic Fwy. and Del Perro Fwy. interchange and just off of El Rancho
Blvd.

When heading north on El Rancho Blvd. get up to the freeway bridge which is
part of the interchange. Just as you get to the bridge then look left to find
a blue wall and some dumpsters. You should also find a path leading down
under the off-ramps. This will lead to a small parking area with a small
white and yellow building. Leave the car here.

The reason for parking it here is because this is where the car will be found
if you do a Mission Replay for "Blitz Play" regardless of where you parked
the vehicle on your initial play-through.

After hiding the car then call up Michael and select "Mark Getaway Location".

0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0
| B. Tow Truck |~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~\
0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0

The Tow Truck can be found just south of the Maze Bank Arena. When you get
there you find somebody working on a car next to it. Sneak up to him and
pistolwhip him. Then steal the Tow Truck and drive it to the Oil Fields. Then
leave the area to successfully complete the mission.

| C. Trash Truck |~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~\
0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0

The Trashmaster can be found in the Mirror Park area. It will be driving
around so you need to put a car in front of it to get it to stop. Then take
the vehicle and drive it a short distance to get around your vehicle. Then
you will be hit with a 2-Star Wanted Rating.

The best thing to do is to immediately get out and go behind the nearby
houses. There's no way you can easily outrun the Rating in the Trashmaster so
it is best to get rid of it on foot, especially considering that you can't go
back to the Oil Fields until it is gone. When the Rating is gone then drive
the Trashmaster back to the Oil Fields to successfully complete the mission.

| Weapons \
0=======================>

  --Combat MG (provided).
  --Carbine Rifle.
  --Sniper Rifle.
  --RPG (provided).

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  You start off as Michael and you need to drive the Trashmaster over to 
  Cypress Flats. When you get there then you will auto switch to Trevor who 
  is keeping lookout. When the Armored Car approaches then you will auto 
  switch back to Michael. Drive the Trashmaster a short distance and block 
  both lanes of the road. As the Armored Car approaches then you auto switch 
  to Franklin and you need to ram the Car with the Tow Truck.

  Get out of the Truck then plant Sticky Bombs on the rear of the Car and 
  blow it open. After that you find out that they had a silent alarm and that 
  the Cops will be swarming in a matter of seconds. This will initiate a 
  4-Star Wanted Rating. Get into cover and wait for them to arrive.

  Here you will get in a protracted battle with the Police. When the game 
  suggests you switch to a character then switch. You will fight the Police 
  using all three characters as you take down N.O.O.S.E, Snipers, and 
  Choppers. To aid in survival it may be best to use Assisted Aiming for this 
  fight. Listen to what the characters are saying so you can position someone 
  properly to deal with any kind of threat.

  After you thin them out then switch to Franklin and drive the Trashmaster 
  to where the Getaway Vehicle is parked, wherever that is. When you get 
  there then get out of the Trashmaster, plant a Sticky Bomb on it, get into 
  the car, drive a short distance, and blow up the Trashmaster. Then drive 
  off away from the area. Later, Franklin will call Michael and then you will 
  auto switch to him.

  From here, drive to Devin's House. When you get there then you start a 
  cutscene. Devin needs somebody to get some cars from him but Michael isn't 
  interested. When Devin asks what Michael is interested in he finds than 
  Mike is interested in movies. Devin tells him that he can hook him up with 
  Solomon Richards, a big time movie producer. After the cutscene ends then 
  the mission is successfully completed.

 /=========================================================================\
| >GHF48. Death at Sea / What Lies Beneath                                  |
 \=========================================================================/
            \=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=/

After the mission "Blitz Play" a "?" marker will appear at the Sonar
Collections Dock. This is a Michael specific Stranger encounter involving a
lady named Abigail. She is the widow of a famous TV personality who died
while exploring wrecks in a sub. She cannot collect the life insurance and
needs help in finding pieces of the sub in order to get it. This begins what
is known as "Death at Sea".

At this point you open up a Dinghy with scuba gear which will be next to the
Sub. There are thirty Submarine Pieces that can be collected. They can be
found in green circles that will appear near you as you drive the Dinghy.
When you get into a circle then you will see sonar pings from one of the
Pieces in the circle. There can be more than one Piece in a circle but only
one will ping at a time.

It should be noted that if a Piece is near land you will see and hear the
pings even if you are on land. The Pieces are always found near wreckage or
interesting landscape feature. You can go and collect additional Hidden
Packages if you wish to do so since you don't get any money for collecting
Pieces. Any character can collect the Pieces but only Michael can deal with
Abigail.

When you collect all thirty Pieces then go back to the Dock to start "What
Lies Beneath" with Abigail. Here you can let her go or kill her - your
choice. The only reward you get for this is $10. No Accomplishment either and
it doesn't count towards 100% Completion.

But I do recommend acquiring the Pieces because it will take the "?" marker
off the map plus you don't have to deal with the annoying pings if you happen
to be doing something around the south part of Los Santos. Because the Dinghy
is much faster than the Sub it won't take too long to collect all of the
Pieces. This will also be Michael's last Stranger encounter.

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

At this point you will have two markers on the map: one for Devin and one for
Solomon Richards. Let's start with Devin.....

  Head up north along the Freeway. Keep up with them into the Grapeseed area

  won't pay you until they are all delivered. Molly outlines the next target 
  and lets Michael go because he is not needed for that one. After the 
  cutscene ends then you will finish the mission as Michael.

| >DVH2. Eye in the Sky                                                     0

| Notes \
0=======================>

  The Z-Type car is inspired by the vehicle used by the Zaibatsu Corporation 
  in GTA2.

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  If you start out as Trevor then you will need to go to the Mission Row 
  Police Station. Go to the front desk and the Cop will point you to the 
  Helipad after you tell him you work for Devin. When you get to the chopper 
  then you will fly off to meet Franklin. If you start off as Franklin then 
  go to the Oil Fields where you will meet with Trevor who flies in.

  When working the scanner you can zoom in on someone, perform a body scan, 
  and pull up their records. Point the camera in the direction you want to 
  go. Start off on a scan of Franklin. After that then you need to go to 
  Hawick and find Chad Mulligan amongst several targets. When you get there 
  then start scanning them. However, your target is not there.

  From here, head east to find several more. Chad is one of them and he 
  should be talking to another woman. Keep him in sight when he walks away 
  and he will eventually lead you to where he has parked the car. But, when 
  Franklin comes to confront him, then Chad drives away. Now you need to keep 
  track of the car so Franklin can follow him and retrieve it.

  Keep the camera zoomed out so you can better keep track of him, especially 
  when he goes through alleys and close to obstructions. Eventually he will 
  enter a parking garage. Now the chopper will lower and you need to use the 
  thermal camera to find Chad.

  First, though, you need to locate Franklin. He will be in the center of the 
  garage. Chad will be located at the northwest corner or way left of 
  Franklin after you locate him. After finding Chad then you will auto switch 
  to Franklin. Pistolwhip Chad and enter the car. If you don't pistolwhip him 
  then he will call the Cops and you will get a 2-Star Wanted Rating when you 
  get near the Airport. That will complicate things a bit.

  After stealing the car then Franklin will call Molly to tell her of the 
  acquisition. You will now go to the Airport to present the car to Devin 
  before he flies off on a trip. When you get to the hangar then you will 
  start a cutscene. After that then grab a car and go to the Airport exit to 
  successfully complete the mission.

| >SMR1. Mr. Richards                                                       0

| Overview /                                           \ Solomon Richards /
0=========0                                             0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0

  Upon meeting Solomon, Michael finds out that he is planning his new movie, 
  "Meltdown". However, things are not going well. The lead actor has a new 
  agent, Rocco Pelosi, who is holding things up and a director who is in the 
  middle of a mental breakdown. Looks like Michael has some work to do in 
  order to get things back on track.....

0========0
| Weapons \
0=======================>

  Carbine Rifle (silenced).

0======0
| Notes \
0=======================>

  Rocco Pelosi is the gangster you dealt with during "The Ballad of Gay 
  Tony".

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  To start, head to East Los Santos and to the Club where you will find 
  Anton, the director, and Milton, the actor. Along the way Solomon will call 
  you to give you some details. You need to teach Rocco some manners and 
  bring the talent back to the Studio, preferably pacified.

  When you get to the Club then you find a helicopter on top of the building 
  and Anton and Milton sitting inside. Rocco goes back into the building to 
  get something and leaves the helicopter unattended. Now you need to get 
  there without alarming Rocco.

  There are two ways to do this. You can either slowly sneak your way up and 
  avoid the workers along the way or you can use a silenced weapon and kill 
  them so you can run and speed things up. I recommend killing them since 
  there are Requirements you can get for doing so. I use the silenced Carbine 
  Rifle for this.

  When you climb to the helipad then you confront Rocco. Here you just need 
  to beat him up with your fists. If you've maxed out your Stamina and 
  Strength Stats then beating him up will be easy, just keep throwing punches 
  and he will go down quickly. After beating Rocco into submission then get 
  in the Chopper.

  Now you need to scare Anton and Milton into submission. You need to fly 
  erratically and fly under bridges and close to buildings. The best thing to 
  do is to get up a little high then shake the chopper by rapidly going left 
  and right. After some of this then Anton and Milton will submit. After you 
  have them under control then fly back to the Film Studio. After you land 
  then go to Solomon to successfully complete the mission.

0===========0
| 100% Score \
0=======================>

  >>Time (10:00)
    ************
      Kill the workers with a silenced weapon and run to the helipad. Then 
      quickly get Anton and Milton to submit.

  >>Silent Assassin
    ***************
      You need to kill three enemies using stealth attacks. Use a silenced 
      Carbine Rifle to kill them quickly before they can alert Rocco.

  >>Can't Touch This 2.0
    ********************
      You need to beat up Rocco without taking any damage. And you can't use 
      any melee weapons at all. If you do then it will immediately kill him 
      and you will fail the mission. Also, if you continue to beat him up 
      after you defeat him then you will kill him.

  >>Perfect Touchdown
    *****************
      You need to land the Frogger without damaging it. And I mean without 
      damaging it *AT ALL* during the flight including the landing. If you 
      barely scratch it then you can't get this Requirement.

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

| >MDZ1. Caida Libre                                                        0
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+/
| Overview /                                             \ Martin Madrazo /
0=========0                                               0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0

  After introducing Trevor to him then Martin needs you to kill a cousin 
  named Javier who has some files of his.....

0========0
| Weapons \
0=======================>

  Carbine Rifle (silenced).

0======0
| Notes \
0=======================>

  One of my readers, Greg Pinto, suggested having Micheal fly to the ranch in 
  a helicopter prior to starting the mission and using it to fly to the 
  Observatory to save time for the Time Requirement. However, you can still 
  get the Requirement without having to do the extra work.

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  To start, head to Galileo Observatory. When you get there then get in the 
  van. Inside the van is a big sophisticated gun. It has incredible zoom 
  capabilities and is extremely powerful. You need it to shoot down the 
  plane, with Javier inside, that is coming in from Liberty City.

  When you spot the plane you will notice a red square in front of it. You 
  need to shoot at the square to hit the plane. You need to hit the square 
  three times to damage the plane enough to bring it down. You need to hit 
  the square before the plane turns towards the Airport or it will be too 
  hard to hit and you may fail the mission.

  After crippling the plane then you will auto switch to Trevor and you need 
  to chase the plane. The plane will drag you all the way out to San Chianski 
  Mountain Range. When it finally crashes then go up and kill Javier and 
  retrieve the files. You will then auto switch back to Michael.

  Leave the area and drive to the Stoner Cement Works on Senora Road. When 
  you get there then drive the van into the cow field next to it and get out. 
  Use a Sticky Bomb, plant it on the van, and get far enough away then 
  destroy it. After destroying it you will immediately get a call from 
  Trevor. He wants you to go to the Stoner Cement Works as there has been a 
  change of plan.

  Since you are already here then simply walk over to the circle to start a 
  cutscene. Michael finds that Trevor has already talked to Martin. Things 
  got out of hand and he decided to kidnap his wife. This, of course, upsets 
  Michael greatly. This will also successfully end the mission.

0===========0
| 100% Score \
0=======================>

  >>Floor It
    ********
      You need to reach top speed on the Sanchez. This is actually tough to 
      do. No matter how fast you go on the straightaways you can only seem to 
      get around 98%. However, according to mr_Tii over at GTAForums, there 
      is a way to get this.

      Just after you switch to Trevor you will need to go off the dirt path 
      and down the hillside. When you get to the edge of the path you should 
      be at a three-way intersection of dirt roads. Instead of just going 
      forward and down the hill, go left.

      On the right side of the road should be a rocky ridge. Either go to the 
      middle or to the end of it then veer right off and down the hill. You 
      will now go down a much steeper grade and that will give you enough of 
      a speed boost to get the Requirement. This will also get you off-course 
      a bit but this shouldn't hamper you.

  >>Glued to the Seat
    *****************
      You need to stay on the Sanchez and not fall off.

  >>One Two Three
    *************
      You need to shoot down the plane with only three shots. Take your time 
      and get the shots while the plane is still pointed towards you.

  >>Time (9:45)
    ***********
      Shooting down the plane quickly, driving the van to the cement factory 
      and destroying it there will help towards this Requirement.

  The {A Fair Day's Pay} Accomplishment.

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

| The Plan \
0=======================>

  To start, go to McKenzie Field. Then get in the Plane and take off. Now you 
  need to get to the Cargo Plane but you have to fly low to avoid radar 
  detection from Fort Zancudo. Going along the main roads and ocean will help 
  to keep you from being detected. You need to follow the plane around Fort 
  Zancudo and Paleto Bay.

  After going around Mount Chiliad then you will be far enough from radar 
  detection to climb altitude and go after the Cargo Plane. When you get 
  close enough then the plane will open up and you will be shot at. Continue 
  forward to land inside the Cargo Plane. However, if you go too high, then 
  you will smack into the tail and you die and fail the mission. So it is 
  best to approach from below at a shallow angle.

  After the cutscene with you entering then you will need to fight your way 
  to the front end of the plane. Switch to your Assault Shotgun, keep in 
  cover, and occasionally pop up to kill a Guard. When you kill all of them 
  then you need to proceed forward. Go in the middle as this will keep you 
  from being hit by moving cargo.

  When you climb up the ladder then kill the pilot and take over. From here, 
  fly the plane back to McKenzie Field. However, after some distance, two 
  jets come in to escort you back to base. But just continue to fly to 
  Grapeseed. You will also need to gain additional altitude as you fly there.

  When you get close then they will fire upon you and cripple the jet. Now 
  you need to jump from the plane. After jumping then deploy the parachute 
  and land, preferably back in Sandy Shores. It should be pointed out that 
  the plane will crash into the western half of the Alamo Sea. It will then 
  become another underwater wreck you can explore for weapons and items. When 
  you safely land then the mission is successfully completed.

| The Plan \

  Follow the dog down the path. The dog will lead you to someone stuck in a 
  tree. Free him and he will talk to you about parachuting. His name is Dom 
  and he is what he calls a control junkie. He will then prod you into going 
  with him on a parachute jump. After the cutscene then follow Dom. Get in

  The pilot will then fly to another area to make another jump. You can skip 
  the journey if you want. When you get close to Mount Chiliad then you will

  it is very easy to go off the mountain and fail the encounter. Don't try to 
  get ahead of Dom - just focus on the course. Eventually you will get into 
  Paleto Forest.

  There is a curve just before the finish line. You can cut across it and get 
  the last checkpoint before the finish and get in front of Dom to win the 
  race. When you finish the race, regardless of who wins, then the encounter 
  will be completed successfully.

  >>Big Air
    *******
      You need to get two seconds of air during the bicycle race. To do this

      with. Look at your in-game map and at the path on the west side of 
      Mount Chiliad.

      Partway down the mountain you should see an oval-like shape where the 
      path splits and comes back together. Just after that the path will 
      split again (although it won't show on the map because the split is too 
      small). In the center of this split is a large ramp-like rock that you 
      can use to launch yourself and still land on the race path. This should 
      get you the Requirement.

      You need to win the bicycle race against Dom.

 /=========================================================================\
| >GHF49. Parachuting                                                       |
 \=========================================================================/
            \=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=/

At this point you will now open up this activity which will appear as
parachutes on your map. There are a total of thirteen of these Parachute
Jumps that must be completed for 100% Completion. There are two categories of
jumps: Helicopter (seven) and Base (six). Each completed category counts for
one activity on the Hobbies and Pastimes category on the 100% Completion
list.

When you land you will be graded and given money bonuses based on accuracy.
The closer you get to the center of the target, the higher your Accuracy
rating and the more money you can make. You don't need to be 100% Accurate to
succeed. Just land anywhere in the target to successfully complete the Jump.
But if you are too far away from it then you will fail the jump.

The jumps are not hard to do if you've done well on the parachuting lessons
in the Flight School. In addition to completion percentage you will also get
a free Parachute when entering aircraft. It should also be noted that you are
not allowed to do a jump when you have a Wanted Rating.

Below each jump listed there are several pieces of information attached:

  --Name
    ====
      Each jump has a name and it is listed here.

  --Neighborhood
    ============
      General area where the jump is located.

  --Location
    ========
      Specific location within the neighborhood where it is located.

  --Type
    ====
      There are three specific types of jumps that you will do:

        ++Checkpoint
          **********
            You need to fly through checkpoints on the way down to the final 
            target. You will be given bonuses for collecting them all.

        ++Target
          ******
            You need to land on a stationary target. There are no checkpoints 
            to fly through.

        ++Vehicle
          *******
            You need to land on a moving vehicle. Like with the Target type 
            there are no checkpoints to fly through.

  --Notes
    =====
      This is where I list certain information on the jump.

Now for the list of Base Jumps which is broken down by area:

| 100% Score \
0=======================>

  >>Dare Devil
    **********
      You need to fall for eight seconds before opening the parachute. This 
      is an extremely frustrating Requirement and is the worst one in the 
      entire game. It seems that no matter what you do you always end up with 
      seven seconds. This one took me a lot of time to get through. There are 
      two methods that I came up with:

        --The Standard Method
          ===================
            When you jump, wait for Dom to get to the end of the word 
            "accelerating" then open the chute. Use the Shoulder Buttons to 
            do rapid left and right movements towards the flatbed. This seems 
            to add speed so you can get to it.

            Avoid using precision landing as this tends to make you misjudge 
            distances and more often than not you will end up just missing 
            the back of the flatbed by an inch or two which is aggravating.

        --The Blind Jump Method
          =====================
            This unusual method was one borne of frustration and I can't 
            exactly figure out why it works but it does. When you jump, pull 
            back on the Left Analog Stick then use the Right Analog Stick to 
            quickly rotate the camera and look at Franklin from underneath. 
            This means you can't see the ground. For some reason this allows 
            you to go beyond the eight second limit.

            Of course, this means you will have to do this multiple times to 
            get the timing right so you can let go of the camera (so it can 
            snap back behind Franklin) and open the parachute so you can get 
            to the flatbed. I got ten seconds on the X360 version and eleven 
            seconds on the PS3 version.

  >>Bullseye
    ********
      You need to land perfectly on the back of the truck.

  Trevor runs into these so-called patriots again and gets pulled into 
  another adventure.....

0========0
| Weapons \
0=======================>

  Stun Gun.

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  To start, you need to chase the suspect. Follow him and either use your 
  Stun Gun or knock him off his ATV. You can also let Joe stun him as well. 
  When he is down then stop nearby and let the patriots apprehend him. After 
  this then head to the Cement Factory.

  When you get there then you need to chase two suspects on bikes. This can 
  lead into a long chase because they are faster than your current vehicle 
  and the rough terrain can slow you down. Eventually they will go down 
  Senora Road and you will have a chance to catch them. Knock them off or 
  shoot them with the Stun Gun. Don't worry about the first guy you knock off 
  - he'll stay put, just go and get the second one.

  After both are down then let the patrol apprehend the second guy and go 
  back and get the first. When the first guy gets into the vehicle then you 
  need to exit it to successfully complete the encounter.

0===========0
| 100% Score \
0=======================>

  >>Downed
    ******
      You need to stop the first group of immigrants within thirty seconds. 
      The best way to do this is to ram him off his ATV. If you're fast 
      enough you can nail him at the beginning when you reach the 
      intersection.

  >>Double Downed
    *************
      You need to stop the second group of immigrants within fifty five 
      seconds. Again, ram them off the bikes to quickly stop them. Another 
      piece of advice is instead of stopping when you get to the Cement 
      Factory then continue forward which gives the immigrants less of a lead 
      on you. You can catch them before they head into the real hilly terrain 
      and get a substantial lead on you.

  >>Shock and Awe
    *************
      You need to use the Stun Gun to stop all immigrants. You can either do 
      this yourself or let Joe do the shooting.

      If you do the shooting then you'll have to take your time with this 
      since the Stun Gun has a very limited range and long recharge time. 
      Especially since you'll have to do this from your vehicle. When you get 
      close to one then hold down the Fire Button and keep adjusting your 
      shot as the weapon recharges. You'll also need to keep it slow so you 
      don't accidentally ram him.

      For the second group of immigrants you should wait until you reach 
      Senora Road before trying to zap them as they will slow down enough for 
      you to attack them and you'll be on a smooth surface which will make 
      that task much easier.

  >>Notes
    *****
      You can't do all three Requirements at once. You can do the first two 
      in one run and the last one in another.

| Reward \
0=======================>

  $500.

| Overview /                               \ Federal Investigation Bureau /
0=========0                                 0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0

  Trevor and Michael meet at the Meth Lab and get into a nasty argument. Then 
  Dave and Steve show up. Apparently one of the other agencies is making some 
  sort of nerve gas and want Trevor and Michael to conduct a raid. They list 
  the equipment needed but want the duo to procure the funds to acquire it 
  themselves. After the F.I.B. leave then the duo are left to plan things 
  out.....

0========0
| Weapons \
0=======================>

  Pistol (silenced).

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  To start, head to Paleto Bay. Along the way Michael will call Lester. He 
  will meet the guys there. In one of the past missions Lester told Michael 
  about a bank "in the sticks" that may have lots of money. So Mike needs to 
  hit that bank to get the cash necessary for the raid.

  When you get to Paleto Bay then you will meet up with Lester. After the 
  meetup then head to the bank. When you get there then you need to focus on 
  the bank. After that then go around back. Lester has doubts about the score 
  based on the alarm but suggests shooting it to gauge a response. You will 
  then leave the car. Shoot the alarm which is the green hexagonal object 
  near the rooftop.

  After that then go to the nearby Gas Station. Nothing seems to happen at 
  first but then a bunch of Police cars show up and you'll find that they 
  will set up roadblocks and searches. This indicates that the bank has a lot 
  of cash or, as Trevor puts it: "bad Cops guarding dirty money". After this 
  then Trevor bails and gets on a motorcycle.

  Now you need to race back to the Meth Lab. You can use either Michael or 
  Trevor for the race. When you get back to the Lab then you need to plan 
  things out on the planning board. The only choice is for a gunman.

  Although you have the choice of Trevor's buddy Chef I strongly recommend 
  Packie. If you used him during the Vangelico Heist then his stats should be 
  almost completely maxed out. After making your choice then you'll auto 
  switch to Trevor and the mission will end successfully.

0===========0
| 100% Score \
0=======================>

  >>Leisurely Drive
    ***************
      You need to drive to the bank within three minutes and thirty seconds. 
      This is very easy to get if you drive fast the entire way. You should 
      get there with more than twenty seconds to spare.

  >>Winner
    ******
      You need to win the race back to the Meth Lab. I suggest using Michael 
      because you can risk crashing with Trevor who will be on a bike.

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

  Almost immediately after this mission you will get a call from Franklin. 
  Earlier in the game he sent you a message about some "hillbillies" looking 
  for Trevor. Now Franklin is following them. These are the remnants of the 
  O'Neil family and they are looking for revenge against Trevor. This will 
  put a "T" marker on Trevor's safehouse.

  Later, you will get a text from Lester about military hardware shipments to 
  Fort Zancudo. However, before I get to that, let's deal with the O'Neil 
  brothers.....

| >TVR5. Predator                                                           0
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+/
| Overview /                                             \ Trevor Philips /
0=========0                                               0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0

  When you arrive at Trevor's house you find it much cleaner than before 
  thanks to Martin's wife. She is behaving far less of a hostage and more of 
  a contented housewife. Apparently Trevor is far more hospitable than her 
  current husband and seems to like being out here. She even takes to 
  stopping Trevor from huffing gasoline with a slap to the face.

  When Trevor tells Michael about Franklin and the trouble he has found then 
  he gets upset. This upsets Trevor and decides to leave. Michael goes 
  along.....

0========0
| Weapons \
0=======================>

  --Carbine Rifle.
  --Heavy Sniper (provided).
  --Assault Shotgun.

0======0
| Notes \
0=======================>

  You can switch to Franklin to start the mission after he calls Trevor about 
  following the O'Neils but you will miss out on the amusing starting 
  cutscene.

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  To start, drive out to Franklin's location. After a short distance you will 
  auto switch to Franklin who is tailing the O'Neil brothers along the Great 
  Ocean Highway. Unfortunately, they realize you are onto them so they speed 
  up. You now have to chase them. If you're thinking about shooting at them, 
  forget it. Their car is indestructible and the brothers inside are 
  invulnerable, even if you use Sticky Bombs.

  As you are chasing them you will call Trevor with the news. Both Trevor and 
  Michael will come to Raton Canyon in a chopper. Eventually the O'Neil 
  brothers will turn off and head into the Raton Canyon area. Continue 
  following them and they will encounter an elk in the road and crash. Now 
  you and Chop have to go to their car on foot. When you get there you will 
  find the brothers gone.

  Franklin calls Trevor with the news then you auto switch to him. From here, 
  drive to the Airfield. When you get there then enter the chopper and fly 
  out to Franklin's position. When you get there then you will auto switch to 
  Michael who will have an Heavy Sniper. During this part you cannot 
  switch to another character.

  Use the thermal sight to find the brothers in the forest. However, there 
  are also lots of elk and other animals in the forest. You need to sort 
  through them to find the brothers. When you find one then get out of the 
  thermal scope and kill him.

  The first brother will be in Cassidy Creek to the lower left of where you 
  start. Use your Special to slow things down so you can kill him before he 
  starts swimming. The second brother will be skulking through the middle of 
  the forest. Even though he is moving slow you should use your Special so it 
  will be easier to kill him.

  After killing the second brother then look up a bit towards the road. The 
  last brother will then start attacking the chopper with RPGs. You can't 
  fire on him because he is behind a large rock. At this point you will then 
  auto switch to Franklin. Head northeast across the creek and towards the 
  road instead of following Chop. When you get to the road then you should be 
  north of the last brother.

  Get close enough to make him appear on your radar. When he appears then he 
  will run towards your position. This will make him easier to kill. After 
  killing him then you will be prompted to switch to Trevor. Gently land the 
  chopper and pick up Franklin and Chop then fly back to the Airfield. When 
  you get there then the mission is successfully completed.

0===========0
| 100% Score \
0=======================>

  >>Accuracy (70%)
    **************
      Use Michael's Special to slow things so you can get the kill shot on 
      the first two brothers and use the Carbine Rifle for body shots on the 
      last one when you are Franklin.

  >>Time (9:00)
    ***********
      Finding and killing the brothers quickly is necessary to speed things 
      up. You can finish this under seven minutes if you're quick enough.

  >>Headshots
    *********
      You need to kill all three brothers with a headshot. You absolutely 
      need to use Michael's Special for the first two brothers. Make sure 
      that each brother is in open space before trying to make the shot then 
      use the Special just long enough to shoot the head. When you face the 
      last one as Franklin then use an Assault Shotgun on him.

  >>Thin the Herd
    *************
      Don't kill any animals. Any roadkill you make on the way to the 
      Airfield does *NOT* count against this Requirement - only the animals 
      in the forest.

| Overview /                               \ Federal Investigation Bureau /
0=========0                                 0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0

  It's time to hit the bank.....

0========0
| Weapons \
0=======================>

  --MG (provided).
  --Carbine Rifle.
  --Assault Shotgun.
  --Minigun (provided).

0======0
| Notes \
0=======================>

  If you do this on a Replay then Packie's stats will go down to their 
  original levels but this shouldn't affect the mission.

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  You will start as Michael and your task is to drive to Paleto Bay. When you 
  get there then drop off Franklin at the marker. From here, go and park the 
  van near the bank entrance. Next, go inside the bank.

  Eventually Packie will cut through the cage door and you can kick it in. As 
  you are getting the money a Police car shows up. Trevor scares them off and 
  they call for reinforcements. As Trevor then go to the vault. Michael 
  should be finished by then and will have over eight million dollars. You 
  will then start a cutscene of the reinforcements arriving. And there are a 
  lot of them.

  But then the three of you emerge with some heavy firepower including a 
  Minigun. You will also be hit with a 5-Star Wanted Rating. Use the Minigun 
  to destroy the cars and kill the Cops. You will notice that each time you 
  get hit you lose a little of the take.

  As you fight off the Cops then a Police chopper shows up. Destroy it then 
  run across the street to the apartment complex. As you get there you get a 
  message from Franklin. There are Cops in the water and you no longer can 
  use the boat to leave. You need to find another way out of Paleto Bay.

  Proceed through the complex and blow apart the fences along the way. Kill 
  any Cop and destroy and Police cars you encounter with the Minigun. When 
  you get back to the street then destroy anything and everything that comes 
  to you. As you proceed up the street then the Army will come in to help 
  out.

  Now you need to proceed through another alley. When it opens up then you 
  will encounter the Army. Kill off most of them with the Minigun. When you 
  kill off enough of them then the Army will bring in a tank. At this point 
  you will then be prompted to switch to Franklin.

  When you switch to him you will be in a Dozer. Follow the path to the 
  others while either avoiding or running over the soldiers in your way. When 
  you get there then you pick up the guys. From here, you need to head to the 
  factory east of your position while avoiding the tanks. Thankfully this is 
  a short drive so they can't get a good bead on you.

  Once inside the factory then you need to proceed to the train platform room 
  by room while fighting off the Army. Switch characters if you need to if 
  you run low on armor or health. When you get to the platform then hold off 
  the Army for awhile until the train shows up. When it shows up then get on. 
  You will then be whisked away from the area.

  You will then meet up with another agent and be given your meager cut. You 
  will also be told that you will be called by Steve later. After the 
  cutscene then the mission is successfully completed.

0===========0

0=======================>

  >>Let It Rain
    ***********

      liberally on everything.

  >>Accuracy (50%)
    **************
      You need to switch to Michael when you start the gunfight so you can 
      increase your accuracy with the MG and Assault Shotgun in short 
      controlled bursts in conjunction with Assisted Aiming.

  >>Mission Time (16:00)
    ********************
      As long as you keep moving this isn't too hard to do.

  >>Collateral Damage
    *****************
      You need to cause at least one million dollars of damage in Paleto Bay. 
      Destroy every Police and Army vehicle you come across with the Minigun 
      and you can easily double that.

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  Mary Ann appears in the daytime hours between 7:00 and 20:00.

  This is a simple checkpoint triathlon race. Just quickly tap the Run Button 
  to speed through. If you maxed out your Stamina then you should have no 
  problems beating her. The hardest part is the Stunt Jump. More than likely 
  you will miss the Jump and Mary Ann will pass you. But you can still make 
  up some ground on her.

  When you switch to the running portion you should be able to pass her since 
  you stop just ahead of where she stops. Continue following the path and 
  finish the race. Winning the race will successfully complete the encounter.

| >TVR6. Derailed                                                           0
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+/
| Overview /                                             \ Trevor Philips /
0=========0                                               0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0

  Ron informs Michael about the monthly train and Trevor fills him on the 
  details. Apparently there's gold on board and enough of it to pay off 
  Madrazo so they can go back to Los Santos. So now the gang go to acquire 
  the precious metal.....

0========0
| Weapons \
0=======================>

  --Combat MG.
  --Heavy Sniper.
  --Sticky Bomb.

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  You start as Trevor and you need to get on the bike. Your next task is to 
  jump onto the train. You will catch up to the train at San Chianski 
  Mountain Range. There are multiple elevated ridges that you can use to get 
  onto the train. Because you are landing on a moving target this is tricky. 

  Once you get onto the train then you need to ride the bike to the front. 
  This is also tricky because the train is narrow. Take it moderately slow so 
  you can stay on it. When you get to the front then Trevor will take 
  control. Blow past the stop and continue onwards. Shortly after then you 
  will auto switch to Michael.

  From here, head to the Rail Bridge. When you get there then the train will 
  wreck and some of it will drop to the water. Get to the orange container 
  and use a Sticky Bomb to blow open the doors. Then you will auto switch to 
  Trevor and you need to protect Michael from the Merryweather recovery crew. 
  Before they get there you should step off to the left a bit and climb onto 
  the higher rocks.

  There will be three boats and a two helicopters. Using the Combat MG will 
  make quick work of them. After that then you will deal with some snipers on 
  the bridge. Switch to the Heavy Sniper and use the thermal scope to find 
  and kill them.

  They are the reason you step onto the higher rocks. One of them will be 
  behind a beam. If you stayed put then you won't be able to shoot him - but 
  he can shoot you and more than likely kill you. By stepping left then you 
  can nail him.

  After them more will arrive, this time from the air. Switch back to the 
  Combat MG and quickly deal with them. Another option is to stay with the 
  Heavy Sniper and snipe them. You can easily nail the pilot in the chopper 
  to bring it down and the parachuters go down in a straight line so you can 
  easily get them too.

  After killing this group then things calm down. Wait for Michael to come to 
  you then get into the Dinghy. This will now begin a chase down the river 
  while being pursued by the Merryweather guys.

  Although you can switch to Michael it may be best to stay with Trevor and 
  personally deal with them. You will notice that you can't lock onto any of 
  them. This will make hitting them a bit harder. But continue firing at the 
  boats and choppers to take them down.

  Once you get to open waters then you will auto switch to Michael. If you 
  went with Michael from the start then you will still have to deal with two 
  Merryweather boats. You will then auto switch to Trevor so you can deal 
  with them.

  Your boat will stop and the Merryweather personnel will rapidly catch up. 
  They move too fast for you to shoot at properly and they will cut you down 
  very quickly. This is why you should stick with Trevor from the start - so 
  you can get rid of them before you reach open waters.
  After you reach open waters then you will auto switch back to Michael. From 
  here, head to the spot on the beach. When you get to the beach then go to 
  the Getaway Vehicles. This will start a cutscene.

  Michael wants to take the loot to pay off Madrazo but Trevor wants none of 
  that and desires to keep it for himself. However, Michael promises him a 
  big score to compensate - the Union Depository. Trevor reluctantly agrees. 
  After the cutscene ends then the mission is successfully completed.

0===========0
| 100% Score \
0=======================>

  >>Time (11:30)
    ************
      Killing the Merryweather guys quickly is the key to this and even if 
      you take a little time you can still get this pretty easy.

  >>Fastest Speed
    *************
      You need to reach the top speed on the Sanchez. This is fairly easy and 
      I got it on the first try.

  >>Better Than CJ
    **************
      You need to land on the train on the first jump. This may take you a 
      few tries as you learn the best angle to make the jump. Obviously a 
      reference to the GTA:San Andreas mission "Wrong Side Of The Tracks..."

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

  Shortly afterwards then you will get a call from Steve. Now is the time to 
  go after the toxic gas now that everything is in place......

| >FIB9. Monkey Business                                                    0
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+/
| Overview /                               \ Federal Investigation Bureau /
0=========0                                 0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0

  When the gang arrives they find that they were supposed to bring additional 
  people for the gig. But wires got crossed between Steve and Dave so the 
  gang couldn't get who was needed. So now the agents have to go with the 
  trio to do this thing.....

0========0
| Weapons \
0=======================>

  --Stun Gun.
  --Carbine Rifle.

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  You start off as Michael and you need to drive the boat down the coast. 
  When you get to the marker then you need to dive into the water and go 
  through the discharge tunnel leading into the Humane Labs and Research 
  facility.

  When you get there then you need to cut through the grate using a special 
  torch. You need to place the torch on each green dot to cut through. After 
  a few seconds then it will become a red line. Use the Fire Button just long 
  enough to cut through since you have a limited amount of fuel for the 
  torch.

  After cutting through then you need to swim through the tunnel leading into 
  the Lab. When you get there then you need to make your way through the 
  facility. You will auto switch to a Stun Gun (regardless of whether or not 
  you already had one). As you proceed through the corridors you will 
  encounter civilians. Stun them to proceed forward.

  Get to the Elevator. When it opens then stun the civilian and grab his 
  Security Card. When you get to the next floor then use the Stun Gun to take 
  down the two lab personnel. Proceed through the corridor and to a point 
  where you will need to take cover from the patrolling security. You can 
  either take them down or let them pass. I prefer to let them pass.

  After that then proceed through the security door and to the room where the 
  gas is stored. You will get into a bit of a standoff with the person 
  inside. The door can only be opened from the inside and the civilian won't 
  cooperate. Another civilian will come through a nearby door. Zap him when 
  he exits. The other civilian will be intimidated enough to open the door. 
  Zap him and proceed to the Toxin.

  After you get the Toxin then security will be alerted. Switch to your 
  Carbine Rifle. You now need to proceed through the facility taking down the 
  personnel as you go. When you get near the monkeys you should find some 
  Health on a wall.

  Eventually you will get to the Loading Bay where plenty of security are 
  waiting. Carefully pick them off from cover until they are all gone. As you 
  are fighting them there should be some Health on the wall to your left just 
  after you enter the Bay. After the battle then place the Toxin in the 
  Refrigeration Unit outside.

  When you place the Toxin safely inside then you will auto switch to Trevor 
  who is flying a Cargobob. Fly low enough to the container to trigger a 
  cutscene. Response teams have already got inside and Steve wants to abort 
  fearing a disaster. But Michael convinces him to come up with a solution. 
  Steve decides to stay behind to create a diversion.

  After the cutscene then you need to fly to the Airfield. When you get there 
  then fly low enough to drop the crate on the trailer. Orientation doesn't 
  matter - just get low enough. After that then land the chopper. This will 
  start a cutscene.

  After dropping off the crate then Michael gets a message from Lester. The 
  item taken from the last mission was enough to settle things with Martin 
  Madrazo. This will allow Michael to return to Los Santos. After the

  has to return her. When you get to the Farm then the mission is 
  successfully completed.

| >TVR8. Surveying the Score                                                0
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+/
| Overview /                                             \ Trevor Philips /
0=========0                                               0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0

  When the gang arrives then Lester comes in telling of "the big one". The 
  big score that will set them up for life once and for all. But, before they 
  do that, they must do some looking around.......

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  When you start the mission you will start as Michael. There will also be a 
  clock on the screen that starts at noon. You can also switch to Trevor if 
  you want (he'll be driving to the Airfield).

  From here, you need to drive to the Bank. The entrance to the bank is on 
  the upper level of road. When you get there then focus on the Bank. After 
  that then you need to get behind the place. It will be on the lower road 
  level. When you get there then focus on the back side of the Bank.

  After that then you will auto switch to Trevor who will be driving towards 
  the Airfield. When you get to the Airfield then get into the Helicopter. 
  From here, fly to Murrieta Heights. When you get there then you will find 
  the convoy of Armored Cars going to the Bank.

  Follow them but don't get too close or you will be warned. They will 
  eventually go into Swiss St. tunnel and out the other end. They will turn 
  left onto and Alta St. where Michael and Franklin will pick them up. After 
  the cutscene then fly back near the tunnel and find the Construction 
  Entrance. Hover low above it for awhile until Lester gets all he needs.

  After that then fly back to the Airfield. You can switch back to Michael if 
  you want but you can just stay with Trevor (Michael will drive Franklin 
  back to his house to complete the mission). When you arrive and land at the 
  Airfield then the mission is successfully completed.

0===========0
| 100% Score \
0=======================>

  >>Perfect Distance
    ****************
      You need to follow the Armored Cars without being warned on distance. 
      This is easy enough if you keep a good distance from them.

  >>Cavity Search
    *************
      You need to find the Construction Entrance within twenty seconds. After 
      the cutscene of the Armored Cars being received is finished then 
      sidestep the chopper left to quickly acquire the site.

  >>Under the Bridge and Tunnel Flight
    **********************************
      You need to fly under the bridge and fly through the tunnel while 
      following the Armored Cars. This is the Power St. Bridge which is also 
      part of the Swiss St. tunnel. Flying through the tunnel and out towards 
      Alta St. will get you both of these Requirements at the same time.

      The tunnel is tough to fly through because it is barely big enough to 
      handle the chopper but it can be done. You have to use first person 
      view to do this. Although tricky to fly through you don't have to be 
      perfect like the regular "Under the Bridge" activity covered earlier. 
      You can scrape along the ground as you fly and you should be fine.

  >>Time (11:00)
    ************
      Switch to Trevor and drive to the Airfield instead of using Michael. A 
      good shortcut to the Airfield is to turn off the Senora Freeway just 
      before the Prison and angle northwest across the land towards the 
      Airfield. This will save considerable time.

      Finding the Construction Entrance and getting the footage quickly will 
      also help. You should also switch to Michael at the end of the mission 
      and drive Franklin to his house.

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

  Now go to Michael's house.....

| >MCL9. Bury the Hatchet                                                   0
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+/
| Overview /                                           \ Michael De Santa /
0=========0                                             0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0

  Michael and Trevor decide to spend some time together at the house. Then 
  the topic turns to Brad and Trevor wonders who is in Michael's grave. This 
  leads Trevor to run off and find the answer.....

0========0
| Weapons \
0=======================>

  --Combat MG.
  --Carbine Rifle.

0======0
| Notes \
0=======================>

  When doing a Mission Replay you will always start with the character you 
  didn't use in the initial play-through. If you used Michael in the initial 
  play-through then you will use Trevor in the Replay and vice versa.

  In addition, if you wish to do a Replay you I recommend waiting until after 
  the mission "Fresh Meat". Remember, whatever armor and health you have at 
  the end of a mission you can carry over into a Replay. But you won't be 
  able to restore Michael's armor and health after this mission because he is 
  captured. Once you free him then you can do a Replay of this mission with 
  full armor and health.

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  The first part of this mission depends on what character you start with:

    >>Michael
      *******
        Run out of the house and grab the first car you see off the street or 
        use one in your garage. From here, go to Los Santos International 
        Airport. As you drive he calls Trevor and tries to deal with him but 
        he refuses to listen. Then Michael calls Dave to tell him about what 
        has happened.

        When you get to the Airport then go up to the second floor terminal. 
        He'll be tracked by some Chinese people who call him the 
        "girlfriend". When you arrive at North Yankton then drive to the 
        Ludendorff Cemetery. When you get there then you need to go to your 
        Grave to start a cutscene.

    >>Trevor
      ******
        You take Michael's car and drive out to Sandy Shores Airfield. When 
        you get there then get in the plane and take off. From here, then fly 
        to North Yankton. As you get close to the marker you will be texted 
        by Ron who informs you that the Chengs are looking for you. When you 
        get to the marker then you will automatically be at the Cemetery.

  At the grave Michael finds Trevor digging it up. But, but despite Michael's 
  pleas, he eventually breaks through and finds the truth about who's in the 
  grave. It turns out to be Brad, who you already knew was dead but not 
  Trevor. This angers Trevor enough to pull a gun on Michael and both have a 
  standoff.

  However, some Chinese guys show up to break the standoff. Trevor flees as 
  Michael takes cover behind a tombstone. Now you need to shoot your way out 
  but all you have is a Pistol, all of your other weapons were removed when 
  you flew up to North Yankton. Start off by killing the first two nearby 
  then grab the Assault Rifle, which has a good amount of ammo, from one of 
  them.

  Then go back onto the upper part of the Cemetery and move to a gravestone 
  so you can use it as cover for the next part. More Chinese guys show up and 
  you need to kill them off from here. There are plenty of them but the 
  Assault Rifle should take them down quickly. After this then advance to the 
  center to face several more (and also pick up ammo from the dead bodies). A 
  couple of them will try to flank you so you will have to retreat a bit.

  After this then continue to advance little by little picking off those you 
  encounter until you reach the parking lot. When you get to your car you 
  find it to be sabotaged by Trevor and Michael is captured. You then auto 
  switch back to Trevor who is flying back to Sandy Shores.

  As you are flying you are then called by Wei Chang Sr., father of Tao 
  Cheng Jr. who Trevor dealt with earlier in the game and who sent the 
  Chinese goons you just had to deal with. Wei wants to move into Blaine 
  County but Trevor is in the way. So he tracked both Trevor and Michael.

  When he couldn't get to Trevor he took Michael and now threatens to kill 
  him if he doesn't get what he wants. In light of recent events this amuses 
  Trevor and tells Wei he is going nowhere basically telling him to kill 
  Michael if he wants. After the call then you will get a text from Lamar 
  about the last car for Devin. Continue to fly and land at the Airfield. 
  When you reach the marker then the mission is successfully completed.

0===========0
| 100% Score \
0=======================>

  >>Time (11:00)
    ************
      Start off as Trevor. Turning off Senora Freeway and shortcutting across

      this Requirement.

  >>Headshots (20)
    **************
      There are plenty of enemies so this shouldn't be too hard if you take

  >>Accuracy (80%)
    **************
      Although I recommend the Pistol, carefully using the Assault Rifle can 
      also work for this Requirement. Using your Special every so often will 
      also help.
