| >DVH4. Pack Man                                                           0
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+/
| Overview /                                               \ Devin Weston /
0=========0                                                 0+=+=+=+=+=+=0

  When Trevor arrives then he gets a message from Lamar. They managed to jack 
  the last car for Devin and they need Trevor to get the Packer so they can 
  take them to Paleto Bay.....

0======0
| Notes \
0=======================>

  When doing a Mission Replay you will always start with Franklin. The Car is 
  nearby so quickly run to it which is faster than finding a car to jack 
  since there doesn't seem to be any cars nearby when you start.

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  When you start as Trevor, and after the call, then you will auto switch to 
  Franklin who is driving near Vespucci Beach. From here, go and get the Car. 
  When you get the car then take it to the Garage. When you get there then 
  put it on the Packer.

  After the short cutscene then you auto switch to Trevor and you need to 
  drive the Packer to the Drop-Off Point in Paleto Bay. The prescribed route 
  takes you along the west side of the state and along the Great Ocean 
  Highway. However, the best route is to go north along Strawberry Ave. and 
  onto Los Santos Fwy. The conversation that occurs between Lamar and Trevor 
  as you drive is one of the most amusing in the game.

  As you pass Bolingbroke Penitentiary then the Cops get involved and you 
  will get a 2-Star Wanted Rating. Franklin decides to get out of the truck 
  and use the JB700 to get rid of the Cops. Slow down a lot and keep the 
  Packer steady enough to allow Franklin to get to the car. When Franklin 
  gets to the car then switch to him.

  He will then back the car off the Packer and you can use the vehicle's 
  defenses to get rid of the Police. Even though you have front mounted guns 
  it is best to use the Spikes to get rid of the pursuit.

  One very important thing to note: the Spikes have no effect on the Packer. 
  So go in front of the Packer, let it get up close behind you, then start 
  dropping Spikes. No matter how close the Police get to the rear of the 
  Packer you can easily blow out their tires and keep them at bay.

  After you blow out enough Cops, usually about five or so, then you will 
  finally lose the Police and Franklin calls Molly with the news of their 
  arrival. When you get to the Procopio Truck Stop then go and meet Molly. 
  After the cutscene, in which Franklin and the crew gets ripped off, then 
  the mission is successfully completed.

0===========0
| 100% Score \
0=======================>

  >>Time (12:00)
    ************
      Following the alternate route will save you nearly four minutes.

  >>Not a Scratch
    *************
      You need to complete the mission with minimal damage to the JB700. One 
      thing to note about using the guns is that the Cops will fire back on 
      you and a couple of shots is all it takes to deny you this Requirement. 
      So using the Spikes exclusively is probably the best way for this.

  >>Shredder
    ********
      You need to disable three Police cars using the Spikes.

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

  After this mission then Franklin calls Lester. Franklin wants to know where 
  Michael is at. Lester notices a lack of use of Michael's credit cards and 
  cell phone which bothers him. He will get Trevor to meet up with Franklin 
  who will be at his aunt's house......

| >FRN4. Fresh Meat                                                         0
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+/
| Overview /                                           \ Franklin Clinton /
0=========0                                             0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0

  After Aunt Denise power walks past Franklin then Trevor shows up. When he 
  trips on the fence then Franklin laughs at him. This angers Trevor and he 
  gets up in Franklin's face. Franklin apologizes and Trevor calms down.

  When the subject of Michael comes up then Trevor tells Franklin about the 
  Chinese and their kidnapping of him. When Franklin tells Trevor about 
  rescuing him then he tells Franklin off preferring to let Michael die than 
  to help him. Now Franklin has to find a way to rescue his friend......

0========0
| Weapons \
0=======================>

  --Combat Pistol.
  --Assault Shotgun.

0======0
| Notes \
0=======================>

  One thing to do before doing this mission is to find the Raven 
  Slaughterhouse which is at the southeast corner of Orchardville Ave. and El 
  Rancho Blvd. in Cypress Flats. You'll be going there during the mission and 
  you'll need to do it fast without being able to use the standard GPS.

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  To start, Franklin calls Lester with the news about Michael's kidnapping 
  and uploads a Trackify app onto Franklin's phone. You need to use it to get 
  to Michael. After the conversation then you will auto switch to Michael who 
  is being held upside down.

  The Cheng's have a brief conversation with him in an attempt to get to 
  Trevor. Michael tells them that this is a mistake. The Cheng's have had 
  enough and decide to kill Michael. A timer will then appear at the lower 
  right corner of the screen. If it runs out then Michael will die.

  At this point then quickly switch to Franklin. When you switch back you 
  should be on Forum Drive and coming up to Carson Ave. You can turn on the 
  Trackify app if you want but this is the quickest route to get to Michael. 

  From where you start, turn left onto Carson Ave. and continue southeast 
  until Carson Ave. ends and then turn left onto El Rancho Blvd. Continue 
  east until you get to the Raven Slaughterhouse where Michael is being kept. 
  Go down Orchardville Ave. a little bit to find the front entrance where you 
  will find some goons.

  Kill them with the Carbine Rifle and proceed into the building while 
  killing more. Continue to make your way through the building towards 
  Michael while killing any and all goons you encounter. When you get to 
  Michael you find that the machine jammed and that he is going nowhere. But 
  more goons show up and you need to throw some guns to Michael.

  Once Michael gets the guns then you auto switch to him. Use the Combat 
  Pistols to kill any goons that appear. Use your Special Ability if you need 
  to, especially for the two that appear to the left. After you kill enough 
  of them then you will auto switch back to Franklin. Continue forward and 
  kill the next two goons.

  However, Franklin is surprised by another who knocks him to the ground. He 
  then tries to use a knife on Franklin. The game then auto switches to 
  Michael and you need to kill the goon from long distance. Use your Special 
  Ability and kill him. Then Micheal will free himself.

  Here you can use Michael or Franklin. I recommend switching to Franklin 
  because all Michael has for weapons is the Combat Pistol - Franklin has an 
  entire arsenal. From here, carefully go through the rest of the 
  Slaughterhouse and pick off the goons that try to stop you.

  When you finally get outside then you need to take the sports car and drive 
  Michael back to his House. But, before you take the car, go to the front 
  of it and take cover.

  A few moments later a couple of more goons will show up. Kill them quickly 
  then get in the car and zoom off. If you just took the car without killing 
  them then they will get in the other car nearby and chase you. Killing them 
  now will prevent the chase.

  When you get to the House then you start a cutscene. Michael will briefly 
  explain to Franklin what happened in North Yankton years ago. After the 
  cutscene then the mission is successfully completed.

0===========0
| 100% Score \
0=======================>

  >>Switch Limiter
    **************
      You need to complete this mission without switching more than three 
      times. The one switch from Michael to Franklin within the 
      Slaughterhouse is probably all that you need to do.

  >>Accuracy (70%)
    **************

  >>Headshots (10)
    **************
      There are plenty of goons so you have plenty of opportunities for this. 
      Try to get some with Michael while he is still hanging and use his 
      Special to make his shots count. Then get the remaining headshots on 
      the goons you encounter in the last part of the Slaughterhouse.

  >>Swift Rescue
    ************
      You need to rescue Michael within three minutes and thirty seconds. 
      Following the route will get you to the Slaughterhouse quickly then 
      rapidly kill the goons you encounter until you reach Michael and the 
      timer disappears.

  >>Sense of Direction
    ******************
      You need to complete this mission without using the Trackify app. 
      Simply keep it off and follow the route outlined to get this 
      Requirement.

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

  In addition, Lester will text you that the F.I.B. wants to meet up with the 
  gang to discuss something with them thus opening up a marker at the Garment 
  Factory. You will also open up another mission at the Film Studio. Let's go

| >SMR2. The Ballad of Rocco                                                0

| Overview /                                           \ Solomon Richards /
0=========0                                             0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0

  When Michael arrives at the Studio he find Solomon being attacked by Rocco 
  who is still upset about what happened earlier. When he sees Michael then 
  he flees. Solomon wants Michael to go after them.....

0========0
| Weapons \
0=======================>

  --Micro SMG.
  --Sticky Bomb.

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  Take the nearby SUV and give chase. The problem with this vehicle is that 
  it doesn't corner very well but you can still catch up to Rocco. When you 
  get to Rocco then get close enough to toss a Sticky Bomb on the car. Then 
  detonate it to get rid of Rocco and his fellow goon.

  If he weaves too much to use the Bomb then switch to your Micro SMG and 
  quickly shoot up his car instead. Shoot up his car enough to get it to stop 
  and kill both Rocco and his friend when they get out.

  After eliminating Rocco then quickly leave the area before the Cops get 
  involved. If they do then you will need to get rid of the Rating. When you 
  get enough distance, or you get rid of the Rating, then Michael calls 
  Solomon. Solomon then requests Michael to come up to his office. You can 
  accept if you want.

  When you get to the office then Solomon will reveal to Michael a gift. He 
  has been given Associate Producer credit on the new "Meltdown" film. After 
  the cutscene then the mission is successfully completed.

| Overview /                               \ Federal Investigation Bureau /
0=========0                                 0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0

  When Michael arrives at the Factory then he tells Lester of his problems 
  with Trevor. The Big Score is on hold until they can get Trevor back on 
  board. When Steve and Dave arrive then they tell the gang what's going on. 
  Steve informs them that the I.A.A are onto them and need the help of the 
  gang to eliminate all evidence of their prior shenanigans from the F.I.B. 
  computers.....

0======0
| Notes \
0=======================>

  When doing a Mission Replay you'll be using your standard car, the 
  Tailgater.

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  After the opening cutscene then get in the car with Lester. From here, go 
  to the F.I.B. Building. As you go there then Lester informs Michael about 
  the temps that work there. Lester is looking for someone that they can turn 
  and this should give them a way into the building. Lester finds someone: 
  Harvey Molina, license plate 83QSL722.

  When you get to the Building's parking lot then you need to wait for the 
  Janitor's Car to leave. When a car comes into view then focus on the car to 
  read the license plate. Harvey's car will be the fifth car to leave, a red 
  car that doesn't stop first before turning away. When you have properly 
  identified the car then follow it but keep a good distance away so you 
  aren't spotted.

  He will eventually lead you to his apartment in Burton. Stop in the yellow 
  marker and get out of your car. Keep your distance and walk to his 
  apartment. After he gets inside then follow him. After the short cutscene 
  with Harvey then run back to your car.

  From here, speed back to the Garment Factory to meet up with Franklin. 
  Lester needs the architect's plans of the F.I.B Building so he can bypass 
  the security. He even provides a name: Chip Peterson. Franklin will leave 
  to go to tail the guy. After the meeting ends then the mission is 
  successfully completed.

    ****************

| >FIB11. Architect's Plans                                                 0
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+/
| Overview /                               \ Federal Investigation Bureau /
0=========0                                 0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0

  Franklin will be just outside a large construction site and now needs to 
  get the plans from the architect.....

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  Enter the site and tail Chip. Just after you enter then the foreman will 
  toss you a hard hat. Continue going after Chip. He will lead you to some 
  elevators. Take the other one and go up after him. When you get to the next 
  floor then he will talk to some workers. Just after that then he will enter 
  into an area that has no workers.

  While in this area then run up and knock him out. Then grab the Briefcase 
  and run back to the elevator. When you get down then run due south to exit 
  the Construction Site. Then find any car and head back to the Garment 
  Factory.

  When you get there then you need to plan the raid. There are two options: 
  The Fire Crew or The Roof Entry.

  The Fire Crew Approach requires that you steal a Firetruck then enter the 
  Building, mop the floors, and plant firebombs. When the bombs are detonated 
  then you use the Firetruck and gain access as firemen then steal the drive 
  where the files are contained. For this Approach you only need two Gunmen. 

  The Roof Approach requires that you drop down onto the building then make 
  your way to the main computer and hack it on site. For this Approach you 
  need a Driver, Gunman, and a Hacker.

  The money for the crew comes from the leftover Paleto Bay Score approved by 
  Steve. Whatever's left over can go to Michael and the rest. So a smaller 
  crew may give you more money. Below are my recommendations for each 
  Approach:

    >>The Fire Crew Approach
      **********************

        --The Gunmen (Packie McReary, Gustavo Mota)
          =========================================
            For this I prefer to use the best ones and these guys are it, 
            especially since Packie should be completely maxed out.

    >>The Roof Entry Approach
      ***********************

        --The Hacker (Rickie Lukens)
          ==========================
            Although not as good as Paige the Skill Increase he gained during 
            the Vangelico Heist makes him much better than before. Giving him 
            some more Skill should be useful for The Big Score later on.

        --The Gunman (Packie McReary)
          ===========================
            If you used him on both the Vangelico Heist and the Paleto Bay 
            Score then he should be completely maxed out thus making this a 
            no brainer.

        --The Driver (Taliana Martinez)
          *****************************
            Although Eddie Toh is almost maxed out she is pretty much right 
            there behind him and for far cheaper. Giving her some Skill 
            Increase now can be very useful for The Big Score later on.

  After choosing the Approach then the mission is successfully completed.

0===========0
| 100% Score \
0=======================>

  >>Quick Getaway
    *************
      You need to leave the Construction Site within forty five seconds. 
      After you get your hard hat then immediately run up and attack Chip 
      then grab his Briefcase.

      At this point you will piss off all of the other workers and initiate a 
      2-Star Wanted Rating. Run back to your car to successfully get this 
      Requirement. Since this is the only Requirement you can take your time 
      with the rest of the mission.

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

  If you chose The Fire Crew Approach then proceed to the next chapter.
  If you chose The Roof Entry Approach then proceed to chapter FIB15.

| >FIB12. Getaway Vehicle (The Fire Crew Approach)                          0
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+/
                                           \ Federal Investigation Bureau /
                                            0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0

Just like you did with the Blitz Play Heist you need to find a suitable
getaway vehicle and park it in a discreet location. It needs to be a four
door vehicle and cannot be any of the characters main cars.

After you acquire one then you need to find a safe place to put it. As with
the last time, I am going to park it in a specific place because that is
where it will always be when doing a Mission Replay.

Go to the intersection of Tower Way and Labor Place in Murrieta Heights. You
should see a sign for East Los Santos Foundry at the southeast corner. Go
west on Labor Place and you should see the entrance, which should be to your
left, after a short distance. Turn south through the entrance and then angle
southeast past the concrete barrier.

You should see an area between two buildings You should also see the words
"Keep Clear" on the ground just ahead of you. Park the car just beyond the
words.

| >FIB13. Fire Truck (The Fire Crew Approach)                               0

| Overview /                               \ Federal Investigation Bureau /

  To do the Fire Crew option you need to acquire a Firetruck.....

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  Go to the intersection of Vespucci Blvd. and Popular St. which is next to 
  the Garment Factory. Go to the southeast corner then pull up your phone and 
  call Contacts - Emergency Services - Fire Dept. This will bring a Firetruck 
  to your location. If things go right then the Firetruck should approach 
  from the east.

  When it stops in or near the intersection then jack it and drive to the 
  bridge tunnel under Vespucci Blvd. next to the Factory while avoiding 
  traffic. At this point you will get at least a 1-Star Wanted Rating that 
  you need to get rid of before proceeding.

  After parking the vehicle then get out and run to the LS River to avoid the 
  Cops that will come looking for you. After the Rating disappears then go 
  back to the Firetruck. Get back in then get back out to successfully 
  complete the mission.

0===========0
| 100% Score \
0=======================>

  >>What is your Emergency?
    ***********************
      You need to call 911 to get the Firetruck to come to you.

  >>Not a Scratch
    *************
      You need to deliver the Firetruck with no damage.

| >FIB14. The Bureau Raid (The Fire Crew Approach)                          0
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+/
| Overview /                               \ Federal Investigation Bureau /
0=========0                                 0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0

  When you arrive at the Factory then it's time to begin the raid.....

0========0
| Weapons \
0=======================>

  --Combat MG.
  --Carbine Rifle.
  --Sticky Bomb (provided).

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  To start, go to the F.I.B. Building. You'll already be dressed at a janitor 
  so you should have no problems getting in. Go past the turnstiles and to 
  the Elevator. When you get to the floor that you are supposed to be on then 
  go and grab the Mop. Go to the Office Floor and start mopping.

  The game will give you instructions on how to mop the floor. Clean up the 
  first spot and after a few swings on the second one then you will dirty the 
  Mop and you need to clean it. Go back to the bucket to clean it and finish 
  the remaining spot. You can avoid this by cleaning the Mop after removing 
  the first spot.

  When the floor are clean then plant the first bomb in the nearby Locker. 
  From here, head to the next area. The next four spots are pretty spread out 
  so take the bucket with you to each one instead of going back and forth. 
  When the last one is gone then plant the next bomb in the Restroom.

  Now head back to the Closet. After dropping off the Mop and Bucket then go 
  back to the Elevator and leave the building. When you get to the marker 
  then Michael will call Franklin with the news. You will then auto switch to 
  Franklin who will be dressed as a fireman and driving the Firetruck. Go and 
  pick up Michael nearby.

  Then pull up your phone and Detonate the bombs which will prompt emergency 
  services. Lester hijacked the signal so only the gang will the ones to 
  enter the Building. When you get to the Building then run inside. Go to the 
  Elevator and head up to the upper floors. When you get to Floor 47 then you 
  will notice an Oxygen Meter at the lower right corner of the screen. If it 
  runs out then you die.
  From this point then you need to run to the other end of the floor to find 
  the stairwell and climb up to Floor 53. When you get there then go to the 
  southeast corner to find the Server Room. It's locked so use a Sticky Bomb 
  to blow open the door. After that then go inside and retrieve the 
  Containment Drive.

  Now follow Michael out of the building. When you get down to the next floor 
  you will find that the stairs have collapsed. You need to find another way 
  out. Get out of the stairwell and to a stuck door. When you manage to break 
  it down then the force will knock down one of your Gunmen. Pick him up then 
  continue.

  Run through the burning hallways until you reach a collapsed floor that you 
  can take down to the next one. Continue following your Crew. At some point 
  there will be an explosion that will knock out Franklin. When he wakes up 
  then he finds that the Crew are way ahead of him.

  Unfortunately, the F.I.B. are onto you and you will encounter agents along 
  the way. Switch to your Carbine Rifle or Combat MG and take them down as 
  you run along the way. When you find the rest of the Crew then you need to 
  climb the rubble. After climbing the rubble then run to the Elevator Shaft.

  Now you need to rappel down it to safety. When you get down to the basement 
  then run back up to ground floor and out of the building. Then get back in 
  your Firetruck and drive to the parked getaway car. When you get to your 
  ride then plant a Sticky Bomb on the side. Get into your car, drive a short 
  distance, and blow up the Firetruck.

  From here, drive to Lester's House. When you get there then you start a 
  cutscene that successfully completes the mission.

0===========0
| 100% Score \
0=======================>

  >>Time (18:00)
    ************

  >>Out of Breath
    *************
      You need to escape the building with 40% oxygen remaining. This is 
      pretty easy to get since you can get over 60% even if you are slowed up 
      a bit.

  >>You Missed a Spot
    *****************
      You need to complete the mopping section within three minutes. Taking 
      the bucket with you to each spot should save some time. However, this 
      can be mildly frustrating due to the finicky mopping controls.

  >>Abseiler
    ********
      You need to abseil down the elevator shaft within thirty seconds. Just 
      keep making the long jumps all the way and you should get this 
      Requirement.

0=======0
| Reward \
0=======================>

  Michael gets nothing but the reward for Franklin will depend on what crew 
  you chose. You will also get {The Government Gimps} Accomplishment.

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

  Michael will then call Dave to tell him that the deed's done and that he's 
  out. Dave will tell Michael that the repeated attacks by Trevor on 
  Merryweather have gotten them to snoop around Dave's office. This sets up a 
  meeting at the Kortz Center.

  **NOTE: Proceed to chapter FIB16.

| >FIB15. The Bureau Raid (The Roof Entry Approach)                         0
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+/
| Overview /                               \ Federal Investigation Bureau /
0=========0                                 0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0

  Shortly after you acquired the plans then Lester texts you that it's on. Go 
  back to the Factory to begin the raid.....

0========0
| Weapons \
0=======================>

  --Assault Shotgun.
  --Sticky Bomb (provided).

0======0
| Notes \
0=======================>

  Because skill levels will be reset when doing Mission Replays I recommend 
  using Paige instead of Rickie if you need to do one.

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  To start, leave the Factory and enter your car. Wait for Franklin to enter 
  first before leaving. Your next destination is the N.O.O.S.E. Headquarters. 
  When you get there then get in the helicopter and fly to the Drop Zone. You 
  also have to fly real high too so just getting to point isn't enough.

  When you get there then the pilot takes the stick and you need to jump out 
  of the chopper. From here, you need to land on the F.I.B. Building's roof. 
  Free-fall for a few seconds then open the parachute. Angle your way down 
  then use precision landing to land on the roof. When you land then you will 
  make your way inside.

  Go to the Server Room but the door is locked. Plant a Sticky Bomb, get a 
  safe distance, then blow open the door. This will set off the alarms but go 
  inside the room to find the Terminal. Highlight My Computer then highlight 
  the external device to bring up two programs.

  Use the HackConnect program first. There will be four numbers at the top of 
  the screen. You need to match these numbers to the same four number 
  sequence that is in the mass of numbers in the center of your screen. These 
  numbers shift around so this part is tricky. Look for a number out of those 
  four that is easy to spot then find it in the mass. Once found then quickly 
  determine if this is the string before proceeding.

  After you get in then activate the BruteForce program. You'll see a bunch 
  of columns with letters going down the screen. One of the letters in each 
  column is red. You need to press your button when the red letter is in the 
  highlighted row in the center of the screen.

  When you have successfully gained the password then use the Down&Out 
  program to download the files and erase them from the database. It will 
  take two minutes for the job to be done. However, the F.I.B. are onto you 
  and will now start attacking. You need to hold them off while the download 
  is going on.

  You can switch to Franklin any time if you want or need to. I prefer to 
  stay as Michael and use the wall as cover and pick off those that come into 
  view using the powerful Assault Shotgun.

  During the firefight your chopper will come down to the roof but the F.I.B. 
  shoot it down. Continue the firefight until the download is complete. When 
  the download is complete then go back to grab the phone. Now you need to 
  get out of the building.

  Go down the stairwell and kill anybody you come across. Eventually you will 
  come to the floor where the chopper crashed. Rickie failed to turn off the 
  sprinklers which can hamper your vision. But the use of the flashlight on 
  your weapons and Assisted Aiming will compensate for that. Kill any agent 
  that you find and proceed to the end of the floor.

  After the short cutscene then you will be down on the next floor. Continue 
  along the path and you will find a paramedic with a Health kit (leave him 
  alone). Continue along the path and take down all agents you encounter. 
  Eventually you'll get to the stairwell and go down the next floor. Kill the 
  next two agents you encounter and you'll enter a room where can rappel down 
  the building.

  When you get down near the bottom then you'll need to destroy the attack 
  chopper. Although the game prompts you to use an assault rifle the Combat 
  MG should be used on it. After you shoot down the chopper then go and drop 
  down to the ground. After that then go to the Getaway Vehicle. You'll have 
  to kill off several more agents before you can get there.

  After you kill them off then you should find an Ambulance. Get inside the 
  Ambulance, which Taliana provided, and drive to Franklin's house. This will 
  start a cutscene that successfully completes the mission.

0===========0
| 100% Score \
0=======================>

  >>No Innocents
    ************
      Don't kill any innocent civilians. The one paramedic you find on the 
      last floor is the one lone civilian. Don't hurt him or let the nearby 
      agents kill him either.

  >>Headshots (20)
    **************

  >>Accuracy (70%)
    **************

  >>Perfect Drop
    ************
      You need to land on the roof, even if it is out of the landing zone, 
      without stumbling.

  >>Hacker
    ******
      You need to hack the system within forty five seconds. The key to this 
      is getting through the HackConnect portion quickly. After that then it 
      gets easier.

  >>Time (19:00)
    ************

0=======================>

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

  For some strange reason you'll also lose all of your Sticky Bombs and most 
  of your Assault Rifle ammo.

  Michael will then call Dave to tell him that the deed's done and that he's

| >FIB16. The Wrap Up                                                       0
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+/
| Overview /                               \ Federal Investigation Bureau /
0=========0                                 0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0

  Now is time to finish things up with the F.I.B.....

0========0
| Weapons \
0=======================>

  --Combat MG.
  --Sniper Rifle.
  --Assault Shotgun.
  --Minigun.

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  When you get to the Kortz Center then go over to Dave. He will be on the 
  upper level at the southeast corner and you have to get there on foot. Run 
  along the east side of the building and through the center to get to the 
  stairs to go up to Dave. You need to take the stairs west of Dave to go up. 
  The stairs to the north of him are blocked off. When you get to Dave then 
  you will start a lengthy cutscene.

  Michael wants to be cut loose but Dave tells him it won't be that simple. 
  As they haggle then Steve shows up. He is pissed that these activities has 
  ruined his career and wants both Dave and Michael arrested. Both Dave and 
  Michael pull guns on both Steve and Agent Sanchez. As the standoff 
  continues then the I.A.A. show up and this complicates things. Then the 
  F.I.B. show up. Then Merryweather show up.

  Then the shit hits the fan and a major shootout begins.

  Stay behind cover and pick off those nearby with the Assault Shotgun (which 
  will kill them quicker). As the shootout continues you find that the 
  stairway you came up on has been hit by a helicopter and you have been cut 
  off. You need to make your way to another part of the building so you can 
  make your way down to meet Dave.

  When you reach your destination then you will be ambushed by a Merryweather 
  chopper. At that point you will auto switch to.....

  .....Trevor who is operating a Sniper Rifle. Snipe the pilot to bring down 
  the chopper. Now snipe all of the SWAT who show up nearby below. After 
  sniping them all then the game will prompt you to go to Michael. Switch to 
  him and use the Combat MG and proceed further into the center of the 
  complex.

  When another chopper shows up then use the Minigun to quickly shoot the 
  pilot and bring it down. Then switch back to the Combat MG and continue to 
  the other side and to the stairs. When you get down then kill any nearby 
  gunmen and get to Dave. When you get to Dave then kill any gunmen that show 
  up and use the Minigun again on the next chopper that appears.

  The game will prompt you to switch to Trevor so go to him. Use the Assault 
  Shotgun and quickly kill the two on the balcony nearby. This will prompt an 
  auto switch back to Michael. Follow Dave to the lower parking area. Here 
  you will need to kill off several more Merryweather goons. Use of the 
  Assault Shotgun and your Special should take care of them.

  During this then you will be prompted by Trevor to go to Morningwood. After 
  the last of the Merryweather goons go down then take one of the nearby 
  vehicles, preferably a fast car, and leave. After a short distance then a 
  Merryweather chopper will appear.

  You can either try to lose it or shoot it down. I highly recommend shooting 
  it down because it shoots both Machine Guns and Rockets and it is tough to 
  lose plus you can't go to Trevor until it is gone one way or the other. 

  Immediately stop *BUT* wait for Dave to pass you by before you get out or 
  he will run you over and you will die. Switch to your Minigun and shoot 
  down the chopper when it turns the corner before it can take off too much 
  health. After this then get back into your vehicle and head to Trevor. When 
  you get to him then you will start a cutscene.

  After all that has happened the only reason Trevor came back to save 
  Michael is for The Big Score that was promised to him. This prompts a

| >SMR3. Legal Trouble                                                      0
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+/
| Overview /                                           \ Solomon Richards /
0=========0                                             0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0

  When Michael arrives at the studio he finds Devin there. Devin informs him 
  that the reason he was hooked up with Solomon was to keep the "Meltdown" 
  production around long enough to allow for total shutdown.

  Devin and his investors want to pull the plug, get a handsome insurance 
  payout, and get Solomon's son on board with dismantling the studio and 
  putting condos in its place. Molly takes the film from Solomon and leaves. 
  When Devin makes a yogi position this angers Michael enough to run off 
  after Molly and retrieve the film.....

0======0
| Notes \
0=======================>

  If you haven't done so you may want to mod your standard Tailgater with 
  improved engines as well as bulletproofing and take it with you to the Film 
  Studio. If you do a Mission Replay then you will find that your Tailgater 
  won't be in the lot waiting for you. Use the yellow car as this has better 
  handling than the white one closest to you.

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  Take one of the fast cars from the lot and speed to the Airport. Along the 
  way Devin will warn you to stop but Michael won't listen. When you get to 
  the Airport then you need to chase Molly. Molly will have a Police escort 
  but she has flipped out because of your pursuit.

  When you get close to the tarmac then you will get a 2-Star Wanted Rating 
  which will change to 3-Star when you get on the tarmac. Molly will also go 
  all over the Airport tarmac destroying things as she goes. A Weazel news 
  chopper is on the scene and you can view the chase from there if you want. 

  Continue to follow her as close as you can but still avoid the devastation 
  she causes. Eventually she will stop behind Devin's hangar. She runs inside 
  and you need to follow her in. Continue running until you find her.

  However, she gets sucked into a jet engine and drops the Film Reel. Pick it 
  up and get into the nearby private jet. Quickly take off and fly west away 
  from the Airport at top speed to lose the 3-Star Wanted Rating. When the 
  Rating disappears then the mission is successfully completed.

0===========0
| 100% Score \
0=======================>

  >>Time (5:30)
    ***********
      Keep up with Molly the whole way and not use the Weazel chase view as 
      this can slow you down. You also need to lose the Wanted Rating 
      quickly. If you are re-acquired at any time then you won't get this 
      Requirement as you will need to lose the Rating again from scratch and 
      this will cost too much time.

  >>Floor It
    ********
      You need to reach the top speed in any car. You can easily do this with 
      any of the fast cars available in the lot or with your own modded 
      vehicle.

  >>Clean Escape
    ************
      You need to lose the Wanted Rating within two minutes. Taking the 
      private jet and flying west at top speed away from the Airport is the 
      best way to get this Requirement. Keep low until the Cops lose sight of 
      you then rapidly gain altitude.

      At some point the game will spawn a Police chopper to find you. 
      However, gaining altitude will reduce their chances of seeing you and 
      you will be slowed down as you climb which will give you a better 
      chance of avoiding it.

  >>News Hound
    **********
      You need to view the Weazel News camera for fifteen seconds. I 
      recommend doing this on the tarmac where you have some room to 
      maneuver. It also doesn't have to be at one time. A few seconds here 
      and there will do the trick.

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

  Since you will be in the air at this point then fly over to the Sandy 
  Shores Airfield. While in the air Michael calls Solomon. Michael's got the 
  print but Solomon informs him that they already had multiple digital prints 
  as backup. The edit is almost finished and Solomon plans a premiere before 
  Devin can do anything else about it. However, the premiere won't happen 
  until certain things are done.

  Land the airplane at Sandy Shores Airfield and check LCN Exchange. 
  According to Jozzborne the stock for FlyUS will immediately crash to about 
  half of its original value (its original value is whatever it was at the 
  start of the mission - this can vary from play-through to play-through). 
  After it crashes then immediately invest all of your money into this stock.

  Unlike with Bilkinton, though, you cannot just sleep for days and wait for 
  it to recover. You must progress through the Main Story in order for it to 
  bounce back. Fortunately, it is only a couple of missions from this point. 
  Because of this it is *VERY* important that when you invest with Franklin 
  you *MUST* leave at least $50 in your account otherwise you may end up in 
  negative money. I'll explain why later.

  Switch to Franklin and do his next mission.....

| >FRN5. Lamar Down                                                         0
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+/
| Overview /                                           \ Franklin Clinton /
0=========0                                             0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0

  While Franklin sits at his house then Tanisha shows up with news on Lamar. 
  Lamar is in trouble but Franklin doesn't want to do anything with him. 
  Stretch sold out Lamar to the Ballas and needs to be rescued. Lamar, 
  Franklin, and Tanisha grew up together and she doesn't want to see Lamar 
  die. This forces Franklin to do something.....

0========0
| Weapons \
0=======================>

  --Micro SMG.
  --Combat MG.
  --Sniper Rifle.

0======0
| Notes \
0=======================>

  If you haven't done so you may want to mod your standard Buffalo with 
  improved engines and suspension as well as roll cages and bulletproofing.

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  To start, get inside your Buffalo and go the Sawmill which is near Paleto 
  Bay. This is where Lamar is being held. As you head there then Franklin 
  will call Lester. Lester informs him that there is a major weed operation 
  out there and that it may be a large one. Franklin will also ask him to 
  bring both Michael and Trevor in on this.

  There are two methods to doing this mission:

    >>The Standard Method
      *******************
        When you get to the Sawmill then you will auto switch to Trevor. You 
        need to find an assault position. There are three on your screen. 
        Michael notes that the one by the road fork is the most heavily 
        guarded. The one to the north has a bulldozer that can be used. The 
        last one is by the railroad.

        Put Trevor by the road fork and you will auto switch to Franklin. Put 
        him by the Dozer to the north then give the signal. Now you can 
        switch to either Michael or Trevor. Go to Trevor and start your 
        assault. Use your Combat MG and activate your Special to quickly take 
        down the initial group of Ballas.

        Continue around the south side of the facility killing Ballas as you 
        go. When you get to the east side then you find Lamar but there are 
        some snipers on the rooftop. Switch to Michael and take down all you 
        can see, especially those on the rooftops. Then switch to Franklin 
        and go rescue Lamar, killing any and all Ballas in the way.

        From here, go lead Lamar out of the facility. But the Ballas won't 
        let you get away that easily. Continue killing them as you make your 
        way down to the main entrance. You'll need to use cover as there are 
        a lot of them. As you head west then more of them show up in cars but 
        kill them while they are still inside to make things easier.

        Then Michael will alert the others that his position has been 
        compromised. Quickly switch to him, switch to your Combat MG, and 
        kill any and all Ballas that threaten him. When they are gone then 
        you will auto switch back to Franklin. From here, take Lamar back to 
        the neighborhood.

    >>Going In Through the Back Door
      ******************************
        The GPS path winds its way through the center of the state. It will 
        also take you near Stab City. Just before the turnoff to Stab City 
        you should get to the railroad tracks.

        Veer left off the road and gently get up onto the tracks then speed 
        north on them. The tracks take you right behind the Sawmill. When you 
        get to the Sawmill then drop down into the lower area at the 
        southeast corner of the facility.

        This will automatically alert the Ballas to your presence. Both 
        Michael and Trevor will automatically be at their positions and begin 
        their attack. Use your Micro SMG to take down a couple of Ballas from 
        the safety of your vehicle before the snipers show up. Then switch to 
        Michael and snipe them before switching to either Franklin or Trevor. 

        Rescue Lamar and kill the remaining Ballas. When they are gone then 
        go back to your modded Buffalo and get back onto the train tracks. 
        Retrace your path back to Senora Road and back to the neighborhood.

  Regardless of method, when you get back to the neighborhood then you start 
  a cutscene. Franklin and Lamar have an argument about friendship and 
  loyalty. After awhile then Franklin leaves but he encounters both Steve and 
  Dave from the F.I.B. They want Franklin to kill Trevor but only when the 
  time is right. This further upsets Franklin. When the cutscene finishes 
  then the mission is successfully completed.

0===========0
| 100% Score \
0=======================>

  >>Headshots (18)
    **************

  >>Accuracy (70%)
    **************

  >>Three Way
    *********
      You need to kill an enemy with all three characters.

  >>Time (13:30)
    ************
      The Back Door Method is an excellent way to save time as you are going 
      on a direct route to and from the Sawmill and you don't have to waste 
      time setting up everybody. There is also a neat shortcut near the 
      beginning you can take as well.

      Remember the earlier mission "Caida Libre"? In it you had to go down a 
      drainage channel while chasing the plane. Well, along the way as you 
      head up Baytree Canyon Road you find the same channel. Just before the 
      channel you need to get behind the guard rail then enter the channel 
      and go straight to Senora Road then turn north.

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

  to attack a few peds or go to the Banning Hidden Package (which is not far

  **NOTE: It is my understanding that one of the recent patches may have

  You will also get a text from Jimmy. They're getting ready for the movie

| Notes \
0=======================>

  will continue and you can't kill anybody regardless of where you are

  driving to the house even though you are inside.

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  You start the mission off at Ponsonbys. Go inside and buy the Tuxedo 
  (regardless of whether or not you have the money to do so - it'll be put on 
  a card if you are broke). After that then you will be picked up by a limo 
  and be taken to the theater. When you get there then go on the Red Carpet.

  Things are going great for once.

  But then Devin shows up and sneers that Michael's "wife is stuck at home".

  the screen. Take the fast car that is parked behind the limo and speed back 
  to your place.

  When you get to the house you find a couple of Merryweather jeeps in front. 
  Switch to your Combat MG and head inside (which will also stop the timer). 
  Amanda is fighting off one of the goons on the stairs. Use your Special and 
  take him down with a headshot. Then switch it off and go to Tracey's room. 
  Use your Special again and take down this goon with a headshot.

  After this then you need to clear the house of Merryweather goons. Switch 
  to your Assault Shotgun and wait. Start with the one coming up the stairs. 
  Then go downstairs and kill off the five there. It should be noted that 
  they are armored so it will take some shots to bring them down. The use of 
  the Assault Shotgun should take them down quickly.

  After clearing the house then go outside through the back. Kill those 
  nearby and then head towards the front. A couple of jeeps will appear with 
  more goons. Use cover and kill the remaining goons. When they are gone then 
  you need to go to your Family still upstairs. When you get there then you 
  start a cutscene.

  One of the Merryweather goons gets the drop on Michael but then the lights 
  go out. A mysterious figure with Night Vision Goggles comes up from behind 
  and takes down the goon. It's Jimmy who saves the day and Michael will get 
  the family to safety. When the cutscene ends then the mission is 
  successfully completed.

  >>Tier One Operator
    *****************

            /=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=\
 /=========================================================================\
| >GHF50. The Order of Things (Part Two)                                    |
 \=========================================================================/
            \=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=/

"Meltdown" / "Parenting 101" are the last Main Story missions prior to The
Big Score. However, there are other things that can be done here beforehand.
The first thing is the remainder of Lester's Assassination missions.

As I wrote earlier most people prefer to save these until after the Finale
because that is when you will paid for The Big Score and use all of the money
you have earned up to that point to invest in stock and make billions of
dollars.

But, if you're like me, you may want to have the Finale mission be the last
thing to do and earn your 100% Completion Score there. In this case this is
the latest you should do Lester's missions. You can still earn more than
enough money to buy the necessary Businesses for Completion percentage (I'll
go over them after Lester's missions).

If you followed my advice prior to the first Assassination Mission then you
should have a lot of money entering the remaining four missions. During these
missions you may acquire the following Accomplishment in the process:

  >>A Lot of Cheddar
    ****************
      For this one you need to spend at least $200 million across all three 
      characters. However, by the time you get to the last Assassination 
      Mission, you should be spending a lot of money buying up and selling 
      stock. And you should probably cross this threshold while doing that.

      If you don't have this Accomplishment by the end of the last 
      Assassination Mission then go back to the LCN Exchange and choose any 
      stock. Then buy all of it until you are broke. Once that is done then 
      immediately sell it. Then buy it back again. Then sell it again. And so 
      forth.

      Each time you buy stock it will count towards this Accomplishment. 
      Selling it will not subtract from it. For example, if you spend $40 
      million in stock, sell it, then spend $40 million again it will count 
      $80 million towards the Accomplishment.

      Do the buy/sell a few times and the Accomplishment should pop up. 
      Credit for this particular method goes to DavoK87 and x S 7 R I K E Z 
      over at www.xboxachievements.com.

Before moving onto the second of Lester's missions you should invest all of
your money into Debonaire which can be found on the LCN Exchange.....

  0+=+=+=+=+=+=0
 / Lester Crest \

| The Plan \
0=======================>

  To start, go to Vespucci Beach and kill the bodybuilder there. There will 
  also be a nine minute timer at the lower right corner of the screen - this 
  is how long you have to kill all of the tainted jurors.

  When you get to the first Juror then use your Micro SMG to kill him. If you 
  miss then he will run for it but you can just run him over to take him 
  down. After Juror 1 is dead then you will get a message from Lester about 
  the second Juror. He will be on a yacht near the Redwood Inn north of your 
  current position.

  When you get there then park in the parking lot, get out of your vehicle, 
  then kill the Juror from afar with your Sniper Rifle. After Juror 2 is dead 
  then go to Vinewood Hills. When you get there then look for a window washer 
  on the building there. Snipe him and go after the last Juror. He will be on 
  a bike in Vinewood Hills. Knock him off the bike to kill him and 
  successfully complete the mission.

0===========0
| 100% Score \
0=======================>

  >>Speedy Killer Bonus
    *******************
      You need to kill all Targets as quickly as possible.

0=======0
| Reward \
0=======================>

  $7,000.

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

  Now go back to your Safehouse. Wait for Debonaire to get to about 80% 
  profit before selling (this takes about a day or so). After selling all of 
  that stock then buy all the Redwood stock you can. It usually bottoms out 
  between $30 and $45. Sleep a few days or so and it will rebound to around 
  300% profit. Sell all of that stock at this point.

  If you have internet access then go to BAWSAQ and buy up all of the Fruit 
  stock you can. If you don't have internet access then you will have to skip 
  this step.

  0+=+=+=+=+=+=0
 / Lester Crest \
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+\
| >LSR4. The Vice Assassination                                             0
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+/
| Overview /                                               \ Lester Crest /
0=========0                                                 0+=+=+=+=+=+=0

  When you get to the phone then Lester wants you to take down Jackson 
  Skinner, product developer at Facade (a rival of Fruit). Skinner has been 
  selling customer data to everyone including terrorists. Skinner has a 
  weakness for prostitutes so that will be your angle to take him down.....

0========0
| Weapons \
0=======================>

  Sniper Rifle (silenced).

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  After the call then go down to La Puerta and park some distance away from 
  the Prostitute. Switch to your Sniper Rifle and watch her. When a car 
  approaches her then aim at the head of the driver. If she turns him away 
  then it is not Skinner. Skinner will arrive in a convertible which is a 
  major clue.

  When he arrives then she will get into his car. While she is getting inside 
  the car then kill him with a headshot. After killing him then leave the 
  area quickly. When you get far enough away then Franklin will call Lester 
  with the news. This will end the mission successfully.

0===========0
| 100% Score \
0=======================>

  >>Clean Escape
    ************
      You need to complete the mission without alerting the Cops.

0=======0
| Reward \
0=======================>

  $3,000.

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

  **NOTE: The game says that you earned $5,000 but you will only get $3,000. 
          A potential glitch, perhaps?

  If you managed to buy up the Fruit stock then wait for it to get around 50% 
  profit before selling. There is no stock to buy up prior to the next 
  mission so let's go to it.....

  0+=+=+=+=+=+=0
 / Lester Crest \

| >LSR5. The Bus Assassination                                              0
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+/
| Overview /                                               \ Lester Crest /
0=========0                                                 0+=+=+=+=+=+=0

  Lester now wants you to kill off Isaac Penny, a ruthless vulture capitalist 
  who is about to take control of Vapid motors. Penny also plans to lay off 
  thousands of workers and this pisses off Lester. However, despite his 
  riches, Penny prefers to live cheaply often taking the bus to and from 
  work. This gives Franklin the angle he needs to "drop Penny off where he 
  needs to go".....

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  After the call then go and get the Bus in La Mesa. When you get the Bus 
  then drive it to each stop until Penny gets on board. He gets upset over 
  the fare and leaves. He then steals a bike and flees. Now you can take him 
  down.

  The best thing to do is to run him off the bike using the Bus. When he is 
  killed then get out of the Bus, take the bike, and flee. After you get far 
  enough away then Franklin will call Lester with the news. This will end the 
  mission successfully.

0===========0
| 100% Score \
0=======================>

  >>Hit and Run
    ***********
      You need to kill the Target using the Bus.

0=======0
| Reward \
0=======================>

  $7,000.

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

  Wait for the news of Penny's death to be announced on the internet before 
  buying up any Vapid stock which is only available on BAWSAQ. The news will 
  cause the stock to crash. Buy up what you can and sleep until it goes up to 
  about 100% profit. Then sell the stock.

  After that then go to LCN Exchange and buy up all of the Gold Coast stock 
  you can. This will set you up for the next, and last, Assassination 
  Mission.....

  0+=+=+=+=+=+=0
 / Lester Crest \
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+\
| >LSR6. The Construction Assassination                                     0
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+/
| Overview /                                               \ Lester Crest /
0=========0                                                 0+=+=+=+=+=+=0

  Lester's last target is Enzo Bonelli, a mob guy that has become a real 
  estate developer. He has used his mob tactics to bully around the general 
  business community and Lester wants him exterminated. He will be at a large 
  construction site but Lester's informant squealed and Bonelli is expecting 
  a hit. This complicates things a bit but that should be no problem for a 
  professional like yourself.....

0========0
| Weapons \
0=======================>

  --Assault Shotgun.
  --Minigun.

0======0
| Notes \
0=======================>

  Reader Sterling P. de Mille came up with a wonderful way to quickly do this 
  on the initial playthrough.

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  There are two ways to do this depending on your personal style:

    >>The Buzzard Method (Initial Playthrough Only)
      *********************************************
        Before going to the marker you need to bring a Buzzard with you. Land 
        the chopper on the railroad tracks nearby then pick up the phone. Fly 
        the Buzzard to the marker in Pillbox Hill and gently land on it to 
        trigger the cutscene. After the cutscene then switch to Rockets and 
        gently fly straight up.

        When you get to the top then use the Rockets to quickly destroy the 
        chopper. It is important to note that you can actually lock onto the 
        enemies with the Rockets during this mission which greatly simplifies 
        and speeds up things. After destroying the chopper then quickly fly 
        away before you take too much damage from the survivors (if any).

        The reason that this method only works on the initial playthrough is 
        that on a replay you will not be allowed to go to the N.O.O.S.E. 
        Building to get a Buzzard. If you go too far away from your target 
        then you will fail the mission.

    >>The Standard Method
      *******************
        After picking up the call then go to the Construction Site. When you 
        get there then you need to get inside. You can go through any 
        entrance. However, expect to meet resistance from the goons.

        But the safest entrance is the one at the southwest corner which, by 
        the way, is also the one closest to the elevator you need to take up 
        to get to Enzo. When you get to the next level then you need to fight 
        off several goons and get to the next elevator which will take you to 
        the rooftop. Use of the Assault Shotgun works well here.

        Kill off the two goons that come down the next elevator and then take 
        it up. When you get to the rooftop then you will encounter several 
        more goons including a sniper on the crane. Enzo will also be fleeing 
        in a helicopter.

        Quickly switch to the Minigun and destroy the helicopter which will 
        also kill Enzo. Then kill everybody else before leaving the area. You 
        can either jump down using the provided Parachutes nearby (unless you 
        have one of your own) or take the elevator down. When you get out of 
        the area then Franklin will call Lester which will also successfully 
        complete the mission.

0===========0
| 100% Score \
0=======================>

  >>No Fly Zone
    ***********
      You need to shoot down the Target's helicopter. But that's not all. You 
      need to jump off of the building instead of taking the elevator down. 
      If you take the elevator down then you won't get the Requirement and 
      the bonus money. If you use the Buzzard then you will get this 
      automatically.

0=======0
| Reward \
0=======================>

  $8,000 plus $2,000 for destroying the chopper for a total of $10,000.

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

  Go back to your Safehouse then sleep until the Gold Coast stock peaks. This 
  should be around 80% or so. When that happens then sell the stock.

  If you saved the "Hitch Lift 1" Random Event Encounter until this point and 
  you have internet access then go to BAWSAQ and buy up as much Tinkle stock 
  as you can. Do the Encounter and your stock should go up around 33% or so. 
  When that happens then sell the stock.

  With that done, let's proceed.....
