 /=========================================================================\
| >GHF51. Businesses (Part Two)                                             |
 \=========================================================================/
            \=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=/

Now that I've done the remainder of the Assassination Missions and made my
money I will now focus on the remaining four Businesses for Completion
percentage and acquire the two Accomplishments related to them.

0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0
| A. McKenzie Field |~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~\
0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0

Switch to Trevor and purchase McKenzie Field in Grapeseed. You will now open
up the Arms Shipment tasks which are Non-Random. There will be a plane in the
hangar and a Dune Buggy nearby.

There will be five different scenarios for each vehicle. These tasks are not
required for 100% Completion but doing all ten scenarios will earn you the
{TP Industries Arms Race} Accomplishment.

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

When using the plane you need to take off, do the drop, and then land the
plane back at the Field and taxi it into the hangar to successfully complete
the task. You will earn $7,000 plus additional bonuses for time and accuracy.
You have a limited number of packages to drop so make them count. Below are
the five scenarios for the plane:

0===========================================================================0
| Scenario #1 | You need to make a couple of simple weapons drops similar   |
|             | to what you did in the mission "Nervous Ron".               |
|-------------+-------------------------------------------------------------|
| Scenario #2 | You need to make three weapons drops but you have to fly    |
|             | low to avoid detection on the Feds radar.                   |
|-------------+-------------------------------------------------------------|
| Scenario #3 | This time you need to drop bombs on some rivals. Get into   |
|             | the zone, which is much smaller than a regular drop, and    |
|             | drop a bomb then use the Left Analog Stick to guide it into |
|             | the center of the area to destroy everybody. Be careful,    |
|             | they will shoot back at you.                                |
|-------------+-------------------------------------------------------------|
| Scenario #4 | You have to drop bombs again but this time on a group of    |
|             | boats and a moving train. Destroy the train first before it |
|             | moves too far away. Get in behind it and drop the bomb      |
|             | close to it. It doesn't have to be a direct hit - just      |
|             | close enough to destroy it. Then go after the boats since   |
|             | they are stationary.                                        |
|-------------+-------------------------------------------------------------|
| Scenario #5 | Rivals have taken over the Sandy Shores Airfield and you    |
|             | need to get rid of them using carpet bombs on the targets   |
|             | below. You need to line yourself with a group of targets    |
|             | before dropping the bomb. This is easily the hardest of all |
|             | of the Arms Shipment tasks.                                 |
0===========================================================================0

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

The second vehicle for the Arms Shipment is the Dune Buggy. The main thing to
do here is to quickly get the Arms Package drop and drive back to the Field
before your rivals can get there. You will get $5,000 for each task completed
but there are no additional bonuses. Below are the five scenarios for the
Buggy:

0===========================================================================0
| Scenario #1 | You need to get to an Arms Package before the competition   |
|             | does. Pick it up then drive back to the Field. You will     |
|             | have to cut across the land to your destination to avoid    |
|             | potential Cop involvement since they will be watching the   |
|             | roads.                                                      |
|-------------+-------------------------------------------------------------|
| Scenario #2 | A rival found out about a drop and you need to beat them to |
|             | it. The fact that the Cops won't be watching the roads will |
|             | make beating them to it easy by taking a direct route to    |
|             | the Package. After acquiring the Package then quickly lose  |
|             | them and go back to the Field.                              |
|-------------+-------------------------------------------------------------|
| Scenario #3 | This is a repeat of Scenario #1 but with a different        |
|             | destination. In addition, the rivals will chase you         |
|             | regardless of how fast you were to the Package. You will    |
|             | need to exit your vehicle and kill them before finishing    |
|             | the task.                                                   |
|-------------+-------------------------------------------------------------|
| Scenario #4 | This is a repeat of Scenario #2 except that the rivals more |
|             | than likely will beat you to the package this time. This    |
|             | means killing them before they get too far away from you.   |
|             | Use your Micro SMG to kill them, get the Package from them, |
|             | and drive back to the Field.                                |
|-------------+-------------------------------------------------------------|
| Scenario #5 | The Arms Package will be dropped off in the Grand Senora    |
|             | Desert National Park south of Sandy Shores. The Cops will   |
|             | be watching the roads so you will need to cut across the    |
|             | land. When you get to the drop then Oscar will warn you of  |
|             | an ambush.                                                  |
|             |                                                             |
|             | As you drive off, several rivals will appear on your radar  |
|             | but they are easy to lose. As you get near the Field you    |
|             | may get attacked by a rival helicopter. Get out of your     |
|             | Buggy and use your Carbine Rifle to destroy it.             |
0===========================================================================0

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

After acquiring the Accomplishment you can stop doing these tasks. If you
want you can do more and the Scenarios will cycle through again. However,
they will be tougher this time as you will have to make more drops, destroy
more targets, and chase down rivals who will get the Package long before you
can get to the drop.

0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0
| B. Franklin's Businesses |~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~\
0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0

Switch to Franklin and go purchase the last three Businesses for Completion
percentage:

0===================0
| Los Santos Customs \
0=========================================================>

  Although The Hen House is cheaper this Business, located in the Grand 
  Senora Desert, doesn't have any tasks associated with it. This becomes a 
  "buy and forget" place. An important thing to note is that any mods you buy 
  here will be free. But it can only be done here - not at any other Los 
  Santos Customs - and only with Franklin.

0===============0
| Towing Impound \
0=========================================================>

  This place has the same type of towing tasks that you did for Tonya 
  earlier. But the tasks are Non-Random so you can "buy and forget" this 
  Business.

0=================0
| Downtown Cab Co. \
0=========================================================>

  This is a taxi Business that will occasionally call you to pick up and 
  deliver customers. There will be nine total customer scenarios and they 
  will cycle again when you finish the last one. Your fare will vary 
  depending on scenario. You will get $2,000 in income weekly and all taxi 
  rides are free. You will also get the {All's Fare in Love and War} 
  Accomplishment upon completion of your first fare.

  At some point after you buy the Business you should get a call to pick up a 
  customer over at Mount Zonah Medical Center. The thing to note is that you 
  can use any car including your modded Buffalo.

  Your customer is an adrenaline junkie and wants you to drive recklessly to 
  his destination, the Vinewood sign. Drive against traffic, drift through 
  turns, occasionally smack into traffic, and go offroad to keep him from 
  getting bored. When you complete the fare then the Accomplishment should 
  pop up.

  Although this is a Random Task Business you will only be called about once 
  per week or two weeks. By buying this Business near the end of the game 
  then this one fare may be the only one you do until after the Finale.

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

Now that the Businesses are done and you have Completion percentage and the
three Accomplishments it is time to move on. But, before doing so, you should
switch to Trevor and do something that can be useful for The Big Score. Find
a good solid four door car then mod it with the best of everything then store
it at your garage which is the one closest to the Vanilla Unicorn. When you
are done with that then proceed to the next chapter.....

  0+=+=+=+=+=+=+0
 / The Big Score \
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+\
| >TBS1. Planning the Score                                                 0
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+/
                                                          \ The Big Score /
                                                           0=+=+=+=+=+=+=0

You can send in any character to start this sequence. It is time to do The
Big Score. There are two options for doing it.

The first option, Subtle, involves hijacking the armored cars then hack into
the street light system and manipulate them to aid in the escape. Then load
up the loot into modified cars and speed off. The second option, Obvious,
involves creating a distraction and drilling into the Depository to get at
the loot.

The Subtle Method requires a large crew (two Gunmen, two Drivers, and a
Hacker) while the Obvious Method requires a slightly smaller crew (two Gunmen
and two Drivers). Below are my recommendations for both Approaches:

  --The Gunmen (Packie McReary, Chef)
    =================================
      I'm going to save a little bit of money here and go with Chef alongside 
      a completely maxed out Packie. If you did The Fire Crew Approach during 
      The Bureau Raid and used Gustavo Mota then use him in place of Chef as 
      he should be maxed out as well.

  --The Drivers (Eddie Toh, Taliana Martinez)
    =========================================
      This massive job calls for good people and I will go with Eddie for one 
      of the drivers. Regardless of whether or not you used Taliana during 
      The Bureau Raid I highly recommend her as the second driver as she is 
      almost as good as Eddie (and maxed out if you used her before) and is 
      very cheap thus allowing you to make more money.

  --The Hacker (Rickie Lukens) [Subtle Approach Only]
    =================================================
      If you used him at every opportunity then he should surpass Paige in 
      just about every skill. And, since he is also the cheapest member, you 
      can make even more money for yourself.

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

After you choose your Approach then you can proceed forward based on that
choice:

  >>For the Subtle Approach then proceed to the next chapter.
  >>For the Obvious Approach then proceed to chapter TBS5.

  0+=+=+=+=+=+=+0
 / The Big Score \
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+\
| >TBS2. Stingers (The Subtle Approach)                                     0
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+/
| Overview /                                              \ The Big Score /
0=========0                                                0=+=+=+=+=+=+=0

  Your first target is a Police van with Stingers that are needed to disable 
  the armored cars.....

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  You need to go to the Davis Police Station. The Police Transporter is in 
  the area where the other Police cars are parked. You need to sneak inside 
  and steal the van. There are three Police officers to avoid, two to the 
  north and one near the Van.

  You cannot go through the chain-link door by the Towing business - you must 
  go in another way. Next to the Police Station is a raised area with 
  benches. Go here and climb one of the benches to see over the wall. You 
  want to jump down next to the Van.

  When you jump down then sneak behind the lone officer and knock him out - 
  don't worry, you won't get a Wanted Rating. It should be noted that if you 
  are spotted by him while taking the Van then you will get a Wanted Rating 
  you need to get rid of. Of course, this complicates things.

  Once you get the Van then take it to a spot under a bridge next to the 
  Vanilla Unicorn. When you park the van then get away from it to 
  successfully complete the mission.

0===========0
| 100% Score \
0=======================>

  >>Escapee
    *******
      You need to steal the Police Transporter and escape within two minutes. 
      Taking the Van without being spotted makes getting this Requirement 
      much easier.

  >>Not a Scratch
    *************
      You need to deliver the Police Transporter with no damage. Taking the 
      Van without being spotted also makes getting this Requirement much 
      easier.

  0+=+=+=+=+=+=+0
 / The Big Score \
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+\
| >TBS3. Gauntlet (1, 2, 3) (The Subtle Approach)                           0
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+/
| Overview /                                              \ The Big Score /
0=========0                                                0=+=+=+=+=+=+=0

  Your next targets are a certain type of car.....

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  You need to get three Gauntlets which then need to be modded for the Heist. 
  Acquiring each car is a mission onto itself with the same Requirements. I 
  recommend using Michael for this since he should have the most money to 
  spend on the required modifications.

  You will be given a text with pictures on where to find the Gauntlets that 
  were spotted on camera. You can use any Gauntlet you find on the street if 
  you want but going after the ones in the text is easier. Listed below are 
  the locations:

    >>Gauntlet #1
      ***********
        On top of a parking garage in Pillbox Hill (the red and white garage 
        along Peaceful St. just north of the intersection of Peaceful St. and 
        Vespucci Blvd.).

    >>Gauntlet #2
      ***********
        Parked by the CaCa Store in Rockford Hills (along Portola Dr. and not 
        far from the Vangelico Jewelry Store you robbed earlier in the game).

    >>Gauntlet #3
      ***********
        Parked in an angled parking space on Fantastic Pl. across the street 
        from the Templar Hotel (which is at the southwest corner of Fantastic 
        Pl. and Vespucci Blvd.) in Mission Row.

  When you get a Gauntlet then you need to take it to a Los Santos Customs to 
  have it modded for the job. The one the game chooses for you is the one 
  that Hao runs (Los Santos International Airport).

  You have to get the Gold Preparation option then any other mods you want or 
  need. I recommend buying all of the Extras in addition to the Heist Prep. 
  After upgrading the vehicle then carefully take the car to the Lock-Up on 
  Elysian Island. After parking it there then leave the Lock-Up to 
  successfully complete the mission.

0===========0
| 100% Score \
0=======================>

  >>Mapped
    ******
      You need to deliver the Gauntlets pictured in the email. Although you 
      can take any Gauntlet in the street you need to get the ones pictured 
      in order to get this Requirement.

  >>Not a Scratch
    *************
      You need to deliver the Gauntlets to the Lock-Up with no damage. This 
      also means no damage on the way to the Los Santos Customs. If you have 
      to pay for repairs then you can't get this Requirement. You also need 
      to carefully drive from the Los Santos Customs to the Lock-Up as well.

  >>Pimped Out
    **********
      You need to spend at least $17,000 modifying the Gauntlet. The Heist 
      Prep alone costs $11,000 so you only really need to spend $6,000 more. 
      Buying all of the Extras and a change of paint should cost you about 
      $26,300 making getting this Requirement very easy.

  0+=+=+=+=+=+=+0
 / The Big Score \
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+\
| >TBS4. The Big Score (The Subtle Approach)                                0
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+/
| Overview /                                              \ The Big Score /
0=========0                                                0=+=+=+=+=+=+=0

  The crew is assembled and ready to pull off the dream job.....

0========0
| Weapons \
0=======================>

  --Advanced Rifle (provided).
  --Sniper Rifle.
  --Assault Shotgun.

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  You start as Michael and you need to get in the car. You will see a timer 
  at the lower right corner of the screen that starts at 07:00 AM. You need 
  to get to the tunnel by 08:00 AM or you will fail the mission. When you get 
  to the tunnel then you need to wait for a little bit.

  When the Armored Vans show up then deploy a Stinger and drive up a bit to 
  give them some room. When the tires are popped then get out of the car. 
  During the cutscene then the rest of the crew arrive to repair the popped 
  tires while everybody else gather up the hostages. But Michael needs one of 
  them to help in getting inside. They find one named Casey.

  From here, drive the Armored Van to the entrance of the Depository. This 
  starts a cutscene of the gang entering the building. After the cutscene 
  then follow the Manager. He will lead you to an elevator. After the 
  elevator then the Manager, and Casey, will open the safe and let the gang 
  inside. Continue to follow the Manager and he will lead you to the Gold.

  After you collect the Gold then follow the team back to the elevator. Then 
  follow them back to the loading dock. After this then get back in the Van. 
  From here, follow Trevor out of the building. As you drive then Franklin 
  will tell Michael that Merryweather knows of what they are doing and is 
  trying to stop them. Franklin has tapped into the transportation grid and 
  you need to switch to him.

  You will then see the grid. There are multiple signal lights on the grid. 
  One side of each square will be red and the other green. The Vans are the 
  blue arrows. Switch the lights near them to green so they can proceed. 
  Merryweather personnel will show as red arrows. You need to delay them at a 
  light or let them through before your Vans get there.

  As your Vans proceed then switch the lights according to what Michael or 
  Trevor tell you. Once the Vans safely arrive at the Destination then you 
  need to switch vehicles. Michael will let Casey go with a gold brick as a 
  reward. But then Merryweather goons show up to crash the party.

  You will need to fight through them before you can leave. And there are a 
  whole lot of them. I recommend using the Assault Shotgun as this will kill 
  them quickly. There will also be snipers on one of the upper levels of the 
  interchange. Switch to your Sniper Rifle and take them down then continue 
  fighting off the others.

  After killing all of the Merryweather goons then you need to drive off with 
  the loot. But the Cops are onto you and you now have a 5-Star Wanted Rating 
  to contend with. However, with all of the modifications you added to the 
  Gauntlets, they shouldn't pose much of a problem. You need to follow the 
  Crew through the city while avoiding collisions and other hazards. 

  Eventually you will end up in the Del Perro Fwy. tunnel. Here you need to 
  drive your car into one of the big rigs brought for the job. When you get 
  inside the truck then you will drop off the Gold at the Grand Senora 
  Desert. From here, drive back to Michael's House. When you get there then 
  you start a cutscene that successfully completes the mission and The Big 
  Score.

0===========0
| 100% Score \
0=======================>

    **************

    **********
      You need to perform less than ten traffic light changes. This isn't too 
      hard since the Merryweather goons tend to be far enough away from you 
      (or stuck at a light already red) to not become much of a problem.

  >>Accuracy (60%)
    **************

You need to get a four door car as your getaway vehicle. Like before it
cannot be any of the characters normal vehicles (Buffalo, Tailgater, Bohdi).
When you find one then the game will notify you whether or not it is
suitable. If it is suitable then you can call Lester to tell him about the
find. This will put a marker on your map and where you need to park the car.

If you prepped earlier then you should already have a modded car inside
Trevor's garage. Take it out, call Lester, then park the car where it needs
to go.

| >TBS6. Driller (The Obvious Approach)                                     0
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+/
| Overview /                                              \ The Big Score /
0=========0                                                0=+=+=+=+=+=+=0

  Your next target is something to bore a hole in the Depository.....

0========0
| Weapons \
0=======================>

  Sniper Rifle (silenced).

0======0
| Notes \
0=======================>

  If you do a Mission Replay then you will be placed just outside the main 
  entrance. I also recommend Michael to do this just in case you want to use 
  his Special.

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  The Cutter will be in La Mesa. It will also be heavily guarded. You can run 
  in and take it but this will incur a 2-Star Wanted Rating which will be 
  difficult to lose because of the large and slow vehicle. You should get rid 
  of the guards before you can take it. Go to the main entrance on Popular 
  St.

  While looking at the entrance then run to the area next door south of where 
  the Cutter is parked. There should be a couple of dumpsters with ramps. 
  Climb up the ramps but don't drop down. Switch to your Sniper Rifle and 
  wait.

  One guard will walk to a garage door near the Cutter. When he stops then 
  kill him. Then look to the northwest and you should make out the head of a 
  guard above a dirt pile and near the transmission tower. Kill him then look 
  north. You should see two guards there. Kill the one in the far background 
  but *DO NOT* kill the one in the foreground.

  After that then run to the area directly across the street from the 
  entrance. Kill the guard at the gate. Then look for the three guards to the 
  right of where the previous guard was standing. Quickly line yourself in 
  such a way that all three are in a straight line. Then use the Sniper Rifle 
  to kill all three in one shot. After that then kill the final guard at the 
  opposite gate.

  When those guards are dead then run through the entrance but go into sneak 
  mode about partway through the yard. Angle left to find the last remaining 
  guard, the one I told you not to kill. Sneak up behind him and knock him 
  out. When all of the guards are down then go and get into the Cutter and 
  leave the yard.

  If you get a 2-Star Wanted Rating your best bet is to go near the north end 
  of the LS River and park the Cutter. Get out then drop down into the tunnel 
  so you can lose the Cops.

  After either quietly acquiring the Cutter or losing the Wanted Rating then 
  Michael calls Lester. He then tells Michael to park the machine at the 
  Parking Lot next to the Depository. When you get there then the mission is 
  successfully completed.

0===========0
| 100% Score \
0=======================>

  >>Sneak Thief
    ***********
      You need to steal the Cutter without being detected. In order to get 
      this Requirement you *MUST* do a Stealth Takedown on any of the guards 
      regardless of what you do with the others. If you just kill all of the 
      guards, even if you are undetected the entire time, you *CANNOT* get 
      the Requirement. This is why I wrote things this way.

  >>Time (5:00)
    ***********
      Stealing the Cutter without being detected is essential for this 
      Requirement.

| >TBS7. Sidetracked (The Obvious Approach)                                 0
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+/
| Overview /                                              \ The Big Score /
0=========0                                                0=+=+=+=+=+=+=0

  Your next target is a train to carry the gold.....

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  When you get close to Davis Quartz then you should see two red dots. These 
  are the Railway Workers you need to incapacitate. After they appear then 
  Michael will call Trevor to tell him to fly out there. Run up to the stairs 
  leading up to the platform then enter sneak mode. One of them will be at 
  the Signal Box above you and the other will be by the track.

  Go up and knock out the one by the tracks then go up and knock out the one 
  by the Box. After that then change the Sidings. Now you have to wait for a 
  train to stop in the Sidings. After a short wait then a train will come and 
  be diverted. When that happens then switch to Trevor who will be at the 
  Airfield.

  He will be in a Skylift and you need to pick up the Freight Engine. Fly 
  there and drop low enough so you can pick up the Engine with the 
  electromagnet. Once you have the Engine then take it to the Airfield. Fly 
  low over the trailer and drop the Engine onto it. Now fly back to the train 
  and get a Flatbed. Repeat the process and grab any of the Flatbeds marked.

  Then fly it back to the Airfield and drop it onto the trailer. When you 
  have done that then the mission is successfully completed.

0===========0
| 100% Score \
0=======================>

  >>Mission Time (4:30)
    *******************
      This one is a little annoying to get because the timing is a little 
      tight and you need to pick up and drop off each piece without a lot of 
      mistakes. It may be best to do this on a Mission Replay since you will 
      start right on the track platform not far from the workers thus saving 
      you time as the mission usually starts the moment they appear on the 
      radar.

  >>Undetected
    **********
      You need to steal the train without being detected.

| >TBS8. The Big Score (The Obvious Approach)                               0
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+/
| Overview /                                              \ The Big Score /
0=========0                                                0=+=+=+=+=+=+=0

  The crew is assembled and ready to pull off the dream job.....

0========0
| Weapons \
0=======================>

  --Advanced Rifle (provided).
  --Sticky Bomb.

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  You start off as Michael and you need to get in the car and drive to the 
  Bank. When you get there then you will meet up with one of your Gunmen. 
  Then you will auto switch to Franklin who is in the tunnel.

  Next, drive the Cutter through the marked wall to get at the Gold. After 
  you drill the hole then back out the Cutter and park it. Then go and place 
  Sticky Bombs on the two cage doors and get back so you can blow them open. 
  After blowing open the doors then you need to protect your other Gunman 
  from the N.O.O.S.E coming in from the tunnels to the south.

  Use your new Advanced Rifle on them. However, more of them will appear from 
  the north. Use cover and quickly take care of them before they take off too 
  much damage. After that then things clear up for now. Use this time to get 
  the Health and Armor that is normally down here to heal yourself if you 
  need it.

  At this point one of the helicopters come to take some of the Gold away. As 
  they are trying to take the Gold away then some more N.O.O.S.E. appear in 
  the vault. Kill them off quickly. As you are doing that then Trevor has to 
  pull out due to some more N.O.O.S.E. rappelling down into the tunnel. Turn 
  around and quickly kill off the three N.O.O.S.E. then switch to Trevor.

  You now have to fly out of the city. Fly north and when you get to the city 
  limits then switch to Michael. Now you have to shoot your way out of a 
  5-Star Wanted Rating. Proceed forward alongside the building and take down 
  all you see using the Advanced Rifle. When you get down to the next level 
  then meet up with Franklin and you will need to cross the bridge. However, 
  it will be crawling with more Police.

  Use cover and quickly pick off all you can. You can switch to Franklin of 
  your health gets too low. Cross the bridge and continue alongside the 
  buildings killing all that appear including those down at ground level. 
  Later, a Police chopper will appear. Kill those inside before they can take 
  off too much damage. Along the way Lester will tell you about Merryweather. 
  They found out about the job and will try to stop you.

  Eventually you will have to move up a level and end up in a courtyard. Here 
  you need to fight off more Police including those in a helicopter. Get into 
  cover and take down the ones coming from the chopper before they can do 
  much harm. After that then move towards the center and take down any who 
  oppose you.

  Proceed through the courtyard to encounter a Merryweather chopper. Shoot 
  the pilot to take it down. Next, proceed down and take down the N.O.O.S.E. 
  waiting for you. Then proceed forward and around the corner. Proceed 
  forward and take down the Cops in the street as you do so. You will then 
  head downstairs and into the parking garage where you have your modded car.

  But more N.O.O.S.E. show up in their special vehicles. Pick them off before 
  they can get out to make things easier. Use the pillars as cover as you get 
  rid of the rest. After you have dealt with all three carloads of N.O.O.S.E. 
  then get into your Getaway Car and leave.

  The quickest way to deal with the Wanted Rating is to go north out of the 
  tunnel and turn right. You will get to the bridge that crosses Del Perro 
  Fwy. This is the same bridge that you used to drop down onto the Freeway 
  during the Vangelico Heist. Find the bridge break and drop down onto the 
  Freeway and go straight to the construction tunnel. Drive far enough in 
  and wait for the Rating to go away.

  After losing the Rating then you will check on Trevor. Unfortunately, 
  Merryweather are onto them and you need to switch to him. When you switch 
  to him then you need to follow your other driver who is in the other 
  chopper. Now you have to deal with three Merryweather choppers who are 
  approaching you.

  You need to keep your chopper on a steady course and close to the other 
  choppers so Lester can shoot them down with some RPGs. As you try to take 
  down the choppers then your other driver will take evasive action by going 
  through the Wind Farm. If you don't bring down the choppers in time then 
  they can take down the other chopper and reach your drop-off point which 
  will result in a mission failure.

  Even so you need to maintain a steady course so Lester can shoot them down. 
  If you do things correctly then you should destroy the last one at the 
  north end of the Wind Farm. When all three of the choppers are down then 
  get behind the train, fly low, and drop off the Gold. After that then go to 
  McKenzie Airfield. When you get there then the mission, and The Big Score, 
  is successfully completed.

Shortly after Franklin arrives home then Devin Weston makes a visit. He wants
Franklin to kill Michael after what happened with the movie and Merryweather.
Franklin also has orders to kill Trevor. This leaves Franklin with three
choices:

  >>Option A: Kill Trevor - proceed to the next sub-chapter.
  >>Option B: Kill Michael - proceed to sub-chapter B.
  >>Option C: Deathwish - proceed to sub-chapter C.

| A. Something Sensible |~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~\
0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0
| Overview /
0=========0

  Although Franklin and Trevor have become friends he has become very 
  agitated as of late, especially where Michael is concerned. This makes him 
  very dangerous and could end up costing Franklin in the long run. He 
  decides that Trevor has to go.....

0========0
| Weapons \
0=======================>

  Pistol.

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  After calling up Trevor then Franklin calls Michael to tell him of what he 
  plans to do. From here, go to the south end of the Oil Fields. When you get 
  there then you confront Trevor and he speeds off. He will lead you on a 
  long chase that goes against freeway traffic and eventually ends up back at 
  the Oil Fields.

  All you have to do is keep up with him - you don't need to try to stop his 
  car. When he gets into part of the industrial area of the Fields then you 
  start a cutscene.

  Michael ambushes Trevor and makes him ram into a gas tanker causing it to 
  spill gasoline and douse Trevor. When you regain control then fire one shot 
  into the gas puddle to set it, and Trevor, aflame. This will start another 
  cutscene with both Michael and Franklin. They both walk away from Trevor 
  and each other. This will also successfully end the mission and the Main 
  Story.

    ******

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

  You will also auto switch to Michael. Because Trevor is dead, you can no 
  longer switch to him. Lester will also text you about not being able to 
  find Trevor and splits his share between you and Franklin. Shortly 
  afterwards you will finally get your payout, plus half of Trevor's share, 
  from The Big Score into your account.

  When you switch to Franklin he will get a nasty email from Ron. He will 
  also get a call from Steve. Steve will get close to Devin to help keep him 
  from getting revenge on both Franklin and Michael because you killed Trevor 
  instead of Mike. This also ends your involvement with the F.I.B.

| B. The Time's Come |~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~\

  leads to the same result - Michael's death.

  After you do the deed then Franklin calls Lamar. This will also

| C. The Third Way |~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~\
0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0
| Overview /
0=========0

  Franklin is good friends with both Michael and Trevor and doesn't want to 
  kill either of them despite what Steve and Devin wants. Franklin calls up 
  Lester for help.....

0========0
| Weapons \
0=======================>

  --Advanced Rifle.
  --Sniper Rifle (silenced).
  --Nightstick.
  --Assault Shotgun.
  --Sticky Bomb.

0======0
| Notes \
0=======================>

  This is the only mission where a Mission Failure will not nullify your Time 
  and Accuracy Requirements. But this is only on the initial play-through. If 
  you fail during a Replay then they will be nullified.

  In addition, you should make sure that all three guys have full health, 
  armor, and ammo prior to choosing this ending.

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  After the call then go to Lester's house. When you get there then Lester 
  comes up with a plan to lure both Steve and Devin to a foundry for an 
  ambush where you can take them both down. Lester will call both Michael and 
  Trevor in on the plan. Franklin will also call Lamar and get him on it. 
  After the call then go to his house and pick him up.

  When you pick him up the head to the Foundry. When you get there then enter 
  the place and make your way to where Trevor and Michael are bickering, as 
  usual. After the cutscene then you need to fight off the F.I.B. Team that 
  has just entered the building. Stay as Franklin and use your cover to pick 
  them off with the Assault Shotgun. Although you have the Advanced Rifle the 
  close quarters are better suited to the Shotgun.

  After taking down the F.I.B. Team then Merryweather comes in. You will also 
  be prompted to switch to Trevor which you should do. As you take down the 
  attackers you find that they are also shooting at each other which helps 
  you out. As the battle continues then you will need to go out and help 
  Lamar. Switch to Franklin, jump down onto the lower level, and quickly go 
  out the way you came while taking down those who oppose you.

  When you get outside then get in cover behind the crate next to your car 
  and take down the F.I.B. that are outside. After taking down most of the 
  F.I.B. then you are requested to rescue Trevor. Switch to Michael and kill 
  off the F.I.B. as you make your way to Trevor. When you get to him then get 
  back into cover and defend yourself against the next wave of attackers. 

  After this then you need to go outside and help Franklin. Do *NOT* follow 
  Trevor out onto the upper level of the Foundry. Instead, go out the same 
  way Franklin came in and take cover behind the car. Take down the remaining 
  F.I.B. Team then go around the corner and start taking down the 
  Merryweather goons attacking Trevor. Use the corner as cover as you get rid 
  of these guys.

  At some point you will be attacked by a Merryweather chopper. Switch to the 
  Advanced Rifle and shoot the pilot to bring it down. After that then 
  continue killing off the remaining Merryweather crew with the Assault 
  Shotgun. After taking down the last of Merryweather then go to the Main 
  Doors and regroup.

  The current plan isn't working so they decide to go after certain people to 
  tie up loose ends - Steve, Devin, Cheng, and Stretch. Franklin calls Lester 
  for help and he pinpoints Steve, Stretch, and Cheng's locations. Trevor 
  goes after Steve, Michael goes after Stretch, and Franklin goes after 
  Cheng.

  Even though you are Franklin at this point you should switch to Michael. Go 
  to where Stretch is at. When you get near then you can attack him. You can 
  drive-by him, run him over, or get just far enough to use a Sniper Rifle on 
  him. However, this may get his Balla friends to attack you. If this happens 
  then you need to get away from them quickly before you can proceed.

  Usually you will be chased by a fast Balla car. Immediately stop, get out 
  of your car, and use your Assault Shotgun to take care of them quickly then 
  continue driving away. When you are far enough away then you can switch to 
  either Franklin or Trevor. Switch to Trevor who should be on the Del Perro 
  Pier.

  Get into position just outside of the amusement park and find Steve on the 
  Ferris Wheel. Use your silenced Sniper Rifle and take him down with a 
  headshot. This will trigger a 2-Star Wanted Rating so you need to lose it 
  before you can proceed. Run north, drop down onto the beach, and run north 
  along it. This should be enough to quickly lose the Rating. When it is gone 
  then switch to Franklin.

  He should be close to the Pacific Bluffs Country Club where Cheng is at. 
  When you get there then you should see three vehicles, two with bodyguards 
  and the center one with Wei Cheng. Throw Sticky Bombs on all three cars. 
  While you are throwing the Bombs you will be attacked but if you're fast 
  enough then you can escape serious damage.

  Let them get far enough away from you then detonate to get rid of all three 
  vehicles. If any of them survive then you will need to kill the remaining 
  Triads before proceeding. When the last Triad are dead then Franklin calls 
  the group. Now switch to Trevor who has found Devin's residence.

  Drive to Devin's house to find that he has surrounded himself with 
  Merryweather guards. Your next goal is to kidnap Devin. You will need to 
  kill the guards first but they aren't too hard to deal with since there is 
  only a small number of them and you have the powerful Advanced Rifle at 
  your disposal.

  After killing the guards then find Devin who will be in the wicker chest 
  near the pool. After kidnapping Devin then take him to the Rendezvous Point 
  which is the Sonar Collections Dock in Chiliad Mountain State Wilderness. 
  When you get there then you meet up with the rest of the gang and properly 
  deal with Devin once and for all. This will also successfully complete the 
  mission and the Main Story.

0===========0
| 100% Score \
0=======================>

  >>Time (21:30)
    ************
      Using Michael to kill most of the Merryweather goons outside the 
      Foundry is a good time saver. Killing your Targets in the prescribed 
      order saves a lot of time since each member of the trio will be close 
      to each Target when you switch to them.

      There is also a nice shortcut just after you leave Devin's house. After 
      you turn left you should see some wooden fences for the guardrail. 
      Break through them and go down the hillside. This will take you 
      straight down to the Great Ocean Highway and save you a lot of valuable 
      time.

      However, you have to be careful when going off the road. If you come 
      off wrong then you may find yourself rolling uncontrollably down the 
      hillside. This will negate most of the time you're trying to save.

  >>Headshots (20)
    **************

  >>Accuracy (70%)
    **************

  >>Stick, Tick...Boom!
    *******************
      You need to kill Cheng with a Sticky Bomb.

  >>Lead Lobotomy
    *************
      You need to kill Steve Haines with a headshot. This is pretty easy 
      since the Ferris Wheel moves slowly.

  >>Stretched Out
    *************
      You need to kill Stretch with a melee weapon. The Nightstick works well 
      here but you will have to speed away from the area quickly to avoid 
      serious damage when the Ballas start attacking.

0=======0
| Reward \
0=======================>

  The {To Live and Die in Los Santos} Accomplishment.

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

  After the mission then you will auto switch to Trevor. He will get an email 
  from Dave telling him about those letters from Brad. If you switch to 
  Michael then you will get an email from Dave telling you to stay out of 
  trouble. If you switch to Franklin then you will get emails from both 
  Michael and Lamar.

0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0
| D. Mrs. Philips / Damaged Goods |~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~\
0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0

If you chose either Option B or Option C then you also open up a Stranger
marker at Trevor's Safehouse. This starts the optional mission "Mrs. Philips"
in which he meets his mother. You need to find a Deludamol van and bring it
to her.

According to gta.wikia.com you can find one at the Dollar Pills store in
Strawberry or at most Hospitals (except Sandy Shores and Paleto Bay). When
you get the van then you start another mission called "Damaged Goods". Take
it back to your Safehouse to complete the encounter. After the encounter the
Deludamol van will spawn at most Hospitals.

            /=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=\
 /=========================================================================\
| >GHF52. Other Rewards                                                     |
 \=========================================================================/
            \=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=/

In addition to the {To Live and Die in Los Santos} Accomplishment you will
also have most of the outfits that you wore during the course of the game
inside your Closet. If Trevor lives then he will also get a Nagasaki Blazer
ATV delivered to his Safehouse in Sandy Shores. He will also be able to buy
dresses at the Binco / Discount Stores.

You will also be able to play the other two endings without having to go back
to Devin's meeting with Franklin so you can play around and get the Gold
Medals related to them. However, the ending you chose on your initial
play-through will be the ending you officially get. If you wish to change
endings then you will need to redo the Finale and choose another ending.

            /=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=\
 /=========================================================================\
| >GHF53. 100% Completion Score                                             |
 \=========================================================================/
            \=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=/

If you've done *EVERYTHING* regardless of order then you should also have
100% Completion. And what do you earn for 100% Completion in "Grand Theft
Auto V"? The {Career Criminal} Accomplishment and nothing else other than the
"100%" T-Shirt for your wardrobe. Considering the scope of the game this is
quite a disappointment.

However, we're not quite done yet.....

  0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0
 / Strangers (Franklin) \
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+\
| >SFK28. The Last One                                                      0
0=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+/
| Overview /                                       \ Strangers (Franklin) /
0=========0                                         0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=0

  Franklin heads into the Raton Canyon area and finds a strange hunter. This 
  guy has been hunting the infamous Sasquatch for many years and even has 
  proof in the form of scat. He wants Franklin to help him hunt down the 
  mysterious creature.....

0========0
| Weapons \
0=======================>

  Advanced Rifle.

0======0
| Notes \
0=======================>

  This only opens up after you acquire 100% Completion and is entirely 
  optional. This usually takes a few days to appear from the time you acquire 
  100% Completion.

0=========0
| The Plan \
0=======================>

  Go to the Scat Site which is the yellow area on your map. When you get 
  there then you will finally encounter the creature who will run away. You 
  should try shoot him down. But he is pretty fast and will disappear from 
  your radar. In addition, if you use AutoAim, it won't lock onto him.

  Listen to his unique sound to put him back on the radar and continue the 
  chase. In addition to his speed he is also tough and will take multiple 
  shots to bring down (I believe it takes around fifty). It is very important 
  to point out that you also need to keep an eye and ear open for the pesky 
  Cougars - they can easily ambush you during the chase.

  After a long foot chase you will finally corner him on top of a hill 
  (assuming you don't manage to shoot him down beforehand). Shoot him to 
  start a cutscene. However, all is not as it seems. You can either kill it 
  or walk away to successfully complete the encounter.

0===========0
| 100% Score \
0=======================>

  >>Wounded
    *******
      You need to shoot the Sasquatch three times before the end of the 
      chase. All you need to do is to get a short burst of machine gun fire 
      on him which will get you more than enough shots you need for this  
      Requirement. Even if you can't AutoAim on him this is an easy task.

  >>Hunter
    ******
      You need to kill four animals while chasing the Sasquatch. You will be 
      dealing with multiple Cougars and you have to kill them before they 
      kill you so this is nearly automatic.

  >>Mr. Green
    *********
      You need to enter the Scat Site on foot.

0=======0
| Reward \
0=======================>

  Nothing.

       <0+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+<<##0##>>+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+=+0>

With that done, let's close things up.....
